items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出残差学习框架，以减轻训练比以往更深网络的难度：把网络层显式地重构为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数。实验证据表明，残差网络更易优化，并能从大幅增加的深度中获益。在 ImageNet 上，我们评估了深达 152 层、比 VGG 深 8 倍而复杂度更低的残差网络，其集成模型取得 3.57% 的测试错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名；在 CIFAR-10 上还分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。表征深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要，仅凭极深的表征即在 COCO 目标检测上取得 28% 的相对提升。
items.highlight_zh: 残差学习让 152 层网络更易训练，夺得 ILSVRC 2015 冠军
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：神经网络越深，理论上表达能力越强，但深层网络很难训练，优化困难、精度反而下降。
方法：作者提出「残差学习」——不让若干层直接学目标映射，而是学输入与输出之间的「残差」，并把输入经捷径直接加到输出上，构成残差块。网络只需学「在原有基础上改多少」，优化因此变得容易。
结果：在 ImageNet 上训练了深达 152 层的残差网络，比 VGG 深 8 倍而计算复杂度更低；多个残差网络集成后测试错误率仅 3.57%，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军。在 CIFAR-10 上还验证了 100 层乃至 1000 层网络的可行性。把这种极深表征用于 COCO 目标检测，带来 28% 的相对提升。
为何重要：它说明「深度」本身可以被有效利用，残差连接此后成为几乎所有深层网络的基础组件；该团队也凭此在 ILSVRC/COCO 2015 的检测、定位、分割等多项任务中夺冠。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。实验已测定约 10 万个独特蛋白质的结构，但这只占已知数十亿条序列的一小部分；测定单个结构往往需要数月到数年，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈。仅凭氨基酸序列预测三维结构——「蛋白质折叠问题」中的结构预测部分——已开放五十余年，现有方法仍远未达到原子精度，在没有同源结构时尤其如此。本文给出首个能在无相似结构已知时也稳定以原子精度预测结构的方法：完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，在第 14 届 CASP14 评估中多数案例精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法。其核心是把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（借助多序列比对）融入深度学习算法设计。
items.highlight_zh: 在无同源结构时也能以原子级精度预测蛋白质结构
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：蛋白质的三维结构决定其功能，但实验测定一个结构往往要数月到数年；已知蛋白序列有数十亿条，已解析结构仅约 10 万，结构覆盖严重不足。仅凭氨基酸序列预测结构——「蛋白折叠问题」的一部分——已悬而未决 50 多年。
方法：作者完全重新设计了基于神经网络的模型 AlphaFold，把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（尤其是多序列比对中蕴含的共进化信息）融入深度学习算法的设计。
结果：在第 14 届国际蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）中，AlphaFold 在多数目标上达到可与实验结构媲美的原子级精度，显著优于其他方法——这是首个在没有相似结构可用时也能稳定给出原子级精度预测的计算方法。
为何重要：它为大规模结构生物信息学打开大门，使海量序列的结构预测成为可能，对基础生物学研究与药物研发都有深远影响。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 利用衍射深度神经网络实现全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：在通过深度学习设计出协同工作的被动衍射层后，该网络可以学会实现多种功能。我们用 3D 打印的 D2NN 在太赫兹波段实验演示了该框架的成功——它学会了执行手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有的众多 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能够以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将在全光学图像分析、特征检测和目标分类中得到应用，还可促成能借 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 3D 打印的衍射层让光本身以光速完成分类与成像
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：常规神经网络靠电子计算，速度受硬件限制；能否让光本身完成神经网络的计算？
方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）——把多层被动衍射元件堆叠成网络，每个像素对通过的光施加特定调制，光在层间传播与逐层调制，整体效果类比神经网络中的「层＋激活」。网络参数用类似深度学习的方式训练得到，再用 3D 打印制作成实物。
结果：在太赫兹波段，他们做出实物 D2NN，成功实现手写数字分类和「成像透镜」两种功能——光穿过器件后在输出面即完成计算。
为何重要：该框架可利用成熟的 3D 打印、光刻和空间光调制器制造，以光速、较低功耗执行图像分析、特征检测与目标分类等任务，还可能催生能「学习」的新型相机与光学元件。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且被广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，数据科学家广泛使用它在众多机器学习挑战中取得最优结果。我们提出一种新颖的面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位草图。更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。结合这些设计，XGBoost 能用远少于现有系统的资源扩展到十亿级以上的样本。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知与加权分位草图让树提升扩展到十亿级样本
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：树提升（如梯度提升树）在机器学习竞赛和工业界效果极好，但当样本量达到数十亿、特征高度稀疏时，已有系统难以高效扩展。
方法：作者设计了端到端可扩展的树提升系统 XGBoost，核心包括：面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法（能自动处理缺失值、减少无效计算）、用于近似查找分裂点的加权分位草图，以及在系统层面的洞见——缓存访问模式优化、数据压缩与数据分片。
结果：把这些设计结合起来，XGBoost 能用远少于既有系统的资源扩展到十亿级以上的样本量，并在众多机器学习任务上取得当时的最优效果。
为何重要：它把算法改进与系统工程洞见结合，成为数据科学家的常用工具，也说明「可扩展性」往往是机器学习方法能否真正落地的关键。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，它代表来自 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与最近的语言表示模型不同，BERT 旨在通过在所有层中联合以左右上下文为条件，从无标签文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练的 BERT 模型只需增加一个输出层即可进行微调，从而为广泛的任务（如问答和语言推理）创建最先进的模型，而无需对特定任务的架构进行大量修改。BERT 在概念上简单，在经验上强大。它在十一个自然语言处理任务上获得了新的最先进结果，包括将 GLUE 分数推至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点）、MultiNLI 准确率推至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6%）、SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 推至 93.2（绝对提升 1.5 分）以及 SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 推至 83.1（绝对提升 5.1 分）。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：一个用于视觉、视觉惯性和多地图 SLAM 的精确开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能够使用单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机，采用针孔和鱼眼镜头模型，执行视觉、视觉惯性和多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个主要创新是一个基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM 系统，即使在其 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖于最大后验（MAP）估计。结果是一个系统能够在小型和大型、室内和室外环境中实时稳健运行，并且比先前方法精确 2 到 5 倍。第二个主要创新是一个多地图系统，它依赖于一种具有改进召回率的新地点识别方法。得益于它，ORB-SLAM3 能够在长时间视觉信息较差的情况下存活：当它丢失时，会启动一个新地图，当重访已建图区域时，该新地图将与先前地图无缝合并。与仅使用过去几秒信息的视觉里程计系统相比，ORB-SLAM3 是首个能够在所有算法阶段重用所有先前信息的系统。这允许在捆绑调整中包括共视关键帧，这些关键帧提供高视差观测以提升精度，即使它们在时间上相隔很远，或者来自先前的建图会话。我们的实验表明，在所有传感器配置中，ORB-SLAM3 与文献中可用的最佳系统一样稳健，并且显著更精确。值得注意的是，我们的双目惯性 SLAM 在 EuRoC 无人机上达到平均 3.6 cm 的精度，在 TUM-VI 数据集的房间中快速手持运动下达到 9 mm，该设置代表了 AR/VR 场景。为了社区的利益，我们公开了源代码。

items.title_en: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
items.title_zh: 世界模型作为原生潜在动作模型
items.abstract_en: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.
items.abstract_zh: 大规模且多样的视频来源，例如第一人称人类视频和异构机器人记录，蕴含丰富的动力学，但要么缺少动作，要么缺少共享的动作空间。潜在动作模型（LAMs）能够恢复这些动力学，但它们从零开始训练其逆动力学模型和前向动力学模型（IDM、FDM），在像素重建与潜在容量和准确性之间进行权衡。预训练视频世界模型原生生成高保真动力学，但以稠密方式表示它们，并使其在所有层中相互纠缠。将世界模型视为一种 LAM，我们表明只需对模型做最小改动即可提取这些动力学。Native LAM 将一个预训练视频扩散 Transformer 同时用作 IDM 和 FDM，以可学习的动力学寄存器作为两者之间唯一的因果桥梁，并在仅在运动上不同的反事实时间对上训练，从而使这些寄存器将视频的动力学蒸馏为紧凑的原生潜在动作。我们进一步提出一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的预训练范式，即从世界模型预训练动作（Pretraining Actions from World models，PAWlicy），其中 Native LAM 在大规模视频上充当动力学教师；与世界动作模型不同，它从不生成视频。在 LARY 基准上，原生潜在动作在动作分类和控制回归两方面均优于现有 LAM，并且在新机器人、新场景以及从人手到机器人上重放相同运动，尽管训练中未使用任何迁移目标。在使用域随机化演示训练的 RoboTwin 2.0 上，采用 3.8B 模型的 PAWlicy 达到 93.6% 的平均成功率，为 VLA 中最高。在 RoboDojo 上，它在我们评估的每个维度上都具有竞争力，并且我们评估的其 Precision 与排行榜领先条目相当。在真实机器人上，它在两个任务上均优于 pi_0.5 基线。两个阶段均仅使用公开数据和公开释放的世界模型。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
items.title_zh: 从部分配对的小规模数据中学习多模态表示
items.abstract_en: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.
items.abstract_zh: 从部分配对的样本中建模多模态数据，对生物医学等领域至关重要：这些领域拥有海量单模态数据集与基础模型，但配对数据依然稀缺。现有融合方法依赖大规模配对数据集，在不完全配对的情形下难以适用。我们提出 CAMEO，一个基于对抗学习的模态融合框架，可从规模小、仅部分配对的数据集中整合模态。CAMEO 将任意预训练单模态编码器与跨模态潜在对齐机制结合，只需极少量配对样本即可学习共享表示。在计算病理学的生态位分类与细胞类型组成预测等任务上，CAMEO 展现出更优的数据效率，在配对数据稀少的条件下优于 CLIP 等对比方法，凸显了配对标注稀缺时对抗对齐的优势。为便于后续研究，我们还发布了一个覆盖三个器官、包含配对图像与基因表达模态的全标注 HuggingFace 数据集。
items.highlight_zh: 对抗对齐让少量配对样本即可融合多模态
items.digest_zh:
「研究了什么问题」：生物医学等领域有海量单一模态数据（比如大量病理切片、大量基因表达谱）以及相应的基础模型，但同一样本同时具备图像与基因表达的“配对数据”非常稀缺。现有的大部分多模态融合方法都假设有大规模配对数据，一旦配对不全、规模很小就不适用。
「用了什么方法」：作者提出 CAMEO，一个基于对抗学习的模态融合框架。它可以外挂任意已预训练的单模态编码器，再通过“跨模态潜在对齐”机制把不同模态映射到共享表示空间，关键在于对齐是用对抗的方式完成的，而不是像 CLIP 那样依赖大量正负样本对的对比学习。因此只需极少量配对样本就能学到可用的共享表示。
「有什么结果」：在计算病理学的生态位（niche）分类与细胞类型组成预测任务上，CAMEO 的数据效率明显更好，在配对数据很少时超过 CLIP 等对比方法，说明配对标注稀缺时对抗对齐更划算。作者还额外发布了一个 HuggingFace 数据集，覆盖三种器官、包含配对的图像与基因表达模态且带完整标注。
「为何重要」：真实世界的多模态数据往往“不齐不齐、小而不全”，CAMEO 把融合方法从“大数据 + 全配对”的理想条件推广到现实条件，降低了多模态学习的门槛，也让这类方法更容易在生物医学等实际问题中落地。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Geometry-conditioned differentiable surrogate with adjoint Monte Carlo sampling for scintillator detector co-design
items.title_zh: 面向闪烁体探测器协同设计的几何条件可微代理模型与伴随蒙特卡罗采样
items.abstract_en: Optimizing light-guide geometries for scintillator-based imaging detectors requires repeated photon-transport evaluations, making direct Monte Carlo simulation computationally costly. Differentiable surrogates can accelerate these evaluations and support detector readout co-design aimed at improving information extraction from particle interactions. In this work we describe a surrogate model for photon transport. We develop it starting from a modular, event-driven Monte Carlo model for the generation and transport of scintillation photons, and a reciprocal Monte Carlo construction (an adjoint model) of a spatially and temporally resolved optical response field. The latter evaluates the collectible light output and its temporal structure from a scintillator volume by launching weighted photon trajectories from the light-guide readout face. We apply this approach to a scintillator cell with two mirrored, curved, single-clad light guides. We employ the adjoint model to train a geometry-conditioned neural surrogate that predicts collection probabilities and conditional transport-time distributions across a constrained guide-design family. The surrogate is natively differentiable, lending itself to be an element of a differentiable pipeline for gradient-based optimization. A forward-reciprocal benchmark and validation on held-out geometries establish the accuracy of the trained model and identify its limitations. The developed tools provide a foundation for rapid optical-response studies and detector readout co-design.
items.abstract_zh: 优化闪烁体成像探测器的光导几何需要反复评估光子输运，直接蒙特卡罗模拟代价高昂。本文提出一种光子输运代理模型：从模块化、事件驱动的闪烁光子产生与输运蒙特卡罗模型出发，构建空间与时间分辨的光学响应场的互易（伴随）蒙特卡罗形式——从光导读出端面发射加权光子轨迹，以评估可收集光输出及其时间结构。作者以含两条镜像曲面单包层光导的闪烁体单元为例，用伴随模型训练几何条件神经网络代理，在受限设计族内预测收集概率与条件输运时间分布。该代理天然可微，可作为基于梯度的可微优化流程中的组件；前向-互易基准与留出几何验证确认了模型精度并指出其局限，为快速光学响应研究与探测器读出协同设计奠定基础。
items.highlight_zh: 用伴随蒙特卡罗训练可微代理，加速光导协同设计
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】闪烁体探测器（医学成像、粒子物理中常见）的工作流程是：粒子在闪烁体内沉积能量发光，光再经光导传到读出端。光导的几何形状直接决定能收集多少光、光到达的时间分布，因此要优化几何，就得反复做蒙特卡罗光子输运模拟——每次都很贵，而且传统模拟不可求导，无法做梯度优化。
【用了什么方法】作者先搭建模块化、事件驱动的蒙特卡罗模型，描述闪烁光子的产生与传播；再构造它的“互易／伴随”版本：不从闪烁点向外发射光子，而是从光导读出端面反向发射带权重的光子轨迹，一次计算即可得到整个闪烁体体积内的可收集光输出及其时间结构。借助这个高效的伴随模型，作者在一族受约束的光导几何上训练了一个“以几何为条件”的神经网络代理：输入几何，输出收集概率和条件输运时间分布，且天然可微。
【得到什么结果】在一个含两条镜像曲面、单包层光导的闪烁体单元上，通过前向模拟与伴随模拟的交叉对照（前向-互易基准），以及在未参与训练的留出几何上测试，验证了代理的预测精度，并明确指出了它失效的边界。
【为何重要】把昂贵的物理模拟换成快速、可求导的预测器，意味着光导几何与探测器读出电子学可以做端到端的梯度优化，而不必把两者分开设计——这正是“协同设计”的关键一步。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 迈向全局反事实的自解释图神经网络
items.abstract_en: Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. To address these limitations, we propose GCSGNN (Global Counterfactual-based Self-explainable GNN), a unified framework that integrates counterfactual generation into the GNN architecture, encouraging explanations that faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. Beyond local explanations, GCSGNN discovers shared latent patterns influencing predictions across graphs, yielding global (i.e., model-level) counterfactual explanations. We further introduce an efficient latent-space counterfactual mechanism that avoids the combinatorial complexity of discrete graph manipulation, enabling scalable discovery of generalizable modification patterns. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GCSGNN outperforms existing methods in generating effective counterfactual explanations. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/gcsgnn.
items.abstract_zh: 图反事实解释（GCEs）通过寻找改变预测所需的最小图修改来解释 GNN 的预测，但现有方法存在两个根本局限：（1）依赖事后解释范式，即在 GNN 训练完成后单独训练解释器，这种顺序优化使解释器无法利用 GNN 学习表示的过程，解释质量往往偏低；（2）大多为局部解释，只针对单个样本生成反事实，无法捕捉跨数据分布的通用模式——而这对药物发现等需要从数以千计案例中总结全局规律的应用至关重要。为此作者提出 GCSGNN，一个将反事实生成整合进 GNN 架构的统一框架，使解释忠实反映模型的决策过程；同时挖掘跨图共享的潜在模式，给出模型级（全局）反事实解释。作者还设计了高效的隐空间反事实机制，避开离散图操作的组合复杂度，使可泛化修改模式的发现具备可扩展性。在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GCSGNN 生成的反事实解释优于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 把反事实生成融入 GNN，兼顾局部与全局自解释
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】图神经网络（GNN）广泛用于分子、社交网络等图数据，但它的预测难以理解。反事实解释的思路很直观：对输入图做尽可能小的改动，使模型预测发生翻转，从而告诉用户“改哪里会改变结论”。现有图反事实方法有两个短板：一是“事后解释”——先训好 GNN，再单独训一个解释器，解释器看不到模型内部如何形成表示，解释质量受影响；二是“只看单样本”，缺乏跨样本的普适规律，而像药物发现这类任务恰恰需要从上万案例中总结通用规则来做系统决策。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 GCSGNN，把反事实生成直接嵌入 GNN 架构，做成“自解释”模型，使解释与模型决策过程保持一致；同时在多张图之间寻找共享的潜在模式，得到模型级（全局）的反事实解释。为避开在离散图结构上搜索带来的组合爆炸，他们把反事实操作放到连续的隐空间中进行，从而高效、可扩展地发现有普遍意义的修改模式。
【得到什么结果】在多个真实数据集上的实验显示，GCSGNN 在生成有效反事实解释方面优于现有方法，代码已开源。
【为何重要】它把图解释从“一条样本一个解释”的个案层面，推进到能反映整个模型决策规律的全局层面，并用隐空间技巧解决了可扩展性问题；对于需要可信、可复用的模型解释的高风险应用，这是关键的一步。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
items.title_zh: ToolSmith：面向多模态搜索代理的自动工具生成框架
items.abstract_en: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的多模态搜索代理通过多轮推理、视觉理解与实时网络搜索，编排一小套手工打造的搜索与视觉工具，以回答超出参数知识范围的问题。但这套工具库制作与维护成本高，且遇到野外的查询新类型、证据新格式与失败模式时便无从应对。相比之下，人类从业者在工具不够时会用熟悉的部件临时拼装新工具，并在后续任务中复用。受此启发，作者提出 ToolSmith——一个在精简基础工具库之上自动生成并复用模块的工具生成框架。作者在三个域内多模态搜索基准和十个域外基准上，采用“VLM 作为裁判”的评测协议进行评估。结果表明，在不同规模的已部署代理上，ToolSmith 均稳定优于仅使用基础工具库的版本，且骨干模型越大收益越显著，体现了方法的可扩展性。
items.highlight_zh: 让多模态搜索代理自动造工具并复用，域外任务稳定提升
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】能看图、能推理、能实时联网搜索的多模态智能体，目前依靠一小套人工编写的“搜索工具＋视觉工具”工作。这套工具箱有两个痛点：造起来费时、维护成本高；更要命的是，一旦遇到新的查询类型、新的证据格式或新的失败模式，工具箱就“冻结”了，无法适应开放世界。
【核心灵感】人类遇到工具不够时，会用熟悉的零件临时拼出一个新工具，并在之后反复复用。作者希望智能体也具备这种“就地造工具、造完能复用”的能力。
【用了什么方法】ToolSmith 是一个自动工具生成框架：底座是精简的基础工具库，智能体在其上自动生成新模块，并将新模块沉淀下来供后续复用，能力因此不断生长。
【得到什么结果】作者在三个域内多模态搜索基准和十个域外基准上评测，采用“VLM 作为裁判”的打分协议。结果显示：对于不同规模的已部署代理，ToolSmith 都稳定优于只用基础工具库的版本；而且骨干模型越大，提升越明显，说明该方法具备良好的可扩展性。
【为何重要】它把“工具箱”从静态的人工产物变成了可自我扩展、可复用的组件。对于需要长期在线、面对层出不穷新问题的多模态搜索智能体来说，这种“自主制造工具”的能力比单纯扩大模型更重要——毕竟现实世界的问题类型不会提前列好清单。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
items.title_zh: Embo-Harness：理解“前沿模型即策略”的机器人执行框架
items.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal models exhibit extraordinary generalization in generating robot actions from observations and instructions, enabling a new paradigm in which they serve directly as policies within closed-loop robotic harnesses. However, the design principles of such harnesses, and the capabilities underlying their strong performance, remain unclear. We present Embo-Harness, a framework for systematically studying frontier-model-as-policy harnesses. We investigate four components of the robotic agentic loop, namely, prompting, planning, action execution, and tool use, and distill six empirical findings into a practical recipe. This recipe prioritizes interfaces that exploit the model's native visual reasoning and tool-use capabilities over handcrafted plans, skills, or action priors, and identifies effective choices for action representation, chunking, reasoning effort, visual observations, short multi-action sequences, and policy refinement. On RoboLab-120, Embo-Harness achieves an 83.3\% success rate, outperforming the strongest reported baseline by 26.2 percentage points. It also succeeds in 15 of 20 zero-shot trials across four real-world manipulation tasks. Beyond performance, controlled interventions indicate that the studied model depends more strongly on accurate spatial target estimation than on explicit low-level joint or trajectory generation. These results provide both a practical recipe for building strong frontier-model-as-policy harnesses and a clearer account of the capabilities that drive their performance.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿多模态模型在根据观测与指令生成机器人动作方面展现出极强的泛化能力，由此催生了一种新范式：让模型直接充当闭环机器人执行框架中的策略。然而，这类框架的设计原则及其性能背后的能力来源仍不清楚。作者提出 Embo-Harness，一个系统研究“前沿模型即策略”框架的方法，考察机器人智能体闭环中的四个环节——提示、规划、动作执行与工具使用，并将六条实证发现凝练为一份实用配方。该配方主张优先采用能发挥模型原生视觉推理与工具使用能力的接口，而非手工设计的计划、技能或动作先验，并明确了动作表示、动作分块、推理投入、视觉观测、短的多动作序列与策略精炼等方面的有效选择。在 RoboLab-120 上，Embo-Harness 取得 83.3% 的成功率，比已报告的最强基线高出 26.2 个百分点；在四个真实操作任务的 20 次零样本试验中也成功 15 次。受控干预进一步表明，所研究的模型更依赖准确的空间目标估计，而非显式的低层关节或轨迹生成。
items.highlight_zh: 前沿模型即策略：六条配方，成功率超最强基线26.2点
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】前沿多模态大模型已经能“看图＋读指令→输出机器人动作”，于是一种新范式出现：不再单独训练专用策略网络，而是把大模型本身放进闭环机器人系统里当策略用。但这类系统该如何搭建、它为什么表现这么好，此前缺乏系统研究。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 Embo-Harness 框架，把机器人智能体闭环拆成四个环节——提示（prompting）、规划、动作执行、工具使用——逐一做受控实验，并把结果提炼成六条经验，形成一份可操作的“配方”。
【配方要点】优先设计能发挥模型原生视觉推理与工具调用能力的接口，而不是堆砌手工计划、技能库或动作先验；文中还给出了动作表示方式、动作分块（chunking）、推理投入程度、视觉观测形式、短的多动作序列以及策略精炼等方面的有效选择。
【得到什么结果】在 RoboLab-120 基准上成功率达 83.3%，比已报告的最强基线高 26.2 个百分点；在四个真实世界操作任务的 20 次零样本尝试中成功了 15 次。
【更深的发现】通过受控干预，作者发现该模型的性能更依赖“能否准确估计空间中的目标位置”，而不是显式生成低层关节角或轨迹。这提示未来的系统设计应把重点放在准确的感知与目标定位上，而不是强行让模型输出精细的底层控制量。这一结论既给出了工程配方，也解释了大模型充当机器人策略时能力究竟来自哪里。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
items.title_zh: ViDiHand2：融合视频扩散先验与手部几何，实现野外场景中的三维手部运动重建
items.abstract_en: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at https://github.com/NTUYWANG103/ViDiHand.
items.abstract_zh: 从第一视角人类视频中学习机器人操作，需要精确的度量级三维手部运动。现有方法利用预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）先验，直接从全帧视频恢复被遮挡的手，但这类基于外观的深度回归在面对未见相机时泛化能力很差。本文提出 ViDiHand2——一个几何驱动的框架，把基于 VDM 的手部深度估计由直接回归改写为细粒度几何约束求解。具体而言，作者提出细粒度几何提升与片段级射线拟合，通过强制像素对齐的二维关节与 MANO 手部度量结构之间的几何一致性，并结合整段片段的时序观测来恢复度量深度。由于提升过程依赖二维关节，为提升遮挡与图像截断下的鲁棒性，作者进一步设计置信度门控融合，按定位置信度自适应地组合几何提升关节与 MANO 预测。此外还增强了 VDM 主干以更好地捕捉时空表征。在 7 个公开数据集上的实验表明，ViDiHand2 一致优于 18 个基线，野外绝对关节误差降低 42%，检测失败减少 8.82 倍，运行速度 57 FPS。
items.highlight_zh: 把深度回归改为几何约束求解，野外关节误差降 42%
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：要让机器人通过观看人类第一视角视频来学习操作，前提是知道手在三维空间中的真实尺度和位置。现有做法借助预训练视频扩散模型，从画面“猜”出被遮挡的手的深度，但这种依赖外观的回归一旦换成没见过的相机就失效，误差很大。
2）用了什么方法：ViDiHand2 换了一条思路——不直接回归深度，而是把问题转化为几何求解。首先增强 VDM 主干，让它输出每帧的二维手部关节和 MANO 手模型的预测；然后让二维关节与 MANO 提供的度量结构保持几何一致，把关节“提升”为三维；再利用整段视频的时序信息做片段级射线拟合，得到稳定的度量深度。挡手或手出画时二维关节不可靠，于是用置信度门控融合，根据定位置信度在几何提升结果与 MANO 预测之间自适应加权。
3）有什么结果：在 7 个公开数据集、18 个基线的对比中全面领先：野外场景的绝对关节误差比各指标最优基线降低 42%，检测失败率降低 8.82 倍，同时保持 57 FPS 的运行速度。
4）为何重要：这项工作说明“几何约束”比“外观回归”更能抵抗相机变化与遮挡，为从人类视频中大规模获取可用的度量级手部运动数据提供了实用方案，对机器人模仿学习具有直接价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: AVF creation in mice disrupts blood flow patterns to impact vasoreactivity
items.title_zh: 小鼠动静脉瘘（AVF）建立后改变血流模式并影响血管反应性
items.abstract_en: Maladaptive venous remodeling contributes to the high rate of arteriovenous fistula (AVF) maturation failure. Impaired vasoreactivity might impact this pathology. We created a murine AVF by anastomosing the external jugular vein to the carotid artery, establishing the AVF vein (AVF-V) and proximal (PA) and distal (DA) carotid artery. We hypothesized that endothelium-dependent vasorelaxation is impaired in the AVF-V vs. the contralateral vein (contra-V) of 5-month-old mice of both sexes 21-days post-surgery, reasoning that abrupt exposure to arterial pressure and disturbed hemodynamics promote endothelial dysfunction. Further, because magnetic resonance imaging revealed lower blood flow velocity and wall shear stress in PA vs. DA 21-days post-surgery, we hypothesized that endothelial function is compromised in PA. Whereas the thromboxane A2 receptor (TP) agonist U-46619 evoked sufficient vasocontraction in the contra-V from which subsequent vasorelaxation could be evaluated, AVF-V responsiveness was insufficient for this assessment, potentially reflecting >5-fold increases in collagen content and intima-media thickness. Consistent with our arterial hypothesis, endothelium-dependent vasorelaxation was impaired in the PA vs. DA and contralateral artery, whereas vascular smooth muscle function, cross-sectional area, collagen area, and intima-media thickness were similar among segments. Low shear stress impairs endothelial autophagy, which supports endothelial nitric oxide generation and vasodilation. Colocalized fluorescence of p-eNOSS1177 with CD31+ cells, and autophagy-related protein 3 with CD31+ cells, as well as nitric oxide bioavailability, were lower in PA vs. DA. These findings suggest that differential blood flow patterns in PA vs. DA following AVF creation may modulate endothelial autophagy, nitric oxide generation, and endothelium-dependent vasorelaxation.
items.abstract_zh: 静脉的不良重塑是动静脉瘘（AVF）成熟失败率高的重要原因，而血管反应性受损可能参与其中。作者将小鼠外颈静脉与颈动脉吻合建立 AVF，得到 AVF 静脉（AVF-V）以及近端（PA）与远端（DA）颈动脉。作者假设：术后 21 天，5 月龄雌雄小鼠的 AVF-V 相对于对侧静脉（contra-V）内皮依赖性舒张受损，因为其骤然暴露于动脉压与紊乱的血流动力学；同时 MRI 显示术后 21 天 PA 的血流速度与壁面剪切应力低于 DA，故推测 PA 内皮功能受损。结果显示，AVF-V 对血栓素 A2 受体激动剂 U-46619 的收缩反应不足，难以评估后续舒张，可能与胶原含量增加 5 倍以上及内膜-中膜增厚有关；与动脉假设一致，PA 的内皮依赖性舒张较 DA 及对侧动脉受损，而血管平滑肌功能、横截面积、胶原面积与内膜-中膜厚度在各段间相似。PA 中 p-eNOS S1177 与 CD31+ 细胞、自噬相关蛋白 3 与 CD31+ 细胞的共定位荧光以及一氧化氮生物利用度均低于 DA。
items.highlight_zh: AVF 术后近端动脉因低剪切应力出现内皮功能障碍
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：动静脉瘘是血液透析患者的“生命线”，但常常因为静脉不能正常增粗成熟而失败。作者想弄清：把静脉接到高压动脉上之后，瘘口附近不同位置的血管在功能上会发生什么改变，尤其是内皮调节血管舒缩的能力是否受损。
2）用了什么方法：在小鼠身上把外颈静脉与颈动脉吻合，建立动静脉瘘模型，术后 21 天取 5 月龄雌雄小鼠的 AVF 静脉、对侧静脉、以及瘘口近端和远端颈动脉进行对比。用磁共振成像测量各段血流速度与壁面剪切应力，用离体血管环张力实验评估收缩与内皮依赖性舒张，并检测胶原含量、内膜-中膜厚度、p-eNOS、自噬相关蛋白 3 与 CD31 的共定位及一氧化氮生物利用度。
3）有什么结果：影像显示近端动脉血流速度和剪切应力低于远端动脉。AVF 静脉收缩反应不足，无法完成舒张评估，同时胶原含量增加超过 5 倍、内膜-中膜明显增厚。与假设一致，近端动脉的内皮依赖性舒张比远端动脉和对侧动脉都差，而平滑肌功能、横截面积、胶原面积和内膜-中膜厚度在各段之间没有差别。近端动脉中 eNOS 磷酸化、自噬标志物与内皮细胞的共定位以及一氧化氮水平都更低。
4）为何重要：结果提示，瘘建立后不同血管段承受的不同血流模式会通过剪切应力—自噬—一氧化氮这条通路造成内皮功能差异，这为理解 AVF 成熟失败的机制、并寻找改善血流动力学或保护内皮功能的干预策略提供了线索。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: A Highly Tunable (Ti,Zr)N$_x$-Based MIM Plasmonic Sensor for Multidomain Biological, Chemical, and Physical Sensing
items.title_zh: 基于 (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 的高可调 MIM 等离激元传感器：面向生物、化学与物理多域传感
items.abstract_en: Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) plasmonic refractive index (RI) sensors have attracted considerable attention for label-free, real-time analyte detection; however, their reliance on noble metals such as gold and silver imposes fundamental constraints on tunability, thermal stability, and CMOS process compatibility. In this work, we propose a novel MIM plasmonic RI sensor based on a square ring resonator with embedded circular nanorods, employing the ternary nitride (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ as the plasmonic material, marking its first application in a MIM sensing platform. Compared to binary nitrides and other alternative plasmonic materials reported in the literature, (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ offers broader compositional tunability and greater flexibility in tailoring the optical response while remaining fully CMOS-compatible. The sensor is validated across a comprehensive range of biosensing and physicochemical analyte scenarios, including glucose monitoring for diabetes assessment, hemoglobin-based anemia classification across four severity levels, simultaneous discrimination of five major blood constituents, and cancer cell identification across six tissue types. For physical and chemical sensing, the structure achieves an air pressure sensitivity of 6.158 nm/MPa with negligible thermal cross-sensitivity, and a CO$_2$ detection sensitivity of 330.12 pm/ppm via polyhexamethylene biguanide (PHMB) functionalization, which is the highest reported among comparable structures in the literature. The proposed sensor achieves a maximum RI sensitivity of 2146.496 nm/RIU with a detection limit of $4.669 \times 10^{-7}$ RIU, outperforming previously reported CMOS-compatible plasmonic RI sensors.
items.abstract_zh: 金属-绝缘体-金属（MIM）等离激元折射率（RI）传感器因可无标记、实时检测分析物而备受关注，但其依赖金、银等贵金属，在可调性、热稳定性与 CMOS 工艺兼容性上存在根本限制。本文提出一种基于方形环谐振腔并嵌入圆形纳米棒的 MIM 等离激元 RI 传感器，采用三元氮化物 (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 作为等离激元材料，这是该材料首次用于 MIM 传感平台。与文献报道的二元氮化物及其他替代等离激元材料相比，(Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 组分可调范围更广、调控光学响应更灵活，且完全兼容 CMOS 工艺。作者在多种生物传感与理化分析场景中验证了该结构，包括糖尿病相关的葡萄糖监测、四级贫血程度的血红蛋白分类、五种主要血液成分的同时区分，以及六种组织的癌细胞识别。在物理与化学传感方面，该结构实现 6.158 nm/MPa 的气压灵敏度且热交叉敏感性可忽略，经聚六亚甲基双胍（PHMB）功能化后 CO$_2$ 检测灵敏度达 330.12 pm/ppm，为同类结构中最高报道值。传感器最大 RI 灵敏度为 2146.496 nm/RIU，检测限 $4.669 \times 10^{-7}$ RIU，优于此前报道的 CMOS 兼容等离激元 RI 传感器。
items.highlight_zh: 三元氮化物 (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 首次用于 MIM 传感，多域检测全面领先
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：MIM 等离激元传感器能靠折射率变化无标记、实时地检测分子，但常用材料是金和银，成本高、光学性质固定难调、不耐高温，也难以与标准 CMOS 芯片工艺兼容。作者想找一种既能灵活调节、又能与芯片产线兼容的替代等离激元材料，并用它做出多用途传感器。
2）用了什么方法：选用三元氮化物 (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 作为等离激元材料（这是它首次用于 MIM 传感平台），器件采用方形环谐振腔并内嵌圆形纳米棒的结构。通过改变材料组分可以调整光学响应；随后在生物、化学、物理三类场景中逐一验证传感性能：葡萄糖监测、按四个严重等级做血红蛋白贫血分类、同时区分五种主要血液成分、识别六种组织的癌细胞，以及气压与 CO$_2$ 检测（后者通过 PHMB 功能化实现）。
3）有什么结果：折射率灵敏度最高达 2146.496 nm/RIU，检测限 4.669×10⁻⁷ RIU，优于已有的 CMOS 兼容等离激元折射率传感器；气压灵敏度 6.158 nm/MPa 且几乎不受温度串扰；CO$_2$ 灵敏度 330.12 pm/ppm，是同类结构中报道的最高值。
4）为何重要：这项工作证明三元氮化物可以替代贵金属，在保持 CMOS 兼容的同时获得更宽的可调性和更好的热稳定性，使一个芯片级器件有望同时覆盖疾病标志物检测、血液分析、气体与压力测量等多种用途，向多功能集成传感迈出一步。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。

items.title_en: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
items.title_zh: RumiFold：让大语言模型原生地折叠蛋白质并推理其功能
items.abstract_en: Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. Code, data, and models are available at: https://rumifold.baulab.info
items.abstract_zh: 我们能否教会一个通用语言模型折叠蛋白质？如果可以，学会折叠除了结构预测之外还能带来什么？本文提出 RumiFold——一个预训练聊天模型，它直接从自身隐藏状态学习预测蛋白质结构。RumiFold 通过多次重复的折叠过程处理蛋白质，再利用这些折叠表示用自然语言回答问题。其折叠精度与 SimpleFold 等专用单表示模型相当，同时在基因本体（GO）蛋白功能预测与自由文本功能描述上达到领先水平。作者发现，折叠预训练使模型隐藏状态围绕蛋白质功能组织起来，形成一个具有生物学依据的逐残基内部工作区；因果干预实验表明，该折叠工作区在 RumiFold 预测功能时把结构与语言连接起来，为生物分子推理提供了丰富表征。作者将 RumiFold 视为迈向“原生生物分子智能”的一步：基于蛋白质的计算与基于语言的推理成为通用语言模型的集成能力。
items.highlight_zh: 语言模型学会折叠蛋白，并在隐藏状态中形成功能工作区
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：现在的大语言模型能聊天、能写代码，但能不能直接“折叠”一个蛋白质——也就是从氨基酸序列推出三维结构？更进一步，学会折叠这件事本身，会不会让模型在理解蛋白质功能上变得更强？
2）用了什么方法：作者构建了 RumiFold，一个预训练聊天模型，它不依赖外挂的结构预测模块，而是直接从自己的隐藏状态预测蛋白质结构。模型对每个蛋白进行多轮“折叠”处理，得到折叠表示，再用这些表示以自然语言回答关于功能的问题。作者还用因果干预的方式探查模型内部：当它预测功能时，是哪些内部表征在起作用。
3）有什么结果：RumiFold 的折叠精度与 SimpleFold 这类专用单表示结构预测模型相当，同时在基因本体（GO）功能预测和自由文本功能描述任务上达到最先进水平。分析显示，折叠预训练让模型的隐藏状态围绕蛋白质功能自发组织，形成一个逐残基的“内部工作区”，并且具有生物学意义；因果实验证明这个工作区正是连接三维结构与语言描述的桥梁。
4）为何重要：这项工作把结构预测从“外挂工具”变成语言模型的一种原生能力，说明折叠训练可以反过来提升模型对生物分子的推理能力。它为“原生生物分子智能”提供了一个可行方向：蛋白质计算与语言推理在同一个通用模型中融合，未来或许能用一句话直接询问结构与功能的关系。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
items.title_zh: 光学上下文压缩何时才划算？推理型 VLM 的解码感知成本分析
items.abstract_en: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.
items.abstract_zh: 把长文本渲染成图像，可让视觉语言模型（VLM）以更少的输入 token 读取文档，但以往评测往往主要统计这些 prefill token；本文指出，对推理模型而言，这种核算并不完整。在 5 个模型、2 个长上下文基准上，图像输入会使模型“想得更久”：4 个通用 VLM 的解码长度增长 1.5–3.5 倍；在典型输出定价下，这种“解码税”使 2 个模型在 QuALITY 上图像反而比文本更贵。中等压缩率下的信息损失不足以解释该现象（OCR 可恢复 98.7% 的词）。压缩是否划算可归结为汇率 (1-1/c)/(r-1) 是否超过工作负载的输出/输入价格加权比，这解释了 Kimi-K3 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 能获益而 Qwen 与 GLM 不能。据此提出的图像优先启发式策略可降低 6–14% 费用，准确率仅损失 0.3–1.2 点。
items.highlight_zh: 图像输入存在“解码税”，是否省钱要按价格汇率判断
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：把长文档渲染成图片喂给 VLM 以节省输入 token，是常见做法，但评测通常只关注 prefill token 变少，忽略了推理模型面对图像时可能“想得更久”，从而带来额外的输出（decode）开销。
2) 方法：在 5 个模型、2 个长上下文基准上对比文本与图像两种输入的 prefill 长度、解码长度与真实成本；用 OCR 结果以及“把模型自己的转写当作文本喂回”来区分“信息丢失”与“解码税”；再做成本核算分解，推导判断压缩是否划算的判据。
3) 结果：4 个通用 VLM 的图像输入使解码长度增至 1.5–3.5 倍；在典型输出定价下，5 个模型中有 2 个在 QuALITY 上图像输入反而更贵。信息损失并非主因：Qwen 的 OCR 可还原 98.7% 的单词，Kimi-K3 读取自身转写文本后推理长度与准确率均恢复。关键在于汇率 (1-1/c)/(r-1) 是否超过工作负载中输出与输入 token 的价格加权比，这解释了 Kimi-K3、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 获益而 Qwen、GLM 不获益。生成前，作者测试的所有免训练信号都无法预测这笔“解码税”。
4) 实用策略与意义：图像优先策略（压缩比≥1.6 才转图像，一旦图像模式的推理成本超过省下的 prefill 就回退文本）可省 6–14% 费用，准确率仅降 0.3–1.2 点；在 QuALITY 上，两条路径都设推理预算更有效。其意义在于提醒成本核算必须把“想得更久”计入，并给出可直接套用的判断公式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
items.title_zh: WorldLeague：物理能动性基准测试
items.abstract_en: AI systems can now operate Blender, follow instructions in complex video games, and manipulate objects with robot arms. What range of physical goals can today's AI systems achieve autonomously? Answering this question requires testing systems on tasks that demand different combinations of perception, memory, planning, and action. We introduce \textbf{WorldLeague}, a benchmark that compares AI systems on a common set of \textbf{60 simulated robot tasks} by measuring progress toward each task's physical goal from the robot's trajectory. Robots explore scenes to gather evidence in \textbf{WorldSeek}, rearrange objects in \textbf{WorldShape}, and adapt to changes in \textbf{WorldShift}. Tying these goals to a single control interface limits which AI systems can be compared. In WorldLeague, vision-language models (VLMs) choose targets and motions, while vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) use their native controls. For each of six capability dimensions, we measure how much progress a system makes toward its goals (Interactive Score) and how often it achieves them (physical success rate). Together, these measures form the system's \emph{Physical Agency Profile}. Among 13 representative AI systems, Claude Fable 5.2 achieves 13 of the 60 goals and earns the highest mean Interactive Score (28.58/100). Fable leads in four dimensions, while GPT-6.1-Sol and GPT-6-Astra tie for first on rule-following tasks. Even when VLMs answer every final question correctly, they receive an Interactive Score of zero in 71.8\% of those episodes. WorldLeague gives Embodied AI, Physical AI, and Agentic AI a shared basis for comparing what AI systems achieve autonomously, from partial progress toward a physical goal to full goal completion. Project Webpage: https://xyangzhou.github.io/WorldLeague
items.abstract_zh: AI 系统如今能操作 Blender、在复杂电子游戏中遵循指令、用机械臂操作物体。要回答“当今 AI 能自主完成哪些物理目标”，需要测试感知、记忆、规划与动作的不同组合。我们提出 WorldLeague 基准，在 60 个仿真机器人任务上，通过机器人轨迹衡量目标推进程度来比较 AI 系统：在 WorldSeek 中探索场景收集证据，在 WorldShape 中重排物体，在 WorldShift 中适应变化。VLM 负责选择目标与运动，VLA 与世界动作模型（WAM）使用其原生控制接口。针对六个能力维度，测量交互分数（进展）与物理成功率（达成），共同构成“物理能动性画像”。在 13 个代表性系统中，Claude Fable 5.2 完成 60 个目标中的 13 个，平均交互分数最高（28.58/100）；Fable 在四个维度领先，GPT-6.1-Sol 与 GPT-6-Astra 在规则遵循任务上并列第一。即使 VLM 最终回答正确，仍有 71.8% 的回合交互分数为零。
items.highlight_zh: 60 个仿真机器人任务统一评测物理能动性，答对不等于做到
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：如今 AI 能操作三维软件、在游戏里听指令、用机械臂操作物体，但“它们能自主完成哪些物理目标”缺乏统一衡量方式；不同系统的输出接口不同（有的输出文字、有的直接输出动作），导致难以横向比较。
2) 方法：推出 WorldLeague 基准，统一采用 60 个仿真机器人任务，按机器人轨迹对物理目标的推进程度打分，而不只看最终答案对错。任务分三族：WorldSeek（探索场景、收集证据）、WorldShape（重排物体）、WorldShift（适应环境变化）。VLM 通过选择目标与运动来行动，VLA 与世界动作模型（WAM）则使用各自的原生控制接口，从而把多种范式的系统放进同一跑道。
3) 评测指标：在六个能力维度上各算两项指标——交互分数（朝目标推进了多少）与物理成功率（是否达成），合成系统的“物理能动性画像”，能区分“部分推进”与“完全达成”。
4) 结果：在 13 个代表性系统中，Claude Fable 5.2 完成 60 个目标中的 13 个，平均交互分数最高（28.58/100），并在四个维度领先；GPT-6.1-Sol 与 GPT-6-Astra 在规则遵循任务上并列第一。一个刺眼发现是：即使 VLM 把每个最终问题都答对，仍有 71.8% 的回合交互分数为零，也就是“说得对但没做到”。
5) 为何重要：它为具身智能、物理 AI 与智能体研究提供共同坐标与可量化画像，把“语言层面的正确”和“物理世界的达成”明确区分开来。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
items.title_zh: WeMM-Ecom：推进微信电子商务的多模态内容理解
items.abstract_en: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 WeMM-Ecom，一系列多模态大语言模型，在各自规模上提供前沿的电子商务能力，同时达到最先进的通用性能。该系列涵盖五种规模，从 0.8B 稠密模型到 35B 混合专家模型（激活参数 3B）。我们的训练流程首先进行两阶段持续预训练，在多样化的多模态数据混合中逐步提高电子商务数据的比例；随后进行混合思维后训练，结合同策略蒸馏与强化学习，以同时支持非思考模式和思考模式。在评估方面，我们构建了涵盖 28 个电子商务基准（23 个内部基准和 5 个开源基准）的综合套件，覆盖八个业务场景，并辅以 64 个公开通用基准。在电子商务套件上，WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B 超越了规模显著更大的开源旗舰模型，包括 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、HY4 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。在通用套件上，每个 WeMM-Ecom 模型都超越了同等规模的 Qwen3.5 对应模型，其中轻量变体（如 WeMM-Ecom-2B）相较 Qwen3.5-2B、MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B 和 LFM3-VL-2B 等领先轻量模型显示出明显优势。在基准之外，WeMM-Ecom 目前已支持微信中数百个生产用例，包括商品目录管理、多模态商品搜索和直播电商，每日处理十亿级请求。我们公开所有模型权重，并详述数据整理、训练方案和基准构建，以促进未来面向领域专用的多模态模型研究。我们已在 https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom 发布模型权重和代码，以促进后续研究。

items.title_en: LeCellModel: Interpretable Density Estimation over the Gene Expression Manifold
items.title_zh: LeCellModel：基因表达流形上可解释的密度估计
items.abstract_en: Representation learning for single-cell RNA-seq has been evaluated by the identities representations capture -- cell types, lineages, perturbations -- rather than how faithfully they model the distribution of cell states on the gene expression manifold. As a result, density estimation, rare-state detection, perturbation scoring, and gene-level attribution are bolted onto frozen embeddings as separate models, disconnected from the geometry of the data. We argue that modeling the distribution of cell states should be the primary objective, and that representation quality follows from it. Building on LeJEPA, whose SIGReg objective enforces a provably optimal isotropic Gaussian latent, we introduce LeCellModel, which reads the encoder's Jacobian log-volume (JEPA-SCORE) under this Gaussian latent as a relative typicality score. Across several datasets, LeCellModel outperforms established methods on the scIB benchmark for representation quality. Furthermore, we show that LeCellModel enables detection of rare expression states using JEPA-SCORE as a typicality measure, applying it to a controlled cytokine panel, where it identifies stimulated cells across minority fractions and tracks pathway-response magnitude. We introduce gene-level interpretability of the typicality score -- to our knowledge, the first method for analyzing JEPA-SCORE in feature space. Leveraging this framework, LeCellModel recapitulates the known association of a profibrotic macrophage program with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and discovers a CD177+ activated regulatory T cell subpopulation previously described only in tumor contexts. Both findings emerge directly from the geometry of the learned embedding, without relying on supervised annotations.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞 RNA-seq 的表征学习一直以表征所捕获的身份——细胞类型、谱系、扰动——来评估，而非以它们在基因表达流形上多忠实地建模细胞状态分布来评估。因此，密度估计、稀有状态检测、扰动评分和基因级归因作为独立模型被附加在冻结嵌入上，与数据的几何结构相脱节。我们认为，建模细胞状态分布应当是首要目标，表征质量由此而来。基于 LeJEPA（其 SIGReg 目标强制得到可证明最优的各向同性高斯潜空间），我们提出 LeCellModel，在该高斯潜空间下将编码器的雅可比对数体积（JEPA-SCORE）解读为相对典型性分数。在多个数据集上，LeCellModel 在 scIB 表征质量基准上优于已有方法。此外，我们证明 LeCellModel 能够以 JEPA-SCORE 作为典型性度量来检测稀有表达状态，并将其应用于受控细胞因子面板，在少数比例中识别出受刺激细胞，并追踪通路响应幅度。我们引入典型性分数的基因级可解释性——据我们所知，这是首个在特征空间中分析 JEPA-SCORE 的方法。利用该框架，LeCellModel 重现了促纤维化巨噬细胞程序与特发性肺纤维化的已知关联，并发现了此前仅在肿瘤情境中描述过的 CD177+ 活化调节性 T 细胞亚群。两项发现均直接源自所学嵌入的几何结构，而不依赖监督标注。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
items.title_zh: GaAs 与 Si 中轨道与自旋响应的解剖：霍尔、逆法拉第与磁光克尔效应
items.abstract_en: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. At small electron doping, the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity exceeds its spin counterpart in magnitude, while the orbital contribution to light-induced magnetization dominates over broad photon-energy ranges. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. This contrast reflects direct electric-dipole coupling to orbital motion versus spin-orbit-mediated coupling to spin polarization. Consequently, Si maintains a substantial orbital magneto-optical response despite its weak spin-orbit interaction. At probe energies of 1.5 eV in GaAs and 3.0 eV in Si, the magnitude of the Kerr rotation per unit orbital moment is approximately 5 and 13 times larger than that per unit spin moment, respectively. Combining the calculated Hall conductivities and Kerr coefficients with a phenomenological drift-diffusion model yields predominantly orbital edge signals for the assumed diffusion constants and relaxation lengths. These results indicate that optical detection of induced magnetization in doped semiconductors such as GaAs and Si can be dominated by orbital signals, and therefore cannot be interpreted solely in terms of spin polarization.
items.abstract_zh: 非磁性半导体中的磁光信号在角动量产生与磁光检测两方面都将自旋与轨道贡献纠缠在一起。我们使用密度泛函理论、线性响应理论以及对逆法拉第效应的二阶密度矩阵处理，计算了电子掺杂 GaAs 和 Si 中的这些贡献。在低电子掺杂下，本征轨道霍尔电导率在量值上超过其自旋对应量，而轨道对光致磁化的贡献在较宽光子能量范围内占主导。我们表明，轨道与自旋分辨的光学霍尔系数和极向克尔系数对轨道矩的敏感性高于对等量自旋矩的敏感性。这一对比反映了电偶极直接耦合到轨道运动与通过自旋-轨道介导耦合到自旋极化的差异。因此，尽管 Si 的自旋-轨道相互作用较弱，其仍保持可观的轨道磁光响应。在 GaAs 的 1.5 eV 和 Si 的 3.0 eV 探测能量下，单位轨道矩的克尔旋转幅度分别约为单位自旋矩的 5 倍和 13 倍。将计算得到的霍尔电导率和克尔系数与唯象漂移-扩散模型结合，在假设的扩散常数与弛豫长度下主要得到轨道边缘信号。这些结果表明，在 GaAs 和 Si 等掺杂半导体中，对感生磁化的光学检测可能由轨道信号主导，因此不能仅用自旋极化来解释。

items.title_en: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
items.title_zh: DeepDOSReasoner：面向态密度预测与材料发现的物理基础推理
items.abstract_en: Predicting a material's behavior from its atomic structure is a longstanding goal of the physical sciences. The electronic and phonon densities of states (eDOS and phDOS) govern key electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic properties, yet their calculation using density functional theory (DFT) is costly: about 60% of Materials Project entries lack eDOS and over 80% lack phDOS. Existing crystal-to-spectrum models rely on pooled structural representations and pointwise regression, which blur spectral features and violate total-state conservation. Here we introduce DeepDOSReasoner, a physics-grounded framework that decodes spectra through atom-to-energy source attention and refines the normalized DOS through learned continuity-equation transport, enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction. DeepDOSReasoner achieves the highest prediction accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both eDOS and phDOS, recovers element-resolved contributions without supervision, and most reliably identifies rare valence-band (VB) gaps. In a prospective screen of 8,106 uncharted materials validated by new DFT calculations, its predictions remain the most accurate among the methods evaluated, with 25 of its top 50 candidates confirmed as VB-gap materials. Three case studies spanning substituted compounds, photovoltaic chalcogenides, and a high-entropy alloy demonstrate transfer across materials classes. Ablations confirm that both stages are necessary, while the model retains comparable accuracy when trained on only 25% of the data. Predicting spectra in milliseconds enables exhaustive screening; we release predictions filling the missing eDOS for 91,405 and phDOS for 127,768 Materials Project entries. DeepDOSReasoner provides a blueprint for integrating machine learning with physical reasoning toward high-throughput spectral screening and autonomous materials discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 从原子结构预测材料行为是物理科学的一个长期目标。电子态密度与声子态密度（eDOS 和 phDOS）决定关键的电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，但使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算它们代价高昂：Materials Project 中约 60% 的条目缺少 eDOS，超过 80% 缺少 phDOS。现有的晶体到谱模型依赖池化结构表示和逐点回归，这会模糊谱特征并违反总态守恒。在此我们提出 DeepDOSReasoner，这是一个基于物理的框架，通过原子到能量源注意力解码谱，并通过学习到的连续性方程输运细化归一化 DOS，在构造上强制非负性和总态守恒。DeepDOSReasoner 在 eDOS 和 phDOS 的所有评估指标上均取得最高预测精度，无监督地恢复元素分辨贡献，并且最可靠地识别稀有的价带（VB）带隙。在对 8,106 种未探索材料进行的前瞻性筛选中（经新的 DFT 计算验证），其预测在所评估方法中仍最准确，其前 50 个候选中有 25 个被确认是 VB 带隙材料。涵盖取代化合物、光伏硫属化物和高熵合金的三个案例研究展示了跨材料类别的迁移能力。消融实验确认两个阶段均必要，而仅用 25% 数据训练时模型仍保持相当精度。毫秒级预测谱使穷尽式筛选成为可能；我们发布了填补 Materials Project 中 91,405 个条目缺失 eDOS 和 127,768 个条目缺失 phDOS 的预测。DeepDOSReasoner 为将机器学习与物理推理相结合、面向高通量谱筛选和自主材料发现提供了蓝图。

items.title_en: Tool-to-Self: Internalizing Visual Tool Capabilities via Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Tool-to-Self：通过脚手架式强化学习内化视觉工具能力
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on external visual tools to access fine-grained visual evidence, but repeated tool execution incurs substantial inference overhead and deployment dependencies. Moreover, conventional tool-use RL can improve visual-task performance, yet the resulting tool gains are often unstable. Motivated by this, we propose Tool-to-Self (T2S), a tool-scaffolded reinforcement learning framework that turns external visual tools into temporary training scaffolds. T2S cold-starts tool-use ability and observation prediction from tool-repairable examples, then progressively anneals tool execution on a per-tool basis during RL. By combining answer-correctness and observation-consistency rewards with privileged on-policy self-distillation from actual tool observations, T2S effectively teaches the model both to reproduce tool outputs and to reason from them. Experiments across diverse visual perception and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over both explicit tool-use models and implicit zooming models while enabling tool-free inference with reduced latency.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）越来越依赖外部视觉工具来获取细粒度视觉证据，但重复执行工具会带来显著的推理开销和部署依赖。此外，传统的工具使用强化学习可以提升视觉任务性能，但由此获得的工具收益往往不稳定。受此启发，我们提出 Tool-to-Self（T2S），一个工具脚手架式强化学习框架，将外部视觉工具转变为临时训练脚手架。T2S 从可由工具修复的示例中冷启动工具使用能力和观测预测，然后在强化学习过程中按工具逐个逐步退火工具执行。通过将答案正确性和观测一致性奖励与来自实际工具观测的特权同策略自蒸馏相结合，T2S 有效地教会模型既复现工具输出，又基于其进行推理。在多种视觉感知与推理基准上的实验表明，相较于显式工具使用模型和隐式缩放模型，T2S 均取得一致提升，同时实现无工具推理并降低延迟。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接激光雷达-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、稳健且多功能的激光雷达-惯性里程计框架。基于高效紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波器，FAST-LIO2 具有两个关键创新，使其能够实现快速、稳健且准确的激光雷达导航（与建图）。第一个是直接将原始点配准到地图（并随后更新地图，即建图），而无需提取特征。这能够利用环境中的细微特征，从而提高精度。消除手工设计的特征提取模块也使其自然适应具有不同扫描模式的新兴激光雷达；第二个主要创新是使用增量 k-d 树数据结构 ikd-Tree 维护地图，该结构支持增量更新（即点插入、删除）和动态重平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R* 树、nanoflann k-d 树）相比，ikd-Tree 取得更优的整体性能，同时天然支持在树上进行下采样。我们在来自多种公开激光雷达数据集的 19 个序列上进行了详尽的基准比较。与其他最先进的激光雷达-惯性导航系统相比，FAST-LIO2 以低得多的计算负载持续获得更高精度。我们还对小视场固态激光雷达进行了多种真实世界实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（例如在大型室外环境中高达 100 Hz 的里程计与建图）、稳健（例如在旋转速度高达 1000 deg/s 的杂乱室内环境中可靠位姿估计）、多功能（即可适用于多线旋转和固态激光雷达、无人机与手持平台，以及 Intel 和 ARM 处理器），同时仍比现有方法取得更高精度。我们的系统 FAST-LIO2 实现和数据结构 ikd-Tree 均已在 Github 上开源。

items.title_en: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
items.abstract_en: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

items.title_en: GABIF: An Adaptive Guided Graph Denoising Framework for Antibody Conditional Inverse Folding
items.abstract_en: Antibodies play a central role in the human immune system, and their design is critical for vaccine development, therapeutic intervention, and improving human longevity. However, the vast combinatorial search space of antibodies poses a fundamental challenge for de novo discovery. Recent advances in deep learning, particularly denoising diffusion models, have demonstrated strong potential in protein inverse folding. Nevertheless, existing approaches are largely constrained to learning from natural antibody repertoires, thereby generating sequences that closely resemble natural antibodies. Such similarity, however, does not necessarily translate into improved functional performance in downstream applications. In this work, we develop a novel generative protein design model that enables the generation and optimization of antibody sequences tailored to specific downstream tasks and target metrics. Besides training on given an antibody dataset, we guide the generative model by an antibody-antigen binding affinity predictor for conditional discrete diffusion. The model is pre-trained on a given antibody dataset. Meanwhile, an antibody-antigen binding affinity predictor is incorporated as a conditional signal in a discrete diffusion framework, where a regressor serves as the conditional probability to guide the learning of the amino acid probability distribution of sequences under the objective of affinity optimization. In silico experiments demonstrate that our antibody design model achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art approaches, while the proposed regressor effectively improves binding affinity, as validated by an independent external predictor. Furthermore, our results highlight that the combination of finetuning and supervised guidance provides a powerful paradigm for adapting pretrained models to downstream tasks.

items.title_en: Polarization switching of double azimuthal backflow in two transverse orbital angular momentum superpositions
items.abstract_en: Optical backflow in the azimuthal direction can be generated by the interference of two rotating-wave structured light beams with distinct transverse topological charges and equal intensity. Here we show that the interference reverses both azimuthal components of the Poynting and the canonical momenta. Although these two momenta are not generally tied, they reverse jointly here: both acquire azimuthal backflow in a common angular sector, while their radial intervals can differ. The double backflow is switched solely by the polarizations of the two beams, without amplitude tuning. A single polarization overlap enters the interference terms of both momenta but not the single-beam terms of either, so that matched polarizations switch the double backflow on whereas mismatched ones switch it off. The double backflow is periodic in the azimuthal direction, with its angular period locked to the topological charge difference and independent of the individual charges. Our results establish a vectorial mechanism for polarization-gated azimuthal backflow, with potential applications in polarization-switchable optical manipulation.

items.title_en: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
items.abstract_en: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.

items.title_en: From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use
items.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. It counterfactually probes the model's reasoning states to identify observation-sensitive questions, distinguishing them from reasoning-dominated ones. PADS then periodically estimates category-level observation effects from recent policy rollouts and dynamically reallocates the training distribution toward questions where visual observations provide informative learning signals, while optimizing solely for final-answer correctness. Experiments across diverse visual perception and multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive tool-use MLLMs, with causal analysis further validating the data-centric perspective for learning effective visual tool use.

items.title_en: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
items.abstract_en: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.

items.title_en: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
items.title_zh: 解析视觉潜表示用于多模态空间推理
items.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.
items.abstract_zh: 跨多个视图的空间推理需要从二维观测中推断物体与相机之间的三维关系，这依赖于跨视图对应关系和场景几何，而视觉语言模型（VLMs）无法可靠地提取这些信息。预训练的视觉编码器已在其潜在特征中捕获了这些信息：CLIP 将物体与图像区域关联，DINOv3 跨视图匹配语义，VGGT 编码多视图几何。然而，当我们将这些特征以灰度特征图像的形式直接呈现在上下文中时，VLMs 并不能从中受益。因此，我们提出 LatentParse，一个无需训练的框架，将潜在特征解析为供 VLMs 使用的显式空间证据。在 LatentParse 中，一个分析器 VLM 使用预定义工具探测全部三个编码器的特征，这些工具用于定位物体、跨视图跟踪物体以及测量视图间的运动。随后它将结果提炼为一份简洁的文本报告，与图像一起提供给 VLM 以回答问题。我们在 MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench 和 SPAR-Bench 上评估 LatentParse，其使全部五个 VLM 相较于仅图像基线平均提升 0.7–2.4 个百分点。在 MMSI-Bench 上，它将 Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.4% 提升至 39.5%，其中在相机相关问题上提升最大，达 19.2 个百分点。这些结果表明，一旦潜在特征被解析为关系证据，无需训练即可对空间推理有用。代码见 https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse。

items.title_en: Active sensing as control over sensory acquisition
items.title_zh: 主动感知作为对感觉获取的控制
items.abstract_en: The term "active sensing" is used across neuroscience and engineering to describe a wide range of sensing behaviors, but there is no consensus on what makes sensing "active." We propose that the behaviors grouped under this label are better understood as forms of control over sensory acquisition and develop a framework that distinguishes three interacting forms of control. Mechanistic control physically structures sensory input, strategic control modulates sensing in closed loop through adaptive and attentional processes, and agentic control concerns the sensing policies available to an agent and its authority to choose among them. These forms of control can occur separately or in combination, and have distinct consequences for sensory input, perception, behavior, and performance. The framework clarifies active-passive comparisons and provides a common basis for analyzing biological, engineered, and hybrid sensing systems by asking what is controlled, how, and by whom.
items.abstract_zh: “主动感知”一词在神经科学和工程领域被用来描述广泛的感知行为，但对于何种感知才算“主动”尚无共识。我们提出，归于此标签下的行为更适合被理解为对感觉获取的控制形式，并构建了一个区分三种相互作用控制形式的框架。机制性控制从物理上构建感觉输入；策略性控制通过自适应与注意过程在闭环中调制感知；能动性控制则关乎智能体可用的感知策略及其在其中进行选择的权限。这些控制形式可以单独出现或组合出现，并对感觉输入、知觉、行为与性能产生不同后果。该框架厘清了主动与被动的比较，并通过追问“控制什么、如何控制、由谁控制”，为分析生物、工程及混合感知系统提供了共同基础。

items.title_en: Designing Incoherent Multispectral Diffractive Optical Networks for Satellite Image Classification
items.title_zh: 设计用于卫星图像分类的非相干多光谱衍射光学网络
items.abstract_en: Optical neural networks and diffractive optical computing provide a promising route for performing task-specific inference with high parallelism and lightweight electronic post-processing. These advantages are especially attractive for multispectral satellite imaging, where conventional workflows rely on transmitting high-dimensional image cubes to the ground for downstream electronic analysis. Here, we introduce a computationally efficient surrogate model-guided framework for designing incoherent multispectral diffractive optical networks that directly output class probabilities onboard, eliminating the need to capture and transfer the full multispectral data cube for ground-side inference. We first train a physically compatible surrogate model, represented by a non-negative fully connected model that accommodates a generalized detector readout, yielding a task-specific non-negative multispectral intensity transformation that can be transferred to an optical processor. We then synthesize its diffractive counterpart through data-free point-spread-function-based optimization under spatially incoherent illumination. Using this approach, we numerically demonstrate a six-spectral-channel diffractive classifier for tri-class satellite-scene recognition, achieving a blind-testing accuracy of 79.8% for artificial surface, water body, and vegetated land images, closely approaching the 81.8% accuracy of its surrogate. We further demonstrate a more compact three-spectral-channel design that numerically achieves 72.7% blind-testing accuracy, compared with 75.1% for its corresponding surrogate model. This surrogate model-guided strategy provides a practical pathway for designing compact, task-specific incoherent multispectral optical processors for resource-constrained remote-sensing inference.
items.abstract_zh: 光学神经网络与衍射光学计算为以高并行度和轻量电子后处理执行任务特定推理提供了一条有前景的途径。这些优势对多光谱卫星成像尤为有吸引力，因为传统工作流程依赖将高维图像立方体传输至地面进行下游电子分析。在此，我们提出一种计算高效的代理模型引导框架，用于设计非相干多光谱衍射光学网络，该网络在星上直接输出类别概率，从而无需为地面端推理采集并传输完整多光谱数据立方体。我们首先训练一个物理兼容的代理模型，其由非负全连接模型表示并支持广义探测器读出，从而产生可迁移至光学处理器的任务特定非负多光谱强度变换。随后，我们在空间非相干照明下通过无数据的基于点扩散函数的优化来合成其衍射对应物。利用该方法，我们数值演示了一个用于三类卫星场景识别的六光谱通道衍射分类器，在人工地表、水体和植被土地图像上取得 79.8% 的盲测准确率，接近其代理模型的 81.8% 准确率。我们进一步展示了一个更紧凑的三光谱通道设计，数值上取得 72.7% 的盲测准确率，而对应的代理模型为 75.1%。这种代理模型引导的策略为设计紧凑、任务特定的非相干多光谱光学处理器提供了实用途径，适用于资源受限的遥感推理。

items.title_en: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
items.title_zh: 线性方法能走多远？BiPert：单细胞扰动建模的统一框架
items.abstract_en: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 理解遗传扰动如何影响细胞行为对于研究基因功能和调控机制至关重要。大规模 CRISPR 筛选在数千个基因上测量这些效应，但覆盖的细胞情境相对较少。因此，在未见细胞类型中预测扰动响应，以及从转录效应中识别被扰动基因，仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们表明这两个任务都可以通过将转录响应共同线性分解为共享成分和扰动特异成分来解决。基于这一原理，我们提出 BiPert，一个用于正向扰动预测和逆向识别的简单线性框架。在正向预测方面，BiPert 在预测未见细胞系中的基因表达变化时，优于不使用外部生物学知识的现有方法。其少样本扩展 BiPert-FS 仅使用十个已测量扰动即可适应新细胞系。在逆向识别方面，BiPert-ID 从单细胞表达谱中识别被扰动基因，在未见细胞系和供体中优于深度学习方法。我们进一步表明，即使在控制扰动效应量之后，效应在细胞情境间迁移更一致的扰动也更容易被识别。总之，这些结果建立了扰动迁移与识别之间的联系，并表明简单线性模型为这两个任务提供了强大且可解释的基线。
