items.title_en: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 从奖励模型所说转向其如何思考：用于 LLM 强化学习的注意力过程奖励模型
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLMs）中的重要组成部分。然而，现有 RL 方法关注最终输出或文本解题轨迹，导致粗粒度奖励和不可靠的推理。此类范式主要关注模型输出什么，而忽视模型内部如何推理。因此，我们能否奖励模型内部如何思考，而不仅仅是其说了什么？我们首先揭示现有奖励建模方法中存在的文本奖励混叠问题。受此启发，我们提出注意力过程奖励模型（APRM），其基于隐藏状态和注意力图分配内部奖励，以捕获高质量推理模式。APRM 仅有约 4600 万参数，使用排序和反事实目标进行训练，其奖励引导 RL 优化，同时定期更新以应对分布偏移。与代表性 RL 方法集成后，APRM 取得平均 2.88% 的 pass@8 提升。我们的结果展示了将内部推理信号纳入 LLM 强化学习的前景。

items.title_en: DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations
items.title_zh: DexDuet：从人类演示中学习保持接触的双臂灵巧操作
items.abstract_en: Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. Even with accurate tracking, robots may contact incorrect object parts or slide their fingers, resulting in unstable manipulation. We present DexDuet, a framework that learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration. DexDuet employs two interaction rewards to preserve human hand-object configurations and contacts. To enable coordinated manipulation, we factorize the bimanual policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies that condition on each other's states. We further propose assisted reference-state initialization (A-RSI), an adaptive curriculum that adjusts object assistance and training starts across demonstration segments to overcome difficult manipulation phases. Across four benchmarks spanning three simulators and five robot embodiments, DexDuet improves object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points over the corresponding baselines while consistently achieving better contact preservation. Notably, among 122 paired runs with comparable object-tracking accuracy, DexDuet preserves the human's contacts better in 117 cases. Code and videos are available at https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/
items.abstract_zh: 人类演示为双臂灵巧技能提供了丰富来源，但将其迁移至机器人手仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要优化物体轨迹跟踪，往往忽视人手如何与物体交互。即使跟踪准确，机器人也可能接触错误的物体部位或使手指滑动，导致操作不稳定。我们提出 DexDuet，一个从单次人类演示中学习保持接触的双臂灵巧操作的框架。DexDuet 采用两种交互奖励来保持人手-物体构型与接触。为实现协调操作，我们将双臂策略分解为两个共享权重的单手策略，二者以彼此状态为条件。我们进一步提出辅助参考状态初始化（A-RSI），一种自适应课程方法，跨演示片段调整物体辅助和训练起点，以克服困难的操作阶段。在涵盖三个模拟器和五种机器人本体的四个基准上，DexDuet 相较相应基线将物体跟踪 ADD-AUC 提升 11 至 41 个点，同时始终实现更好的接触保持。值得注意的是，在 122 组物体跟踪准确率相当的配对运行中，DexDuet 在 117 例中更好地保持了人类接触。代码与视频见 https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/

items.title_en: WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
items.title_zh: WildAnySplat：野外场景中的前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting
items.abstract_en: We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods. To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data. We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation. Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 WildAnySplat，一个前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting（三维高斯泼溅）框架，能够从野外多视图图像中进行稳健的新视图合成。与受控拍摄不同，真实世界图像通常包含由瞬态遮挡物、光照变化和相机 ISP 引起的多视图不一致，这会降低现有前馈重建方法的质量。为应对这一挑战，我们引入学生-教师框架，学习对瞬态鲁棒且外观一致的三维表示。教师网络处理干净图像，学生网络处理对应的野外输入。教师提供干净监督，引导学生趋向一致的规范表示。由于成对的干净与野外数据稀缺，我们采用混合数据策略，结合真实配对拍摄、合成增强以及由基于优化的重建生成的伪干净标签，弥合合成数据与真实世界数据之间的域差距。我们采用 Transformer 架构，并为相机位姿、深度和高斯预测设置专用 DPT 头。我们还预测每个视图的瞬态掩码，以重新加权光度监督并抑制不可靠高斯。为考虑跨视图外观变化，我们加入双边网格模块，对每幅图像的颜色变换建模，并能够恢复规范辐射表示。在具有挑战性的野外基准上的实验表明，WildAnySplat 提高了对瞬态遮挡和外观变化的鲁棒性，同时保留前馈高斯泼溅的快速推理。

items.title_en: Infrared Relaxation Modes and the Emergence of Collective Order in Neural Dynamics
items.title_zh: 红外弛豫模式与神经动力学中集体秩序的出现
items.abstract_en: We develop a microscopic field theory of collective order formation in interacting nonlinear neural systems. Integrating out microscopic neural degrees of freedom yields an effective action whose quadratic kernel determines the ordering threshold, while higher-order connected responses govern nonlinear stabilization. Spectral decomposition reveals that relaxation rates and collective-mode overlaps control collective instability and memory dynamics. Enhanced infrared spectral weight lowers the critical coupling and generates long-time memory, revealing a common spectral origin of collective ordering and persistent dynamics. Controlled numerical constructions verify the spectral dependence of collective instability and response, while nonlinear mean-field scaling follows from the microscopic Landau expansion. Transformer Jacobian spectra further reveal learning-induced infrared organization and transient memory enhancement consistent with critical-like response. Our results establish a microscopic framework linking neural interactions, collective order, and long-time memory.
items.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个微观场论，用于描述相互作用非线性神经系统中集体秩序的形成。将微观神经自由度积分掉，得到一个有效作用量，其二次核决定有序化阈值，而高阶连通响应支配非线性稳定化。谱分解揭示，弛豫速率和集体模式重叠控制集体不稳定性和记忆动力学。增强的红外谱权重降低临界耦合，并产生长时间记忆，揭示集体有序和持续动力学具有共同的谱起源。受控数值构造验证了集体不稳定性和响应的谱依赖性，而非线性平均场标度可由微观 Landau 展开得到。Transformer 雅可比谱进一步揭示学习诱导的红外组织和对瞬态记忆的增强，与类临界响应一致。我们的结果建立了一个将神经相互作用、集体秩序和长时间记忆联系起来的微观框架。

items.title_en: Domain advantage in two-dimensional quantum-device design with multi-modal agentic harness
items.title_zh: 多模态智能体执行框架在二维量子器件设计中的领域优势
items.abstract_en: High-quality two-dimensional quantum devices are commonly fabricated from mechanically exfoliated crystals, whose irregular shapes and placement require a lithographic layout tailored to each specimen. Drawing these layouts remains largely manual. We introduce qlaybench, a benchmark that tests whether language-model agents can turn microscope images and experimental requirements into device layouts that fit the specimen. Agents with conventional tools often construct devices when material outlines are supplied, but struggle to identify those outlines from images. Modelled on the human workflow, qlaybot, a multimodal agentic harness, connects image interpretation to the tools used to align images, draw device features and inspect the resulting layout. We evaluate each layout with checks drawn from practical design experience, asking whether it fits the specimen and connects its intended components. With greater computational effort, an agent using qlaybot passes 81.5% of the benchmark tasks, compared with 24.1% when it uses conventional tools. This domain advantage highlights the importance of connecting scientific interpretation of a specimen to geometric design and provides a route towards reducing manual effort in two-dimensional quantum-device fabrication.
items.abstract_zh: 高质量二维量子器件通常由机械剥离晶体制备，其不规则形状和放置位置要求为每个样品定制光刻布局。绘制这些布局在很大程度上仍是手工完成。我们引入 qlaybench，一个基准，用于测试语言模型智能体能否将显微镜图像和实验要求转化为适合样品的器件布局。使用传统工具的智能体在提供材料轮廓时通常能构建设备，但难以从图像中识别这些轮廓。受人类工作流程启发，qlaybot 是一个多模态智能体执行框架，将图像解释与用于对齐图像、绘制器件特征和检查所得布局的工具连接起来。我们使用来自实际设计经验的检查项评估每个布局，询问其是否适合样品并连接其预期组件。在更大的计算投入下，使用 qlaybot 的智能体通过了 81.5% 的基准任务，而使用传统工具时为 24.1%。这一领域优势凸显了将样品的科学解释与几何设计连接起来的重要性，并为减少二维量子器件制造中的手工工作提供了一条途径。

items.title_en: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
items.title_zh: 面向自主通信网络中意图管理与控制的智能体 AI
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. However, existing approaches often focus on intent management and orchestration, leaving the adaptation of underlying network optimization and control functions largely unaddressed. This article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment through three agents: an interpreter, powered by a language model, that translates and refines intents into machine-readable optimization templates; an optimizer that adapts controller policies to intent specifications; and a controller that performs fast decision-making. We discuss the design space of each agent and how the workflow can be embedded across network architectural domains. Finally, we develop a concrete realization combining a language-model interpreter with Bayesian optimization for the optimizer and multi-objective reinforcement learning for the controller, and evaluate it in a radio resource management case study for differentiated connectivity. Results demonstrate how the agentic AI framework can connect high-level intents with runtime network control, showing adaptability of intent specifications and control policies to service requirements and changing network conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）驱动的自动化将帮助未来移动网络将高层网络意图转化为具体的网络优化或控制动作。然而，现有方法通常聚焦于意图管理与编排，基本上未处理底层网络优化与控制功能的适配。本文提出一个三元智能体 AI 框架，通过三个智能体协同设计意图管理与意图履行：一个由语言模型驱动的解释器，将意图翻译并细化为机器可读的优化模板；一个优化器，使控制器策略适配意图规范；以及一个执行快速决策的控制器。我们讨论每个智能体的设计空间，以及该工作流如何嵌入跨网络架构域。最后，我们开发一个具体实现，将语言模型解释器与用于优化器的贝叶斯优化、用于控制器的多目标强化学习相结合，并在面向差异化连接的无线电资源管理案例研究中评估。结果展示了智能体 AI 框架如何将高层意图与运行时网络控制连接起来，表明意图规范和控制策略对服务需求及变化网络条件的适应性。

items.title_en: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
items.title_zh: 什么构成训练编码智能体的优质数据？基于 SWE-Gym 的系统性研究
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在软件任务上训练编码智能体，这些任务的隐藏测试决定奖励，然而任务集合仅用参考修复来检查这些测试。我们追问什么使一个任务成为好的训练数据，重点关注其奖励标签的正确性。我们用两个 LLM 系列审计 SWE-Gym，一个疑似错误只有在执行重现它时才计入。我们发现，未解决往往意味着被错误标注：在 9B 基础模型从未解决的任务中，74% 有一个拒绝正确修复的测试（假阴性），而在它有时解决的任务中这一比例为 20%。我们修复或移除此类任务，剩余经过审计的任务能训练出更好的策略。在相同规模和匹配难度下，在这些任务上训练的模型在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 的留出任务上分别比在原始任务上训练的模型高 2.4 分和 2.7 分，而仅仅丢弃从未解决的任务则没有这种增益。我们进一步发现，通过测试的错误补丁（假阳性）约占所有通过补丁的四分之一，而能捕获其中四分之一的新测试并未以可检测的方式改变留出分数。通过率表明一个任务是否产生奖励，而不是该奖励是否正确，因此奖励标签本身必须被检查。为此，我们发布 SWE-Gym-Verified，包含其 1,087 个经审计任务、每个判定及其执行证据、我们的训练集以及完整审计流水线。

items.title_en: AgentMoT: An Agentic Mixture-of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: AgentMoT：用于端到端自动驾驶的智能体化 Mixture-of-Transformers
items.abstract_en: Driving models need to choose which capabilities to use and when to reconsider their decisions. We introduce AgentMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers with built-in agent reasoning and system scheduling. Combinations of agent, world, and action experts form three jointly trained pathways for direct-action, vision-language-action, and world-action computation. The Router selects a native pathway, while the agent expert supplies reasoning and selects skills. Execution feedback raises wake-up requests, and the agent self-scheduler learns whether to reconsider the task decision or keep it. Mandatory requests invoke the agent directly. The relative-capability principle guides these choices by relating the benefit of additional computation or intervention to its cost. After open-loop initialization, dual-loop evolution trains the Router, agent, and self-scheduler from closed-loop experience while failure-driven updates refine skills and execution feedback. AgentMoT achieves state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive v0.0.3 and v0.0.4, with 94.48/92.33 driving score and 85.45/82.73% success rate, respectively. With skills disabled, learned routing improves over the strongest fixed pathway by 1.79 driving-score points and 4.09 percentage points of success rate on v0.0.3. Ablation studies further show gains from closed-loop agent learning, two-view queries, and event-triggered wake-up.
items.abstract_zh: 驾驶模型需要选择使用哪些能力以及何时重新考虑其决策。我们提出 AgentMoT，一种内置智能体推理和系统调度的 Mixture-of-Transformers。智能体、世界和动作专家的组合形成三条联合训练路径，分别用于直接动作、视觉-语言-动作和世界-动作计算。路由器选择一条原生路径，而智能体专家提供推理并选择技能。执行反馈会发出唤醒请求，智能体自调度器学习是重新考虑任务决策还是保持它。强制请求直接调用智能体。相对能力原则通过将额外计算或干预的收益与其成本相关联来指导这些选择。在开环初始化之后，双环演化从闭环经验中训练路由器、智能体和自调度器，同时故障驱动更新细化技能和执行反馈。AgentMoT 在 Bench2Drive v0.0.3 和 v0.0.4 上取得最先进结果，驾驶分数分别为 94.48/92.33，成功率为 85.45/82.73%。在禁用技能时，学习到的路由在 v0.0.3 上比最强的固定路径提高 1.79 个驾驶分数点和 4.09 个百分点的成功率。消融研究进一步显示闭环智能体学习、双视图查询和事件触发唤醒带来的增益。

items.title_en: AvatarAnyone: Agentic Reconstruction of Mesh-Based Layered Avatars from YouTube Video
items.title_zh: AvatarAnyone：从YouTube视频智能体重建基于网格的分层化身
items.abstract_en: We introduce AvatarAnyone, a method for reconstructing avatars from casual YouTube videos as layered meshes, with each garment and footwear as a separate mesh layered on top of the body mesh. In such videos, people differ in garment classes, clothing types, and layers, and each combination needs a different reconstruction. A single fixed layered reconstruction pipeline therefore fails. AvatarAnyone solves this problem with AI agents that plan a custom optimization for each person's reconstruction. The agents predict the garment classes, the clothing type, and the layering. They use these predictions to choose an initialization and stage the optimization. Because the avatars are layered meshes, they support applications such as virtual try-on and cloth simulation. We change the clothing layers of an avatar and render it in different garments and poses. We can also simulate a clothing layer as cloth over the animated body with a standard cloth simulator. Most existing avatars are one fused surface or a set of Gaussians and cannot do this. We load the avatars directly into Blender, Unreal Engine, and robotics simulators such as MuJoCo. As the avatars are meshes, they support contact modeling with other objects. We show results from around 150 YouTube videos. On four datasets, AvatarAnyone outperforms existing mesh-based methods for animatable monocular reconstruction. Our project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/avataranyone.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出AvatarAnyone，一种从随手拍摄的YouTube视频中重建化身的方法，将其重建为分层网格，每件衣物和鞋类都是叠加在身体网格之上的独立网格。在此类视频中，人们在服装类别、服装类型和层数上各不相同，每种组合都需要不同的重建。因此，单一固定的分层重建流程会失败。AvatarAnyone通过AI智能体解决该问题，这些智能体为每个人的重建规划定制优化。智能体预测服装类别、服装类型和分层。它们利用这些预测选择初始化并分阶段进行优化。由于化身是分层网格，它们支持虚拟试穿和布料仿真等应用。我们更换化身的服装层，并在不同服装和姿态下渲染它。我们还可以使用标准布料模拟器，将服装层作为布料在动画化身体上进行模拟。大多数现有化身是单一融合表面或一组高斯，无法做到这一点。我们将化身直接加载到Blender、Unreal Engine以及MuJoCo等机器人模拟器中。由于化身是网格，它们支持与其他物体的接触建模。我们展示了约150个YouTube视频的结果。在四个数据集上，AvatarAnyone在可动画的单目重建方面优于现有的基于网格的方法。项目页面见https://miraymen.github.io/avataranyone。

items.title_en: One-Step Self-Assembling Lipopolymer Coatings Enable Direct Longitudinal Biosensing in Native Biological Matrices
items.title_zh: 一步自组装脂质聚合物涂层实现天然生物基质中的直接纵向生物传感
items.abstract_en: Sample-driven cross-reactivity remains a fundamental bottleneck for sensitive and selective biosensing in complex biological environments, particularly in microfluidic systems where high surface-to-volumes ratios amplify non-specific interactions. Here, we address this challenge with a one-step, biomimetic surface functionalization strategy based on engineered lipid-based nanocarriers that self-assemble within minutes into immunoassay-ready, antifouling interfaces that couple pegylated-lipid passivation with biorthogonal, site-specific probe conjugation. This approach enables rapid, tuneable, and reproducible surface functionalization, which suppresses sample-specific cross-reactivity even in undiluted serum, and supports direct, label-free digital biosensing assays directly in native biological environments. When integrated into an optofluidic platform combining digital in-line holography and microfluidics, this approach allows time-resolved quantification of tetraspanin-positive extracellular vesicle secretion dynamics from two-dimensional and three-dimensional lung cancer cell models using 50 μL of sample within 10 min, without isolation or purification. Because the presented surface functionalization proceeds via self-assembly rather than covalent surface modification, this one-step modular-approach is intrinsically decoupled from device fabrication and applies to both glass and PDMS, coating the entire microfluidic channel, thereby establishing a general route for integrating biomimetic nanostructures into robust, high-performance immunoassays, advancing biosensing beyond end-point measurements, and towards rapid and continuous real-time monitoring.
items.abstract_zh: 样品驱动的交叉反应性仍是复杂生物环境中灵敏且选择性生物传感的基本瓶颈，尤其是在微流体系统中，高表面积与体积比会放大非特异性相互作用。在此，我们通过一步仿生表面功能化策略应对这一挑战，该策略基于工程化脂质基纳米载体，这些载体在数分钟内自组装成可直接用于免疫测定的防污界面，将聚乙二醇化脂质钝化与生物正交、位点特异性探针偶联相结合。该方法可实现快速、可调且可重复的表面功能化，即使在未稀释血清中也能抑制样品特异性交叉反应，并支持直接在天然生物环境中进行直接、无标记的数字生物传感测定。当集成到结合数字同轴全息与微流体的光流控平台中时，该方法可利用50 μL样品在10分钟内，对二维和三维肺癌细胞模型分泌的四跨膜蛋白阳性细胞外囊泡动态进行时间分辨定量，无需分离或纯化。由于所提出的表面功能化通过自组装而非共价表面修饰进行，这一一步模块化方法本质上与器件制造解耦，并适用于玻璃和PDMS，涂覆整个微流体通道，从而为将仿生纳米结构集成到稳健、高性能免疫测定中建立通用途径，推动生物传感超越终点测量，迈向快速连续实时监测。

items.title_en: Non unitary and nonlinear quantum generative large model design and fast large-scale training without back propagation
items.title_zh: 非酉与非线性量子生成大模型设计及无需反向传播的快速大规模训练
items.abstract_en: Transformer-based large models require huge computational and storage costs. Quantum computation is expected to address that due to its potential to speed up classical algorithms exponentially. Key challenges of implementing quantum large models include the linear, unitary nature of qubit evolutions contrast with the non-unitary matrices and nonlinear functions in classical Transformers, as well as the difficulty of implementing gradient back-propagation on quantum hardware. Here we propose a fully quantum large model containing all the Transformer layers, implementing the non-unitary transformations through SVD-decomposition-based quantum circuits, and approximated nonlinear activation functions through pre-trained parameterized quantum circuits. We also propose a quantum circuit training algorithm based on multi-agent Reinforcement Learning, which can train large-scale parameterized quantum circuits without back-propagation. The dependency between the inference time complexity and the model's hidden dimension has been reduced from polynomial to logarithmic, showing an exponential advantage. The inference executions on the quantum hardware verify our model's 300-1000 times speed-up, and the measurements on the sequence-to-sequence tasks shows its learning ability. The training algorithm achieves only 25% complexity of the best SOTA quantum circuit training algorithms, especially this ratio decreases fast as the parameter scale increases. Our work not only proposes a quantum large model that can significantly reduce the computational cost, but also promotes the quantum computation towards general computing.
items.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的大模型需要巨大的计算和存储成本。量子计算有望通过指数级加速经典算法的潜力来解决这一问题。实现量子大模型的关键挑战包括：量子比特演化的线性、酉性质与经典Transformer中的非酉矩阵和非线性函数形成对比，以及在量子硬件上实现梯度反向传播的困难。在此，我们提出一种包含所有Transformer层的全量子大模型，通过基于SVD分解的量子电路实现非酉变换，并通过预训练的参数化量子电路近似非线性激活函数。我们还提出一种基于多智能体强化学习的量子电路训练算法，可在无需反向传播的情况下训练大规模参数化量子电路。推理时间复杂度与模型隐藏维度之间的依赖关系已从多项式降低到对数，显示出指数优势。在量子硬件上的推理执行验证了我们的模型具有300–1000倍加速，序列到序列任务上的测量显示了其学习能力。该训练算法仅达到最佳SOTA量子电路训练算法复杂度的25%，尤其随着参数规模增加，该比例快速下降。我们的工作不仅提出了一种可显著降低计算成本的量子大模型，也推动了量子计算向通用计算发展。

items.title_en: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
items.title_zh: RoFE：面向低数据多模态表格学习的旋转冻结嵌入
items.abstract_en: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态表格学习将表格数据与图像和文本相结合，通常处于标注数据稀缺的场景中。表格基础模型，如先验数据拟合网络（PFN），通过上下文学习无需任务特定训练即可提供有前景的解决方案。然而，现代图像和文本编码器产生的嵌入具有数百或数千个维度，远超PFN预训练期间所遇到的特征数量。现有方法使用主成分分析（PCA）压缩冻结嵌入来弥合这一差距。令人惊讶的是，我们发现当标注样本稀缺时，这种PCA接口可能不如简单线性分类器，尽管PFN是为小数据集设计的。我们识别出潜在的失效机制：PFN的逐列标准化会去除PCA得分的方差。当PCA保留标注样本的每个方向时，这些样本会坍缩为一个正单纯形，其中所有成对距离相等。为解决该问题，我们提出旋转冻结嵌入（RoFE），一种在PFN推理前旋转PCA得分的免训练方法。我们从理论上证明，旋转使列方差几乎相等，从而使标准化近似保留嵌入几何。在图像和文本分类任务、编码器以及表格基础模型上，RoFE相比PCA接口提升了低数据性能，并优于需要任务特定训练的基线。该改进也扩展到回归。

items.title_en: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
items.title_zh: CO-GRAFT：通过角色级策略嫁接归因搜索智能体中的强化学习增益
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）可将大语言模型搜索智能体相对于其RL前初始化提升最多32个精确匹配（EM）点，但总体准确率增益并不能识别训练期间哪些底层功能能力得到改善或发生交互。我们提出CO-GRAFT，一种与奖励无关的干预式归因框架，其中经RL训练的智能体及其RL前初始化在带实时检索的闭环执行下共同生成单条轨迹。每个策略控制四个功能角色中互斥的子集：中间推理、搜索或回答决策、搜索查询生成以及最终答案抽取。在不修改权重或重新训练的情况下评估所有2^4=16种角色分配，定义一个合作博弈，其Shapley值将总RL增益分解到各角色，而Möbius交互项区分独立角色改进与多角色耦合。将CO-GRAFT应用于跨Qwen2.5和Llama-3.2模型（涵盖两种规模、基础与指令微调初始化、GRPO和PPO优化器以及NQ和HotpotQA数据集）的Search-R1智能体，我们表明查询生成从未超过总增益的15%；相反，增益由RL前答案有效性、搜索保留、模型规模以及固定任务级搜索预算主导，在更大或格式良好的答案响应检查点中将信用从推理转向答案抽取，而较小的基础模型依赖推理—决策耦合。

items.title_en: Confidently Lost: Silent Failure and Edge Deployment of Dense Visual SLAM under Photon Starvation
items.title_zh: 自信地迷失：光子饥饿条件下稠密视觉SLAM的静默失效与边缘部署
items.abstract_en: Dense visual SLAM built on learned two-view geometry is evaluated in good light; in low light it fails silently. Two frames of 9-level quantized noise, no scene at all, give MASt3R-SLAM's network a cross-view geometric self-consistency of 0.936; a real dark frame pair gives 0.935. Starved of structure, the network invents the same geometry for both views and the system trusts the agreement: on a dark sequence it consumes 1,605 frames, emits 7 keyframes, rejects no factor-graph edges and reports full frame rate, while over 95% of the correspondences it accepts violate the ground-truth epipolar geometry. One inflated statistic is read by two subsystems against thresholds in opposite directions, so keyframing starves while relocalization accepts almost every candidate. The same statistic, read at keyframe-pair baselines, separates the confident collapse from working runs on the ETH3D dark sequences without ground truth or extra computation (in-sample). Low-light-adapted weights take tracked trajectories from 1/6 to 5/6, as does retuning two thresholds; neither yields accurate ones, because the adaptation withdraws confidence from wrong geometry rather than finding right geometry. Replayed on a Jetson AGX Orin carried by a legged robot, the mechanism's signature reproduces on the two darkest of four routes, and which of its faces appears varies with route geometry and sensor encoding. The network does not lose confidence in the dark; it manufactures it.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习得到的双视图几何构建的稠密视觉SLAM是在良好光照下评估的；在低光下，它会静默失效。两帧9级量化噪声、完全没有场景，使MASt3R-SLAM的网络获得0.936的跨视图几何自一致性；一对真实暗帧给出0.935。在缺乏结构时，网络为两个视图虚构相同的几何，而系统信任这种一致性：在一段暗序列上，它处理1,605帧，输出7个关键帧，不拒绝任何因子图边，并报告满帧率，而其接受的对应关系中超过95%违反真值对极几何。一个被夸大的统计量被两个子系统以相反方向对照阈值读取，因此关键帧化陷入饥饿，而重定位几乎接受每个候选。同一统计量在关键帧对基线上读取时，可在无真值或额外计算（样本内）的情况下，将自信崩溃与正常工作运行在ETH3D暗序列上区分开。低光适配权重将跟踪轨迹从1/6提升到5/6，重新调整两个阈值也有同样效果；两者都不能得到准确轨迹，因为该适配是从错误几何中撤回置信度，而不是找到正确几何。在由腿式机器人携带的Jetson AGX Orin上重放时，该机制的特征在四条路线中最暗的两条上复现，且其呈现的哪个侧面随路线几何和传感器编码而变化。网络在黑暗中并未失去置信度；它制造了置信度。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: DriveDreamer-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Driving Perception and Agentic Data Generation
items.title_zh: DriveDreamer-RSI：驾驶感知与智能体数据生成的递归自我改进
items.abstract_en: Controllable generation can expand training data for driving perception, but visual realism alone does not ensure learning gains. Effective generation must adapt both what data to generate and how to construct them as the perception model evolves. In this paper, we present DriveDreamer-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement of driving perception and agentic data generation through feedback between perception learning and data construction. Its outer loop implements Gap-Guided Target Adaptation, generating labeled videos from current perception gaps and updating targets after training. Its inner loop uses a vision-language agent to iteratively edit scenes through observation and execution feedback. Across rounds, Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement derives reusable construction advice from execution experience and downstream learning outcomes. On the nuScenes validation set, DriveDreamer-RSI surpasses the dataset-replay baseline by 4.09 mAP and 4.13 NDS points using approximately half the synthetic frames.
items.abstract_zh: 可控生成可以扩充驾驶感知的训练数据，但仅凭视觉真实感并不能保证学习收益。有效的生成必须随着感知模型的演化，同时调整生成什么数据以及如何构建这些数据。本文提出 DriveDreamer-RSI，一个通过感知学习与数据构建之间反馈来实现驾驶感知和智能体数据生成递归自我改进的框架。其外循环实现 Gap-Guided Target Adaptation（差距引导的目标自适应），根据当前感知差距生成带标注视频，并在训练后更新目标。其内循环使用视觉-语言智能体，通过观察和执行反馈迭代编辑场景。跨轮次中，Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement（学习反馈驱动的策略细化）从执行经验和下游学习结果中提炼可复用的构建建议。在 nuScenes 验证集上，DriveDreamer-RSI 在使用约一半合成帧的情况下，比数据集回放基线高出 4.09 mAP 和 4.13 NDS 点。

items.title_en: Learning effective stochastic predator and prey dynamics across physical and biological systems from limited data
items.title_zh: 从有限数据中学习跨物理与生物系统的有效随机捕食者-猎物动力学
items.abstract_en: Constructing an effective low-dimensional stochastic model from sparse observations requires separating deterministic drift from state-dependent fluctuations when the governing interaction law is unknown. We formulate an adaptive neural stochastic differential equation with topology constraints (TC-AdaNSDE) for two-variable predator--prey dynamics. To regularize the inverse problem when data are scarce, the model combines flexible drift and correlated diffusion fields with density-adaptive local Kramers--Moyal moment estimates and soft phase-space constraints reflecting boundary saddle behavior near extinction and local stability near coexistence. Using a known nonlinear stochastic system, we first show that short-time trajectory error cannot assess diffusion accuracy on its own and must be paired with distributional measures of one-step transitions and long-time phase-space occupancy. We then apply this framework to macroscopic turbulence and zonal flow energies reduced from Hasegawa--Wakatani plasma simulations and to short ecological time series. In the sparse-data regime, TC-AdaNSDE reproduces both short-horizon evolution and long-time invariant energy distributions where deterministic reductions collapse and unconstrained stochastic fits diverge, while recovering physically interpretable drift and fluctuation fields across both physical and biological systems.
items.abstract_zh: 在支配性相互作用规律未知时，从稀疏观测中构建有效的低维随机模型需要将确定性漂移与状态依赖涨落分离。我们针对二变量捕食者-猎物动力学，提出一种带拓扑约束的自适应神经随机微分方程（TC-AdaNSDE）。为在数据稀缺时对反问题进行正则化，该模型将灵活的漂移场和相关扩散场与密度自适应的局部 Kramers--Moyal 矩估计以及软相空间约束相结合，这些约束反映灭绝附近的边界鞍行为和共存附近的局部稳定性。利用一个已知的非线性随机系统，我们首先表明，短时轨迹误差本身不能评估扩散精度，必须与一步转移的分布度量和长时相空间占据度量配合使用。随后，我们将该框架应用于从 Hasegawa--Wakatani 等离子体模拟约化得到的宏观湍流和纬向流能量，以及短生态时间序列。在稀疏数据情形下，TC-AdaNSDE 能够再现短时程演化和长时不变能量分布，而确定性约化会失效、无约束随机拟合会发散；同时，它在物理和生物系统中都能恢复具有物理可解释性的漂移场和涨落场。

items.title_en: On-demand frequency-entangled microwave biphotons from a transmon-resonator dimer
items.title_zh: 基于 transmon-谐振器二聚体的按需频率纠缠微波双光子
items.abstract_en: We propose a superconducting circuit QED source of on-demand frequency-entangled microwave photon pairs, with one photon emitted into each of two separate waveguides, enabling individual manipulation. The design is based on a transmon-resonator dimer, which consists of two transmon-resonator subsystems coupled through a cross-Kerr interaction. We outline a viable circuit-QED realization in which the required cross-Kerr interaction is implemented using Josephson-junction couplers. To analyze the emission dynamics, we derive and numerically solve the set of evolution equations that enable tracking the evolution of the joint spectral intensity of photons. We characterize the resulting photon-number correlations, frequency anticorrelation, and spectral entanglement. By varying the coupling strengths, we obtain biphotons with distinct joint spectral intensities and Schmidt spectra, ranging from broadly distributed multimode entanglement to states dominated by two nearly equally weighted Schmidt contributions. In the latter regime, optimizing the transmon-resonator coupling and detuning yields an output biphoton state that has fidelity $F \approx 0.956$ with a two-dimensional maximally entangled state. Restricting the local target modes to separated frequency bins yields a fidelity $F_\mathrm{bin} \approx 0.949$, indicating that the output state closely approximates a frequency-bin Bell pair. Thus, the proposed microwave biphoton source provides a route toward distributing frequency-encoded quantum resources between remote superconducting nodes.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种超导电路 QED 的按需频率纠缠微波光子对源，其中每个光子分别发射到两个独立波导之一，从而可对单个光子进行操控。该设计基于 transmon-谐振器二聚体，它由两个通过交叉 Kerr 相互作用耦合的 transmon-谐振器子系统组成。我们概述了一种可行的电路 QED 实现方案，其中所需的交叉 Kerr 相互作用由约瑟夫森结耦合器实现。为分析发射动力学，我们推导并数值求解了一组演化方程，这些方程能够追踪光子联合谱强度的演化。我们表征了所得的光子数关联、频率反关联和谱纠缠。通过改变耦合强度，我们获得了具有不同联合谱强度和 Schmidt 谱的双光子，其范围从广泛分布的多模纠缠到由两个几乎等权 Schmidt 贡献主导的状态。在后一情形下，优化 transmon-谐振器耦合和失谐可得到输出双光子态，其与二维最大纠缠态的保真度为 $F \approx 0.956$。将局部目标模限制到分离的频段，可得到保真度 $F_\mathrm{bin} \approx 0.949$，表明输出态非常接近频率 bin 贝尔对。因此，所提出的微波双光子源为在远程超导节点之间分发频率编码量子资源提供了一条途径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Schism: Reconfigurable Scale-Up Domains for Distributed Quantum Computing
items.title_zh: Schism：面向分布式量子计算的可重构扩展域
items.abstract_en: Switch-based quantum datacenters connect quantum processing units (QPUs) through photonic switches and shared Bell-state measurement (BSM) devices. Sharing BSMs saves hardware, but fixed connectivity constrains access to these resources. Local communication can overload one rack's BSMs while others remain idle; reaching those idle resources incurs additional optical loss and retries through switches and quantum frequency converters (QFCs). Programs remain locked into this locality-contention tradeoff as their communication patterns change. We propose Schism, an architecture that lets programs dynamically change which QPUs share each BSM pool. Schism places BSM pools at aggregation switches and QFCs on their core-facing uplinks. Top-of-rack switches establish reconfigurable native-wavelength circuits from QPUs to these pools, forming scale-up domains bounded by the optical loss budget. Reconfiguration reshapes resource sharing across racks without moving QPUs or migrating quantum states. Our key insight is that QPU grouping jointly determines photon-path loss and contention for BSM resources: locality alone cannot identify the best grouping, and a grouping pays off only if its savings outweigh the delay of reconfiguring to it. We develop an optimization framework that combines graph partitioning with resource-constrained completion-time estimates and dynamic programming to select how QPUs share BSM pools and when those groupings reconfigure, between or within circuit phases. Our evaluation using SeQUeNCe with trapped-ion parameters shows that Schism achieves communication speedups of 4.9-7.3x across 11 workloads on 32 QPUs compared to Fixed Clos connectivity and 3.6-8.3x compared to SwitchQNet. Schism also outperforms a hypothetical network-wide switch by 1.35-1.38x on the eight workloads whose phases fit in a pool, and trails it by 1.1-1.75x on the other three.
items.abstract_zh: 基于交换机的量子数据中心通过光子交换机和共享贝尔态测量（BSM）设备连接量子处理单元（QPU）。共享 BSM 可节省硬件，但固定连通性限制了对这些资源的访问。局部通信可能使一个机架的 BSM 过载，而其他机架的 BSM 空闲；访问那些空闲资源会带来额外光损耗，并需要通过交换机和量子频率转换器（QFC）进行重试。随着程序通信模式变化，程序仍被锁定在这种局部性-争用权衡中。我们提出 Schism，一种允许程序动态改变哪些 QPU 共享每个 BSM 池的架构。Schism 将 BSM 池放置在聚合交换机上，并将 QFC 放置在其面向核心的上行链路上。架顶交换机建立从 QPU 到这些池的可重构原生波长电路，形成受光损耗预算约束的扩展域。重配置可在不移动 QPU 或迁移量子态的情况下重塑跨机架的资源共享。我们的关键见解是，QPU 分组共同决定光子路径损耗和对 BSM 资源的争用：仅凭局部性无法确定最佳分组，并且只有当分组的收益超过重配置到该分组的延迟时，该分组才值得采用。我们开发了一个优化框架，将图划分与资源约束的完成时间估计以及动态规划相结合，以选择 QPU 如何共享 BSM 池，以及这些分组在电路阶段之间或阶段内何时重配置。我们使用 SeQUeNCe 和囚禁离子参数进行的评估表明，在 32 个 QPU 上的 11 个工作负载中，与 Fixed Clos 连通性相比，Schism 实现 4.9-7.3 倍通信加速；与 SwitchQNet 相比实现 3.6-8.3 倍加速。对于阶段可放入一个池的八个工作负载，Schism 还比一个假想的全网交换机快 1.35-1.38 倍；在另外三个工作负载上则慢 1.1-1.75 倍。

items.title_en: TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: TAP：扩散语言模型的策略接口
items.abstract_en: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. Causal clamp and slot-injection tests show that dedicated policy slots can influence body denoising through feedback, especially at 8B scale. Safety-refusal experiments further show that TAP-DiLM supports competitive typed refusal behavior when trained with diverse unsafe prompts.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型对掩码画布进行去噪，这使其成为回答、等待、澄清或拒绝等选择性生成决策的自然场景。我们提出 TAP-DiLM，在掩码扩散语言模型中添加类型化策略变量，并研究该策略应如何附加到去噪过程。在 BERT-base、MDLMOWT、LLaDA-8B 和 Dream-7B 上，我们比较了共享词表槽位、专用槽位头和基于 CLS 的外部头。结果揭示了明显的接口-骨干交互：专用头在不同规模下提供稳健的策略学习，而共享词表头在 LM 头几何有利时能够有效。一个简单的 LM 头锐度探针可预测共享头策略内化何时可靠，为接口选择提供了实用诊断。因果钳制和槽位注入测试表明，专用策略槽位可通过反馈影响主体去噪，尤其在 8B 规模下。安全拒绝实验进一步表明，当使用多样化不安全提示训练时，TAP-DiLM 支持有竞争力的类型化拒绝行为。

items.title_en: Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
items.title_zh: 部分可观测性下强化学习的粒子信念表示
items.abstract_en: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.
items.abstract_zh: 粒子滤波器能够灵活表示复杂的多模态信念，但将其表示为加权、无序集合，这与传统固定维策略不兼容。我们在保持信念估计和策略优化固定的情况下，研究将粒子信念编码作为强化学习策略输入。我们比较了统计摘要、累积量生成函数（CGF）特征和置换不变集合编码器。可训练编码器可以端到端学习，或通过信念重建或任务特定预测进行预训练。在八个任务上，基于池化的集合编码器和梯度 CGF 特征在端到端设置下表现可靠，而 Set Transformer 在适当预训练下取得最高性能。当任务特定预训练的目标捕捉到与决策相关的信念结构时，它会有帮助；而重建预训练和潜在对齐提供的收益更具选择性。对于在部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程中选择和训练粒子信念编码器，我们的结果表明，一个能很好地重建信念的编码不一定适合作为控制的输入。

items.title_en: GSDet: Gaussian Splatting for Oriented Object Detection
items.title_zh: GSDet：面向有向目标检测的高斯泼溅
items.abstract_en: Oriented object detection has advanced with the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers. However, modern detectors still rely on predefined object candidates, such as anchors in CNN-based methods or queries in transformer-based methods, which struggle to capture spatial information effectively. To address the limitations, we propose GSDet, a novel framework that formulates oriented object detection as Gaussian splatting. Specifically, our approach performs detection within a 3D feature space constructed from image features, where 3D Gaussians are employed to represent oriented objects. These 3D Gaussians are projected onto the image plane to form 2D Gaussians, which are then transformed into oriented boxes. Furthermore, we optimize the mean, anisotropic covariance, and confidence scores of these randomly initialized 3D Gaussians, using a decoder that incorporates 3D Gaussian sampling. Moreover, our method exhibits flexibility, enabling adaptive control and a dynamic number of Gaussians during inference. Experiments on 3 datasets indicate that GSDet achieves AP$_{50}$ gains of 0.7\% on DIOR-R, 0.3\% on DOTA-v1.0, and 0.55\% on DOTA-v1.5 when evaluated with adaptive control and outperforms mainstream detectors.
items.abstract_zh: 有向目标检测随着卷积神经网络（CNN）和Transformer的发展而进步。然而，现代检测器仍然依赖预定义的目标候选，例如基于CNN方法中的锚框或基于Transformer方法中的查询，这些候选难以有效捕获空间信息。为解决这些局限，我们提出GSDet，一种将定向目标检测表述为高斯泼溅的新框架。具体而言，我们的方法在由图像特征构建的3D特征空间内执行检测，其中使用3D高斯表示有向目标。这些3D高斯被投影到图像平面以形成2D高斯，随后被转换为有向框。此外，我们使用包含3D高斯采样的解码器，优化这些随机初始化的3D高斯的均值、各向异性协方差和置信度分数。而且，我们的方法具有灵活性，能够在推理期间实现自适应控制和动态数量的高斯。在3个数据集上的实验表明，当采用自适应控制评估时，GSDet在DIOR-R上获得0.7%的AP$_{50}$增益，在DOTA-v1.0上获得0.3%的增益，在DOTA-v1.5上获得0.55%的增益，并优于主流检测器。

items.title_en: The neural basis of unfamiliar face recognition in humans with fMRI frequency-tagging
items.title_zh: 使用fMRI频率标记的人类陌生面孔识别的神经基础
items.abstract_en: Faces provide the most diagnostic information for identifying individuals in humans. Understanding the neural mechanisms involved in face identity recognition (FIR) is particularly important for unfamiliar faces, for which identity cannot rely on encoded multimodal semantic associations. Here, we investigated the neural basis of FIR using an original frequency-tagging fMRI approach providing objective, sensitive, and reliable measures of face recognition. Ten human participants were presented within a rapid 6 Hz stream of natural images of a single unfamiliar identity in two conditions: (1) with the same face image across low-level changes (size, luminance, contrast) only, or (2) with images varying in background, size, head orientation, gaze direction, etc. Every 9 s during a 243 s run, seven images of different unfamiliar identities were introduced in bursts. For each participant and each condition, we recorded runs with upright and inverted faces. Analyses were performed within face-selective regions (defined from a frequency-tagging localizer) and in the Fourier domain, where individual face discrimination responses were objectively identified and quantified at the identity-change frequency (0.111 Hz). We observed robust image-based individual face discrimination responses across both conditions in core face-selective ventral regions (LatMidFG and IOG). In contrast, responses in early visual cortex and the pSTS were negligible in our second condition, which required generalization across viewpoint variations. In addition, the LatMidFG showed a reliable inversion effect, confirming that the observed responses cannot be attributed solely to low-level image differences. Overall, these findings highlight the value of fMRI frequency-tagging for objectively characterizing the cortical network underlying unfamiliar FIR, providing evidence for high-level discrimination and generalization of unfamiliar face identity in the human ventral occipito-temporal face-selective network.
items.abstract_zh: 面孔为人类识别个体提供了最具诊断性的信息。理解面孔身份识别（FIR）所涉及的神经机制对于陌生面孔尤为重要，因为陌生面孔的身份不能依赖已编码的多模态语义关联。在此，我们使用一种原创的频率标记fMRI方法研究FIR的神经基础，该方法提供客观、灵敏且可靠的面孔识别测量。十名人类参与者在快速6 Hz的自然图像流中观看单一陌生身份的图像，分为两种条件：（1）仅存在低层变化（大小、亮度、对比度）而面孔图像相同；或（2）图像在背景、大小、头部朝向、注视方向等方面变化。在243 s的运行中，每9 s以脉冲形式引入七张不同陌生身份的图像。对于每名参与者和每种条件，我们记录了正立和倒置面孔的运行。分析在面孔选择区（由频率标记定位器定义）内以及傅里叶域中进行，在身份变化频率（0.111 Hz）处客观识别并量化个体面孔辨别反应。我们在核心面孔选择性腹侧区域（LatMidFG和IOG）中观察到两种条件下均存在稳健的基于图像的个体面孔辨别反应。相比之下，在需要跨视角变化泛化的第二种条件下，早期视觉皮层和pSTS中的反应可忽略不计。此外，LatMidFG显示出可靠的倒置效应，证实观察到的反应不能仅归因于低层图像差异。总体而言，这些发现凸显了fMRI频率标记在客观刻画陌生FIR背后的皮层网络方面的价值，为人类腹侧枕颞面孔选择网络中陌生面孔身份的高层辨别与泛化提供了证据。

items.title_en: A single-photon quantum sensor via single-atom cavity-QED
items.title_zh: 基于单原子腔QED的单光子量子传感器
items.abstract_en: We describe a cavity-QED sensor using an optical probe with exactly one photon per pulse. This has a better sensitivity than a coherent pulse with the same average power when no global coherent phase reference is available. The sensor measurement is based on the estimation of the Raman-controlled absorption probability of a single-photon pulse. We use the Fock state master equation to determine the dynamics and performance of the Raman-controlled absorption of a single photon pulse and optimise the sensitivity using machine learning. Two examples are presented; (1) the target parameter is the detuning of the two-level system itself, and (2) the target parameters describe a remote reflecting cavity. In the second case, the scheme does not require a shared coherent phase reference.
items.abstract_zh: 我们描述了一种腔QED传感器，其光学探针每个脉冲恰好包含一个光子。在没有全局相干相位参考时，与相同平均功率的相干脉冲相比，它具有更好的灵敏度。该传感器测量基于对单光子脉冲的拉曼控制吸收概率的估计。我们使用Fock态主方程确定单光子脉冲拉曼控制吸收的动力学和性能，并使用机器学习优化灵敏度。给出了两个例子：（1）目标参数是二能级系统本身的失谐；（2）目标参数描述一个远程反射腔。在第二种情况下，该方案不需要共享的相干相位参考。

items.title_en: AdaptRouter: Adaptive Routing across Evolving Tasks and Models
items.title_zh: AdaptRouter：跨演化任务与模型的自适应路由
items.abstract_en: Model routing assigns each query to a suitable foundation model, but tasks and available models keep changing, and existing routers are either untrained for the pool at hand or fit once and forget earlier tasks when updated. We present AdaptRouter, an adaptive router trained by policy learning: a compact multimodal decision model reads each question with cards describing the current experts and learns from native task feedback, without routing labels, to select one frozen expert. Open-weight and API experts share the router, its inputs, and the quality-cost trade-off but use different losses: cheap open-weight experts are explored with RL, whereas paid API experts are queried once and their cached feedback is reused as soft labels. New tasks are learned without replay, new experts enter as cards, and an open-weight quality-first advantage provably keeps cost from overriding quality. Across four task stages, AdaptRouter loses at most 0.4 points on earlier tasks, whereas feedback-trained routers lose up to 7.0, and as its pool grows from three to ten experts, its accuracy rises from 67.2% to 72.1%. On five API models, it exceeds GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra (low) by over 22 points at under a third of their cost.
items.abstract_zh: 模型路由将每个查询分配给合适的基础模型，但任务和可用模型不断变化，现有路由器要么未针对当前模型池训练，要么在更新时只拟合一次并遗忘早期任务。我们提出AdaptRouter，一种通过策略学习训练的自适应路由器：一个紧凑的多模态决策模型读取每个问题以及描述当前专家的卡片，并从原生任务反馈中学习，无需路由标签，以选择一个冻结的专家。开放权重专家和API专家共享路由器、其输入以及质量-成本权衡，但使用不同的损失：廉价的开放权重专家通过强化学习（RL）进行探索，而付费API专家仅查询一次，其缓存反馈被重用为软标签。新任务在无回放的情况下学习，新专家以卡片形式进入，并且开放权重质量优先优势可证明能防止成本压过质量。在四个任务阶段中，AdaptRouter在早期任务上最多损失0.4分，而反馈训练的路由器最多损失7.0分；当其模型池从三个专家增长到十个专家时，其准确率从67.2%上升到72.1%。在五个API模型上，它以不到其三分之一成本超过GPT-6.1 Sol和GPT-6 Astra (low) 22分以上。

items.title_en: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
items.title_zh: 推理何时有助于实体消歧？域内和分布偏移下的小型LLM
items.abstract_en: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction. Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance. Notably, reasoning LLMs have been shown to perform entity disambiguation in a true zero-shot fashion, generalizing across knowledge bases and domains. However, it is unclear whether this capability survives, or remains competitive, with smaller LLMs, where entity disambiguation has typically relied on reranking rather than reasoning. We ask when reasoning is worth its cost at small scale. We compare pointwise, listwise, and reasoning-based candidate-selection components within a classical coarse-to-fine entity disambiguation pipeline, across the classical, few-shot and true zero-shot settings. The reasoning paradigm is trained with distillation and reinforcement learning recipes. The benefit of reasoning grows with domain shift: negligible in-domain, decisive in the true zero-shot setting. We show that two distinct factors are at work: the reranker's uncertainty over the candidates locates where the paradigms disagree, while shift governs which is right when they do.
items.abstract_zh: 实体消歧（将文本中的歧义提及映射到知识库中的实体）是知识图谱构建、问答和信息抽取等任务中的基础步骤。近期工作已将LLM应用于该问题，并取得了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，推理LLM已被证明能够以真正的零样本方式执行实体消歧，并在知识库和领域之间泛化。然而，尚不清楚在通常依赖重排序而非推理的小型LLM中，这种能力是否仍然存在或保持竞争力。我们探究在小规模下推理何时值得其成本。我们在经典由粗到细的实体消歧流水线中，比较逐点、列表式和基于推理的候选选择组件，涵盖经典、少样本和真正零样本设置。推理范式通过蒸馏和强化学习方案训练。推理的收益随领域偏移而增长：域内可忽略，在真正零样本设置中具有决定性。我们表明有两个不同因素在起作用：重排序器对候选的不确定性定位了范式在何处不一致，而偏移决定了当它们不一致时哪个是正确的。

items.title_en: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 从大型语言模型起草的角色类型化信号时序逻辑规范生成安全关键驾驶场景
items.abstract_en: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. A compiler derives the optimization: it edits a diffusion model's samples by the smallest change that satisfies the specification, each clause moves only its owner, the attacker is solved against the unreacted vehicle under test before its response, and the monitor of the same specification decides acceptance. On nuScenes and CommonRoad, judged independently of the specification, one parameter set produced valid scenarios at a rate 0.14 above a weighted objective tuned per scenario type, and descriptions yielded at least one valid scenario for 11 of the 16 pre-crash types expressible in the public data. Learned planners fail more often on the generated scenarios than on their seeds. Fine-tuning on them lowers a planner's failure rate on critical scenarios, and the time headway one clause of the label requires, not the generator, sets the size of the gain.
items.abstract_zh: 安全关键场景在记录驾驶中很少见，必须生成这些场景以测试和训练自动驾驶车辆的运动规划器。在引导扩散模型中，每种场景类型需要自己的加权目标，并与有效性检查分开。与攻击者一起优化时，被测车辆可以取消攻击或将其吸引到自身。我们将每种场景表述为信号时序逻辑规范，其子句按角色类型化。每个子句指定它可以改变的智能体以及它可以读取的智能体，并且被测车辆仅从攻击开始时刻读取攻击者。大型语言模型根据描述起草规范，类型检查器接受该规范。编译器推导优化：它通过满足规范的最小更改来编辑扩散模型的样本，每个子句只移动其所有者，攻击者在被测车辆响应之前针对未反应的被测车辆求解，同一规范的监视器决定接受。在nuScenes和CommonRoad上，独立于规范进行评判，一组参数产生的有效场景率比按场景类型调优的加权目标高0.14，并且描述为公共数据中可表达的16种碰撞前类型中的11种至少产生了一个有效场景。学习到的规划器在生成场景上比在其种子上更频繁地失败。在这些场景上微调会降低规划器在关键场景上的失败率，而标签中一个子句所需的时间车头时距（而非生成器）决定了增益的大小。

items.title_en: AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection
items.title_zh: AdvMTO：面向基于BEV的3D目标检测的、经由2D高斯泼溅的多模态与时间对抗目标攻击
items.abstract_en: Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector's accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.
items.abstract_zh: 对抗目标攻击对自动驾驶中基于BEV的3D目标检测器构成威胁。现有攻击通常针对单一模态，在当前时间戳协调相机与LiDAR观测，或主要在相机流中建模时间持续性。若无当前与历史观测的统一构建，攻击可能使检测器累积证据的一部分未被抑制，从而限制其有效性。本文提出AdvMTO，一个用于抑制持续性对抗目标检测的2D高斯泼溅（2DGS）框架。其有向面元在一个目标状态中编码外观、几何与不透明度，并由此生成相机图像和扫描线LiDAR回波。随后AdvMTO通过检测器原生处理构建当前与历史输入，针对融合检测器在每个原生源扫描中重新生成LiDAR回波。我们为每个检测器优化有界外观扰动，并通过历史BEV记忆为时间相机检测器传播梯度。对于融合检测器，沿局部法线的有界几何细化进一步扰动两种传感模态。在nuScenes上的实验证明，在三种BEV检测器上有效抑制交通锥检测。时间消融进一步凸显了检测器原生历史建模对攻击构建与优化的重要性。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: From Growth Inhibition to Fluctuations: Testing an Ising Model of Bacterial Responses to Antibiotics
items.title_zh: 从生长抑制到涨落：检验细菌对抗生素响应的Ising模型
items.abstract_en: Complex networks of biochemical reactions have been proposed to exhibit emergent cooperativity that can be described by an effective Ising model, with a small number of parameters encoding collective interactions. Here this mapping is experimentally tested using the response of three bacterial species to a range of antibiotics acting on different cellular targets. The Ising description is compared to the conventional Hill model, examining both the mean growth-rate response and, importantly, its population growth-rate heterogeneity (PGRH). While both models describe the mean growth-rate dependence on antibiotic concentration comparably well, we find that the Ising model provides a markedly better description of PGRH, offering an additional and more stringent test of the collective description. The fitted Ising interaction strength is systematically related to the Hill exponent and increases with the functional distance of the antibiotic target from the protein-production machinery. These results provide experimental support for describing complex biochemical reaction networks through effective cooperative Ising interactions, and suggest that the collective response of bacterial growth to antibiotics reflects the organization of the underlying metabolic network.
items.abstract_zh: 已提出，复杂的生化反应网络可表现出可由有效Ising模型描述的新兴协同性，用少量参数编码集体相互作用。本文利用三种细菌物种对作用于不同细胞靶点的一系列抗生素的响应，对该映射进行实验检验。将Ising描述与常规Hill模型进行比较，考察平均生长速率响应，以及重要的一点——其种群生长速率异质性（PGRH）。虽然两种模型对平均生长速率随抗生素浓度变化的依赖关系描述得相当好，但我们发现Ising模型对PGRH的描述明显更好，为集体描述提供了额外且更严格的检验。拟合的Ising相互作用强度与Hill指数系统性相关，并随抗生素靶点与蛋白质生产机器之间的功能距离增大而增大。这些结果为通过有效协同Ising相互作用描述复杂生化反应网络提供了实验支持，并表明细菌生长对抗生素的集体响应反映了底层代谢网络的组织。

items.title_en: Turbulence Strength Estimation from Multiplexed Orbital Angular Momentum Beams Using Multimode Fibre Speckle
items.title_zh: 利用多模光纤散斑从复用轨道角动量光束估计湍流强度
items.abstract_en: The strength of atmospheric turbulence governs how much the modes of a free-space optical link mix together. It is usually measured with a separate instrument or with a Gaussian probe beam, neither of which uses the beams that a structured-light link already carries. Here we show that the turbulence strength, expressed as the Fried parameter, can be estimated directly from multiplexed orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams without knowing which modes are present. The beams pass through a passive multimode fibre that turns them into speckle on a camera, and a trained weighted sum of the camera pixels (known as an extreme learning machine), averaged over a few tens of frames, gives the Fried parameter. In the laboratory with emulated turbulence, superpositions of up to eleven OAM modes give an estimate as accurate as that from a Gaussian probe beam sent through the same fibre. In all but weak turbulence the estimate is also more accurate than an ideal Strehl meter or an ideal tip/tilt sensor, providing an efficient way to estimate turbulence strength in mode-division multiplexed systems.
items.abstract_zh: 大气湍流强度决定自由空间光链路中模式混合的程度。通常用单独仪器或高斯探测光束测量，二者均未利用结构光链路已携带的光束。本文表明，湍流强度（以Fried参数表示）可直接从复用轨道角动量（OAM）光束估计，而无需知道存在哪些模式。光束通过无源多模光纤后在相机上形成散斑，对相机像素进行训练加权求和（称为极限学习机），并在数十帧上平均，可给出Fried参数。在实验室模拟湍流条件下，多达十一个OAM模式的叠加所给出的估计与通过同一光纤发送的高斯探测光束一样准确。除弱湍流外，该估计也比理想Strehl计或理想倾斜/偏转传感器更准确，为模分复用系统中估计湍流强度提供了一种高效方法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: World Models and the Law
items.title_zh: 世界模型与法律
items.abstract_en: Current AI may have a model of how we use human language, but this does not translate into a reliable representation of physical reality. World models promise to fill this gap by learning how an environment changes over time and predicting the consequences of an action, and they are already used to steer robots and generate explorable worlds. This article asks how AI regulation in three major legal contexts, the European Union, California, and China, copes with the distinctive challenges they raise. I propose a definition and a taxonomy of world models based on who or what acts on their predictions, and identify the risks of misplaced reliance on them. I argue that existing rules tend to cover world models but leave three questions open, i.e., action provenance, trajectory validity, and the weight of simulated evidence, and recommend ways to fill these gaps.
items.abstract_zh: 当前AI可能拥有关于我们如何使用人类语言的模型，但这并不能转化为对物理现实的可靠表征。世界模型有望通过学习环境如何随时间变化并预测行动的后果来填补这一空白，它们已被用于驱动机器人和生成可探索世界。本文探讨欧盟、加利福尼亚和中国三个主要法律语境下的AI监管如何应对其提出的独特挑战。我基于是谁或什么依据其预测行动，提出世界模型的定义和分类法，并识别对其错误依赖的风险。我认为现有规则往往覆盖世界模型，但留下三个未决问题，即行动来源、轨迹有效性和模拟证据的权重，并建议填补这些空白的方法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Reading the Tea Leaves, Again: Can Large Language Models Predict Language Model Training Runs?
items.title_zh: 再读茶叶：大型语言模型能否预测语言模型训练运行？
items.abstract_en: LLM agents now propose research ideas and run the experiments that test them, but they train every run to its end, whereas a researcher reads a run's configuration and the beginning of its curve and stops the runs that show no promise. Reading a run this way takes more than describing or implementing a training method: it takes knowing what a design choice does to a run. We build Tea Leaves to measure this knowledge on 682 real training runs across pretraining, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning (RL): a forecaster sees the first 20% of a run with its configuration, description, and code, and predicts the rest. Across 11 LLMs and a range of forecasting baselines, the strongest LLMs match or exceed the best curve fitter on smooth loss curves (skill 0.66 against 0.62) and lead on noisy RL reward curves (0.43 against 0.13). What bounds every forecaster is what the log carries: on sparsely logged community runs all methods lose most of their skill, and none reliably flags a failing run in advance. Beyond the curve, information helps and effort does not: related runs in the prompt cut the error on loss curves by 39%, and knowledge of training dynamics lets the strongest LLMs order all 36 pairs of runs that differ by a described code change, which the early curves do not separate, whereas tools add little. This knowledge can be learned from logged runs: a small open model trained on public runs matches the best LLM on loss curves. Applied to the progress curves of research agents, the same reading ranks tasks by their remaining headroom, although for a single agent run it does not improve on the last value. We release the benchmark, the trained readers, and their training data to test and train LLMs' understanding of training and to help research agents decide which runs deserve their compute.
items.abstract_zh: LLM智能体现可提出研究想法并运行检验这些想法的实验，但它们会把每次运行训练到结束，而研究者会阅读一次运行的配置及其曲线开头，并停止没有希望的那些运行。以这种方式阅读一次运行，需要的不仅仅是描述或实现一种训练方法：还需要知道某个设计选择会对运行产生什么影响。我们构建Tea Leaves，用于在涵盖预训练、微调和强化学习（RL）的682次真实训练运行上测量这种知识：预测器看到一次运行的前20%及其配置、描述和代码，并预测其余部分。在11个LLM和一系列预测基线中，最强的LLM在平滑损失曲线上达到或超过最佳曲线拟合器（技能0.66对0.62），并在噪声RL奖励曲线上领先（0.43对0.13）。限制每个预测器的是日志所携带的信息：在稀疏记录的社区运行上，所有方法都失去大部分技能，且没有一个能可靠地提前标记失败运行。在曲线之外，信息有帮助而努力没有：提示中的相关运行将损失曲线误差降低39%，对训练动态的知识使最强的LLM能够对全部36对仅因所述代码更改而不同的运行进行排序，而早期曲线无法区分这些运行，工具则帮助甚微。这种知识可以从记录的运行中学习：一个在公共运行上训练的小型开放模型在损失曲线上匹配最佳LLM。应用于研究智能体的进展曲线时，同样的阅读按剩余空间对任务排序，尽管对于单个智能体运行，它并不优于最后一个值。我们发布基准、训练好的阅读器及其训练数据，以测试和训练LLM对训练的理解，并帮助研究智能体决定哪些运行值得其计算资源。

items.title_en: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
items.title_zh: ReWeave：面向具身执行框架优化与跨任务元蒸馏的新兴物理任务拓扑
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程具身任务涉及可能只有通过交互才能明确的物理依赖关系。随着任务理解加深，过去的试验可以揭示用于适应和迁移的新信息。然而，粗粒度进展反馈无法识别哪些物理前提条件成立，使搜索缺乏引导；而任务特定优化容易过拟合到单个场景，使跨任务迁移变得脆弱。我们提出ReWeave，一个在不更新策略权重的情况下，从交互中联合优化具身智能体执行框架和新兴物理任务拓扑的框架。在保持执行策略和感知冻结的情况下，ReWeave协同优化耦合上下文、工作流和控制循环。当新证据修正拓扑时，ReWeave将过去的试验重新投影到更新后的任务理解上，揭示保留的进展、回退和瓶颈，以指导父代选择和搜索宽度。跨任务时，将已验证的局部机制与未满足的前提条件匹配，将72个专家单元整合为44个可复用组（为完全拼接的0.34×），并纳入一个能够持续学习的紧凑共享执行框架。ReWeave在LIBERO-PRO上将留出成功率从89.00%提高到98.75%，在RoboDojo上从25.50%提高到58.25%，同时在159次失败的RoboDojo开发试验中，有89%揭示了保留的进展，并将更强的离线推理转化为更高的在线性能。在八个未见过的LIBERO-PRO任务上，共享执行框架达到51.3%成功率，而直接蒸馏为41.3%，在持续学习后升至75.0%。

items.title_en: RadioWorld: Transferring World Models to Radio-Frequency Radiance Fields
items.title_zh: RadioWorld：将世界模型迁移到射频辐射场
items.abstract_en: Electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation in the physical world constitutes a Radio-Frequency (RF) radiance field, providing rich information for 6G communication and sensing. However, existing neural RF field methods suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) they predominantly rely on per-scene optimization and cannot generalize to unseen scenes; (2) they require costly reference RF measurements in each target scene; and (3) they degrade severely when extrapolating beyond the vicinity of reference measurements. To overcome these limitations, we present RadioWorld, a general framework that adapts a world model to synthesize RF radiance fields directly from physical scene geometry and transceiver locations, without requiring any reference RF measurements at inference. Specifically, RadioWorld couples two specialized modules within a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture: a Scene-Understanding Transformer that encodes 3D scene geometry and transceiver locations to extract environment-aware global EM propagation features, and a Field-Generation Transformer that attends to these features to synthesize the RF radiance field with the local query conditions. We also establish UrbanRF-Bench, a large-scale ray-traced benchmark spanning 657 urban scenes and 32,850 RF radiance fields across seven global cities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RadioWorld significantly outperforms specialized baselines and accurately synthesizes RF fields at arbitrary locations in unseen cities. Code, datasets, and checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 物理世界中的电磁波传播构成射频（RF）辐射场，为 6G 通信与感知提供丰富信息。现有神经 RF 场方法有三大局限：依赖逐场景优化，无法泛化到未见场景；每个目标场景都需要昂贵的参考 RF 测量；在参考测量范围之外外推时性能严重退化。为此我们提出 RadioWorld，将世界模型适配为直接从物理场景几何与收发机位置合成 RF 辐射场，推理时无需任何参考 RF 测量。RadioWorld 在双流 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构中耦合两个模块：场景理解 Transformer 编码 3D 几何与收发机位置，提取环境感知的全局电磁传播特征；场生成 Transformer 关注这些特征并结合局部查询条件合成辐射场。我们还构建了 UrbanRF-Bench，覆盖 7 座全球城市的 657 个城市场景与 32,850 个 RF 辐射场。实验表明 RadioWorld 显著优于专用基线，并能准确合成未见城市中任意位置的 RF 场。
items.highlight_zh: 把世界模型迁移到射频域，无需实测即可合成城市 RF 辐射场
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：6G 通信与感知需要知道城市中电磁波如何传播，这可视为一个“射频辐射场”。现有神经 RF 场方法有三个痛点：每个场景都要单独优化，换到新场景就不灵；目标场景必须提供昂贵的参考 RF 测量；一旦离开测量点附近做外推，效果急剧下降。
2) 方法：RadioWorld 把“世界模型”的思路搬到射频域，直接以 3D 场景几何和收发机位置为输入，生成对应位置的 RF 辐射场，推理阶段不需要任何参考测量。模型采用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构：场景理解 Transformer 负责从几何与收发机位置中提取环境感知的全局电磁传播特征，场生成 Transformer 则关注这些特征并结合局部查询条件（如具体查询点）合成场值。
3) 数据与基准：作者构建 UrbanRF-Bench，用射线追踪生成，覆盖 7 座全球城市的 657 个城市场景、32,850 个 RF 辐射场，规模可观且跨城市分布。
4) 结果：实验显示 RadioWorld 明显优于专用基线方法，并能对未见城市中任意位置的 RF 场做出准确合成，说明它学到的是可迁移的传播规律而非记忆单一场景。
5) 为何重要：它把“逐场景拟合”变成“跨场景生成”，有望减少 6G 网络规划与部署中对实地射频测量和逐场景仿真的依赖，降低建模成本并提升对新环境的适应能力。

items.title_en: Disease-specific versus symptom-specific neuroimaging phenotypes across Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease, and Small Vessel Disease
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和小血管病中疾病特异性与症状特异性神经影像表型的比较
items.abstract_en: Background: Neurodegenerative disorders are common in ageing populations, and arise from several distinct pathophysiological causes. Yet, they also share many symptoms, including cognitive and neuropsychiatric ones. It is unclear to what extent the impact of neurodegeneration on brain systems is unique or shared across disorders, and whether shared symptoms are driven by degeneration of the same brain systems. Methods: We collected data from n=251 participants with Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease, Small Vessel Disease, and age-matched healthy controls. All participants underwent harmonized cognitive and neuropsychiatric assessment and were scanned using the UK-Biobank MRI protocol capturing features including brain volume, white matter lesions and microstructure, tract volume, iron content, and functional connectivity. Results: We replicated established case-control brain changes in Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease and Small Vessel Disease compared to healthy controls. Leveraging this joint standardised dataset, we identified distinct neuroimaging features of individual neurodegenerative disorders, providing evidence for robust diagnosis-specific brain changes. Importantly, however, there was also a large degree of transdiagnostic similarity across neuroimaging markers. Testing for transdiagnostic associations between symptoms and brain phenotypes, we found that lower medial frontal pole connectivity to primary motor cortex was preferentially associated with apathy, fatigue, and depression; whereas cingulum microstructure was associated with cognitive deficits across diagnoses. Conclusions: These results demonstrate that different neurodegenerative diseases are characterised by dissociable brain changes, but also common transdiagnostic and symptom-associated features. This suggests that shared symptoms across neurodegeneration may in part be driven by overlapping impact on key brain systems, such as changes in medial frontal pole connectivity and cingulum microstructure. Our work highlights that multimodal imaging biomarkers can help understand and parse symptomatic heterogeneity in neurodegenerative and ageing populations.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：神经退行性疾病在老龄化人群中常见，并由若干不同的病理生理原因引起。然而，它们也共享许多症状，包括认知和神经精神症状。目前尚不清楚神经退行性变对脑系统的影响在多大程度上是疾病独有的或跨疾病共享的，也不清楚共享症状是否由相同脑系统的退变驱动。方法：我们收集了n=251名阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、小血管病患者以及年龄匹配的健康对照者的数据。所有参与者均接受了统一的认知和神经精神评估，并按照UK-Biobank MRI协议扫描，采集脑体积、白质病变与微结构、纤维束体积、铁含量和功能连接等特征。结果：我们复现了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和小血管病相对于健康对照的既有病例-对照脑改变。利用这一联合标准化数据集，我们识别出各神经退行性疾病的独特神经影像特征，为稳健的诊断特异性脑改变提供了证据。然而重要的是，神经影像标志物之间也存在很大程度的跨诊断相似性。检验症状与脑表型之间的跨诊断关联时，我们发现内侧额极与初级运动皮层的连接降低优先与冷漠、疲劳和抑郁相关；而扣带微结构与各诊断中的认知缺陷相关。结论：这些结果表明，不同神经退行性疾病以可分离的脑改变为特征，但也具有共同的跨诊断和症状相关特征。这提示神经退行性变中的共享症状可能部分由对关键脑系统的重叠影响驱动，例如内侧额极连接和扣带微结构的变化。我们的工作强调，多模态影像生物标志物有助于理解和解析神经退行性及老龄化人群中的症状异质性。

items.title_en: Ultrabroadband, high-sensitivity time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy enabled by a Yb-based laser system
items.title_zh: 基于Yb激光系统的超宽带、高灵敏度时间分辨太赫兹光谱
items.abstract_en: Ultrafast optical fields have introduced numerous novel light-induced states in quantum materials. Identifying these states and elucidating their formation mechanisms require comprehensive, quantitative access to nonequilibrium electrodynamics across relevant energy scales. Here, we develop a Yb-laser-based time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy (TRTS) platform combining multi-pass-cell pulse compression, spintronic terahertz generation, and air-biased coherent detection. A single time-domain waveform scan provides continuous phase-resolved spectral coverage to 25 THz ($\sim$100 meV) with a Fourier resolution of 0.1 THz ($\sim$0.4 meV). This capability enables the characterization of both low-frequency charge dynamics and higher-energy resonant excitations in quantum materials under a common temporal reference. The system achieves a single-scan time-domain signal-to-noise ratio of 72 dB with long-term waveform stability, while preserving most of the laser pulse energy for tunable excitation. Measurements on intrinsic GaAs resolve extremely weak phonon features above 23 THz and demonstrate quantitative retrieval of equilibrium and transient complex optical properties. The resulting platform can provide a more complete microscopic picture of light-induced states in quantum materials.
items.abstract_zh: 超快光场已在量子材料中引入众多新颖的光诱导态。识别这些态并阐明其形成机制，需要全面、定量地获取相关能量尺度上的非平衡电动力学。在此，我们开发了一个基于Yb激光的时间分辨太赫兹光谱（TRTS）平台，结合多通池脉冲压缩、自旋电子太赫兹产生和空气偏置相干检测。单次时域波形扫描可提供连续相位分辨的光谱覆盖，至25 THz（约100 meV），傅里叶分辨率为0.1 THz（约0.4 meV）。这一能力使得在共同时间参考下表征量子材料中的低频电荷动力学和更高能量的共振激发成为可能。该系统单次扫描时域信噪比为72 dB，并具有长期波形稳定性，同时保留大部分激光脉冲能量用于可调谐激发。对 本征GaAs的测量分辨出23 THz以上的极弱声子特征，并证明可定量反演平衡态和瞬态复光学性质。该平台可为量子材料中的光诱导态提供更完整的微观图景。

items.title_en: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
items.title_zh: MobileGrail：为可设备端部署的移动GUI智能体安全学习紧凑型防护栏
items.abstract_en: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart. On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.
items.abstract_zh: 运行时防护栏通过在执行前评估每个拟议动作来保护移动GUI智能体，但现有防护栏依赖云端托管的大型多模态模型，将每个屏幕暴露给远程服务器，包括支付、消息和医疗记录等隐私信息。我们提出MobileGrail，一个可设备端部署的模型，同时解决这两个问题。它维护一个循环任务状态，仅保留后续安全决策所依赖的证据，使授权和执行进度能够超越短上下文而持续存在。为了在保持安全边界精确的同时尽早干预，它学习两个标签：unsafe和block；unsafe标记实施违规的动作，而block可在干预窗口的任意步骤发出，该窗口从用户授权不再能解释的第一个动作延伸到实施违规的动作本身。为支持训练，我们构建了一个包含32个应用的环境，其后端验证每个动作的效果，为监督提供经验证的标签，并为强化学习提供奖励以校准干预时机。我们还构建了MobileVeto，一个离线基准，包含主要来自留出应用的不安全轨迹，每条轨迹均配有良性对应轨迹。在MobileVeto上，基于Qwen3.5-2B构建的MobileGrail拦截了76.2%的违规，而其提示词骨干模型为64.5%，同时将过早干预从58.6%降至5.2%，在这两项上均优于基于云的OS-Sentinel。我们进一步在GhostEIBench上进行在线评估，其中MobileGrail守护Qwen3.8-27B智能体，将110个任务中完全成功的攻击从13个降至3个，同时将任务完成数从48提高到58。量化为4比特后，MobileGrail在Snapdragon 8 Elite上以4.7秒的中位延迟运行，与云端托管的Gemini 3.8 Flash的5.1秒相当。

items.title_en: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
items.title_zh: Escriba-OCR：用于手写葡萄牙语作文保留错误转写的1B视觉语言模型
items.abstract_en: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.
items.abstract_zh: 反馈工具和关于学习者写作的研究需要手写作文的转写，且要精确保留学生所写内容：拼写错误、换行、删除线和插入内容。视觉语言模型（VLM）读手写内容很好，但它们也倾向于将其改写为正确语言。我们在BRESSAY的1,000篇手写巴西葡萄牙语作文上测量这一点，使用一个基准，在字符错误率（CER）之外加入错误保留、虚构错误、编辑标记精确率和召回率以及行结构，并使用配对自助置信区间。我们将研究限制在学校可在自有硬件上运行的开源权重模型。在22个开放基线中，最佳模型Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B在199个测试页上达到5.6% CER；没有一个能可靠复现编辑标记，而且每个VLM都会将39-78%的不在葡萄牙语词典中的词替换为词典词。我们在一个GPU上于85分钟内用647个训练页微调LightOnOCR-3-1B。所得的Escriba-OCR-1B达到2.06% CER，比最佳基线低3.5个百分点（95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]）；在ICDAR 2024竞赛指标下，它达到2.1% CER，低于已发表的最佳页面级结果（2.2-2.4%）。它恢复了67%的插入内容和77%的难以辨认的删除内容，并复现了97%页面的行结构，但仍会将60%的可能拼写错误规范化。三个随机种子在0.04 CER点内一致，量化为4比特后，模型在普通CPU上以每页约一分钟运行。在另一语料的40封信件上，它与基础模型表现相当（不含该模型附加的评论），但更常误读未见词；权重插值弥补了一半差距。教师评审发现，在可判断的表观更正中有45%是BRESSAY真实标注中的错误，因此基于词典的分数可能低估了保留程度。我们发布模型、基准代码和评审数据。

items.title_en: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
items.title_zh: AXE：AlpaSim端到端闭环挑战技术报告
items.abstract_en: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告介绍了一个用于Physical AI AV Track的端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的完整流水线。该框架包括数据整理、HD地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习和基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环环境中的安全性，我们引入一种基于选择的E2E规划方法，利用目标检测和BEV分割来过滤掉可能导致碰撞或偏离道路的轨迹候选。在NVIDIA NuRec和NVIDIA PAI-AV数据集上训练，我们的方法对固定词汇表的轨迹候选在碰撞、可行驶区域合规性和从模拟推演中学习到的进度方面进行评分，并选择通过过滤器的最佳候选。这一设计突显了将E2E规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。
