items.title_en: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
items.title_zh: MORSE：通过开放世界自动研究优化流式记忆设计
items.abstract_en: A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.
items.abstract_zh: 流式视频系统必须在单遍处理中、在有界帧存储下决定保留哪些证据，而此时它尚不知道未来问题会需要哪些细节。近期的递归自我改进方法自动化设计用于存储和检索这些证据的运行框架。它们根据失败修订运行框架，但编辑器仍须依据先验知识和预定义工具集来设计每一次修复。然而，在不同视频中反复出现的失败可能指向先前工作已经解决的问题。我们提出 MORSE（Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement），一个开放世界自动研究框架，利用反复出现的失败来指导在线搜索解决方案。其编辑器按原因对训练轨迹中的失败进行分组，然后检索论文、模型卡和代码，寻找可适配的方法或可使用的预训练感知模型。当编辑器引入新的感知能力时，它还可以针对冻结的视频-语言模型修订运行框架存储和检索所得证据的方式。在留出验证流上，MORSE 首先选择能提升答案质量的修订，然后寻求在指定容差内保持这些收益的更快速修订。在三个流式视频基准上，MORSE 在每个冻结骨干比较中始终取得最高答案准确率。在 OVO-Bench 上，我们的 Qwen3-VL-8B 运行框架平均在 0.30 秒内回答查询，同时达到 75.1% 准确率，比使用相同冻结骨干的次优已评估运行框架领先 3.1 个百分点。

items.title_en: Integrating hydrogen-exchange experiments with conformational ensembles
items.title_zh: 将氢交换实验与构象系综整合
items.abstract_en: Protein conformational dynamics are central to biological function but remain difficult to characterise at scale. Amide hydrogen exchange (HX), measured by NMR or mass spectrometry, probes these dynamics but requires computational models for integration with structural ensembles. We benchmark models for calculating HX from ensembles using a large literature-derived dataset spanning folded and intrinsically disordered proteins. We then develop a model that identifies exchange-competent amides from local structural descriptors while accounting for electrostatic effects. The model predicts protection across a broad dynamic range in ensembles generated by molecular dynamics and generative AI. HX-guided ensemble reweighting improves agreement with independent NMR, SAXS, and folding-stability measurements. Millisecond HX distinguishes and refines alternative ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins, while reweighting of structured proteins reveals folding intermediates and low-population excited states. These results establish HX as a quantitative restraint for ensemble reweighting and provide a scalable framework for benchmarking simulations and generative protein models.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象动力学是生物功能的核心，但在规模化表征上仍然困难。通过核磁共振或质谱测量的酰胺氢交换（HX）可探测这些动力学，但需要计算模型才能与结构系综整合。我们使用一个涵盖折叠蛋白和固有无序蛋白的大规模文献衍生数据集，对从系综计算 HX 的模型进行基准测试。随后，我们开发了一个模型，从局部结构描述符中识别具备交换能力的酰胺，同时考虑静电效应。该模型在由分子动力学和生成式 AI 生成的系综中，能在广泛动态范围内预测保护程度。HX 引导的系综重加权改善了与独立 NMR、SAXS 和折叠稳定性测量的一致性。毫秒级 HX 可区分并细化固有无序蛋白的替代系综，而对结构化蛋白进行重加权则可揭示折叠中间体和低占据激发态。这些结果确立了 HX 作为系综重加权的定量约束，并提供了一个可扩展框架，用于对模拟和生成式蛋白质模型进行基准测试。

items.title_en: Reconfigurable Microwave Photonic All-Pass Filters based on Optical Kerr Microcombs
items.title_zh: 基于光学克尔微梳的可重构微波光子全通滤波器
items.abstract_en: Microwave photonic (MWP) all pass filters (APFs), which enable phase manipulation without altering signal amplitudes, are essential for phase engineering in high bandwidth microwave signal processing. However, achieving a high degree of reconfigurability in the filter order and characteristic parameters of APFs remains challenging for conventional methods. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a new strategy for realizing MWP APFs based on a microcomb driven transversal filter system, enabling high reconfigurability, sharp phase transitions with high group delays, and low loss. We experimentally demonstrate both 1st and 2nd order APFs, achieving a maximum amplitude variation (MAV) of 1.95 dB and a maximum group delay (MGD) of 580 ps for the former, and a MAV of 2.01 dB and an MGD of 1740 ps for the latter. In addition, both independent and joint tuning of APF characteristic parameters are demonstrated by simply programming the tap coefficients without changing any hardware, enabling highly reconfigurable filter response for diverse phase engineering functionalities. These results highlight the potential of our approach for implementing MWP APFs with both high performance and reconfigurability for practical applications requiring dynamic and versatile phase control.
items.abstract_zh: 微波光子（MWP）全通滤波器（APF）能够在不改变信号幅度的情况下实现相位操控，是高带宽微波信号处理中相位工程的关键。然而，传统方法在实现 APF 滤波器阶数和特性参数的高度可重构性方面仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出并实验演示了一种基于微梳驱动横向滤波器系统实现 MWP APF 的新策略，可实现高可重构性、具有高群延迟的陡峭相位过渡以及低损耗。我们实验演示了一阶和二阶 APF，前者实现了 1.95 dB 的最大幅度变化（MAV）和 580 ps 的最大群延迟（MGD），后者实现了 2.01 dB 的 MAV 和 1740 ps 的 MGD。此外，仅通过编程抽头系数而不改变任何硬件，就演示了 APF 特性参数的独立调谐和联合调谐，从而为多样化的相位工程功能实现高度可重构的滤波器响应。这些结果凸显了我们的方法在实现兼具高性能和可重构性的 MWP APF 方面的潜力，适用于需要动态且多功能相位控制的實際应用。

items.title_en: LIELLA: Private Edge Adaptation with Photonic Weight Streams
items.title_zh: LIELLA：利用光子权重流的私有边缘适配
items.abstract_en: Although photonic accelerators have shown promise for energy-efficient machine learning inference, privately personalizing large models across multiple edge clients remains difficult under tight memory, precision, and hardware constraints. We present LIELLA, a weight-streaming architecture that enables multiple edge clients to personalize a shared model through compact private adapters. The two proposed photonic adapter architectures accommodate both backpropagation and forward-only optimization while substantially reducing modeled client-side electrical energy consumption compared with electronic adapters. Under simulated hardware noise, clients sharing the same streamed backbone achieve nearly clean accuracy on QNLI and SST-2, even with attojoule-scale optical energy per MAC at each receiver. The architecture also enables hardware-aware adaptation among clients performing the same task, allowing their individual private adapters to achieve further accuracy improvements. For a gigabyte-scale TinyLlama backbone, LIELLA maintains a megabyte-scale inference memory footprint and kilobyte-scale persistent adapter storage per client, while achieving strong performance through forward-only adaptation. These findings further highlight hardware-driven opportunities to develop smaller yet more effective parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods and more accurate, noise-robust forward-only optimization algorithms.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管光子加速器在节能机器学习推理方面已显示出前景，但在严格的内存、精度和硬件约束下，跨多个边缘客户端私有地个性化大型模型仍然困难。我们提出 LIELLA，一种权重流式架构，使多个边缘客户端能够通过紧凑的私有适配器个性化共享模型。所提出的两种光子适配器架构同时支持反向传播和仅前向优化，同时与电子适配器相比大幅降低建模的客户端电能消耗。在模拟硬件噪声下，共享同一流式骨干的客户端在 QNLI 和 SST-2 上达到接近无噪声的准确率，即使每个接收器每次 MAC 的光能为阿托焦耳级。该架构还支持执行同一任务的客户端之间进行硬件感知适配，使其各自的私有适配器实现进一步的准确率提升。对于千兆字节级 TinyLlama 骨干，LIELLA 保持兆字节级推理内存占用和每客户端千字节级持久适配器存储，同时通过仅前向适配实现强劲性能。这些发现进一步凸显了硬件驱动的机会，即开发更小但更有效的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法以及更准确、噪声鲁棒的仅前向优化算法。

items.title_en: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
items.title_zh: 从点云到工程模型：对建成环境中智能体式三维重建的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体可以将三维测量转换为 CAD 几何，但为建成环境重建工程模型需要超出表面拟合的语义解释和一致的建造约束。我们将场景级 Scan-to-BIM（建筑信息建模）表述为智能体式三维编码任务，并引入 S2Bench，其中包含跨五个领域的 128 个真实世界场景的公开和专有扫描，并配有覆盖多样空间尺度的专家整理参考模型。一个共享框架让智能体能够在 Python 中测量扫描、在实时 CAD/BIM 内核中构建带类别标签的组件，并迭代改进其代码。我们还提出并行异步协作，其中负责人委派带版本的任务，在工作者执行时继续建模，并整合受修订约束的提案。在 1,028 次重建上评估五个智能体和一个协作团队表明，扫描到模型残差直接指导几何修复，而推断语义类别和建造关系需要联合几何、视觉和工程推理，智能体难以对其落地和验证。因此，领先智能体紧密拟合扫描几何（5 cm 内覆盖率 96%），但仅达到 63% mIoU，且没有智能体在超过 38% 的场景上通过所有工程检查。覆盖率和工程符合度随场景尺度下降，而将较小模型作为团队运行可改善所有三个维度，并在较大场景上获得更大覆盖率提升。项目页面见 https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ROSE-Drive: Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: ROSE-Drive：自动驾驶的运行时编排与系统演化
items.abstract_en: End-to-end driving models have made substantial progress, yet reliable closed-loop driving in complex traffic remains challenging. Beyond improving individual models, system-level orchestration offers a complementary approach by coordinating driving capabilities and computation. We introduce ROSE-Drive (Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution), a model-agnostic framework that jointly orchestrates driving execution and computation. It coordinates frozen driving models with driving skills, perception tools, and feedback controllers. A distilled vision-language model (VLM) proposes driving tasks and scene relations. Shared physical state and persistent tasks support capability composition, task continuity, and adaptive scheduling. The orchestrator combines model and skill outputs across control channels, maintains task responsibility through handover, and uses execution feedback to select controllers, reuse valid motion references, and schedule model inference. Offline revisions use execution records to refine skills and their coordination through a stable task interface. Successive system stages inherit these revisions while model, perception, and VLM weights remain fixed. Evaluations with four driving models on Bench2Drive v0.0.3, Bench2Drive v0.0.4, and Fail2Drive show accumulated capability and transfer before target-benchmark revision. On held-out Longest6, driving score (DS) rises from 25 to 52 for AutoMoT and from 22 to 47 for SimLingo across system stages, while both systems skip new model inference on over 71% of control steps.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端驾驶模型已取得实质性进展，但在复杂交通中实现可靠的闭环驾驶仍然具有挑战性。除了改进单个模型之外，系统级编排通过协调驾驶能力与计算提供了一种互补方法。我们提出 ROSE-Drive（Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution），一个模型无关框架，联合编排驾驶执行与计算。它协调冻结的驾驶模型与驾驶技能、感知工具和反馈控制器。一个蒸馏的视觉-语言模型（VLM）提出驾驶任务和场景关系。共享物理状态和持久任务支持能力组合、任务连续性和自适应调度。编排器跨控制通道组合模型和技能输出，通过交接维持任务责任，并利用执行反馈选择控制器、复用有效运动参考并调度模型推理。离线修订利用执行记录，通过稳定任务接口改进技能及其协调。连续的系统阶段继承这些修订，而模型、感知和 VLM 权重保持固定。在 Bench2Drive v0.0.3、Bench2Drive v0.0.4 和 Fail2Drive 上使用四个驾驶模型进行评估，显示在目标基准修订前具有累积能力和迁移。在留出的 Longest6 上，跨系统阶段，AutoMoT 的驾驶分数（DS）从 25 升至 52，SimLingo 从 22 升至 47，同时两个系统在超过 71% 的控制步骤上跳过新模型推理。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场以进行视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏输入视图优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视角方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5维坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关发射辐射亮度。我们通过沿相机射线查询5维坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影为图像。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的照片级真实感新视角，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以获得有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Stain-robust classification of Alzheimer's disease and chronic traumatic encephalopathy
items.title_zh: 染色稳健的阿尔茨海默病与慢性创伤性脑病分类
items.abstract_en: Retrospective reassessment of archival brain banks provides opportunities to identify previously undocumented neuropathologies. However, limited tissue availability and preservation, together with differences in sampling and staining protocols across brain banks, can constrain the histological information available for analysis. This study investigated whether computational models can integrate complementary information across histological stains and retain discriminative information under incomplete stain availability. A deep learning model incorporating shared-specific feature modeling, cross-stain knowledge distillation, and random modality masking was developed and evaluated on 1,607 whole slide images from the dorsolateral frontal cortex of 602 donors across three cohorts. Using chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) and Alzheimer's disease (AD) and their comorbidity as a proof-of-principle application, our model achieved macro-averaged areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.899, 0.904, and 0.898 across three stain-defined groups, exceeding corresponding single-stain baselines. Discriminative performance was retained when each group's defining stain was withheld. Model-predicted disease probabilities were associated with neuropathological staging measures for AD and CTE, and spatial attribution patterns on the remaining stains were largely preserved under defining-stain masking. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of leveraging complementary and partially overlapping histopathological information under incomplete stain availability, providing a foundation for future computational studies across brain regions and brain banks.
items.abstract_zh: 对存档脑库的回顾性再评估为识别既往未记录的神经病理提供了机会。然而，组织可用性和保存状况有限，加之不同脑库之间采样和染色方案的差异，可能限制可用于分析的组织学信息。本研究探讨计算模型能否整合跨组织学染色的互补信息，并在染色可用性不完整时保留判别信息。我们开发了一个深度学习模型，结合共享-特异特征建模、跨染色知识蒸馏和随机模态掩蔽，并在来自三个队列、602名供者的背外侧额叶皮层1,607张全切片图像上进行了评估。以慢性创伤性脑病（CTE）和阿尔茨海默病（AD）及其共病作为原理验证应用，我们的模型在三个由染色定义的分组中分别达到0.899、0.904和0.898的宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积，超过相应的单染色基线。当扣留每组定义性染色时，判别性能仍得以保留。模型预测的疾病概率与AD和CTE的神经病理分期指标相关，并且在定义性染色被掩蔽时，其余染色上的空间归因模式基本保持不变。这些发现证明了在染色可用性不完整时利用互补且部分重叠的组织病理学信息的可行性，为未来跨脑区和脑库的计算研究提供了基础。

items.title_en: Conceptual Design of a 5 MV High-Voltage System for a Compact Orbitron Fusion Device
items.title_zh: 紧凑型Orbitron聚变装置5 MV高压系统的概念设计
items.abstract_en: The high-voltage system is a key part of the puzzle toward achieving net-positive fusion power in a compact Orbitron device. This paper presents a conceptual engineering design for a 5 MV, 20 mA, 100 kW HV system for a next-generation Orbitron, serving as an upper-bound design point for the HV system. The MC-TRANS++ 0-D code is used to set the load requirements: a 1 m long, 0.45 m first-wall-radius central cell, 2.5 T on-axis and 10 T mirror-throat fields, and a 5 MV radial potential drop sustaining supersonic rotation ($M = 4.8$). This delivers a triple product of $5.8 \times 10^{21}$ keV s /m3 and $Q_{sci}$ = 8.5. The HV power supply integrates an AC-DC converter, a SiC full-bridge inverter, a CLLC resonant network with an air-core step-up transformer, and feeds a 120-stage parallel-fed series-cascaded rectifier operating at 250 kHz. At full load, this architecture yields an end-to-end efficiency of 85%, much higher than the 60% typical of triode-driven MV-class power supplies. The 5 MV voltage is delivered to a radially nested 50-gap bushing system that interfaces pressurized insulating gas to high vacuum, using brazed alumina spacers with a corrugated profile. The design draws directly on the measured behavior of a previously demonstrated 300 kV prototype, from which six quantitative lessons are extracted and mapped onto the 5 MV design. Electrostatic simulations of the complete assembly at rated voltage show maximum surface fields of 30.3 MV/m on the corona rings, 7.7 MV/m at the cathode triple junction, and average vacuum-gap fields ranging from 5.5 to 40 MV/m. These field strengths remain below breakdown thresholds due to the implementation of triple-junction shielding, insulation corrugation, and axial magnetic insulation at 2.5-10 T. The conceptual system has a form factor of 2.7 meters in diameter and 6.5 meters in length, projected to deliver a net power output of 86-171 kWe.
items.abstract_zh: 高压系统是紧凑型Orbitron装置实现净正能量聚变功率这一难题的关键部分。本文提出下一代Orbitron的5 MV、20 mA、100 kW高压系统的概念工程设计，作为该高压系统的上限设计点。使用MC-TRANS++零维代码设定负载要求：1 m长、第一壁半径0.45 m的中心室，2.5 T轴上磁场和10 T磁镜喉部磁场，以及维持超声速旋转（$M = 4.8$）的5 MV径向电势降。这给出5.8 × 10^21 keV s/m3的三乘积和$Q_{sci}$ = 8.5。高压电源集成AC-DC变换器、SiC全桥逆变器、带空芯升压变压器的CLLC谐振网络，并为工作在250 kHz的120级并联馈电串联级联整流器供电。在满载下，该架构实现85%的端到端效率，远高于三极管驱动的MV级电源典型的60%。5 MV电压被输送到径向嵌套的50间隙套管系统，该系统将加压绝缘气体与高真空衔接，使用具有波纹轮廓的钎焊氧化铝隔件。该设计直接依据先前已演示的300 kV原型的实测行为，从中提取六项定量经验并映射到5 MV设计。额定电压下完整组件的静电仿真显示：电晕环上的最大表面场强为30.3 MV/m，阴极三结合点处为7.7 MV/m，真空间隙平均场强为5.5至40 MV/m。由于实施了三结合点屏蔽、绝缘波纹化和2.5–10 T轴向磁绝缘，这些场强仍低于击穿阈值。该概念系统的外形尺寸为直径2.7米、长度6.5米，预计可提供86–171 kWe的净功率输出。

items.title_en: Towards Edge Artificial Intelligence for Predicting Antimicrobial Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
items.title_zh: 面向边缘人工智能的结核分枝杆菌抗菌药物耐药性预测
items.abstract_en: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) poses a major challenge to global tuberculosis control, as multidrug-resistant strains limit available treatment options. Rapid and accurate prediction of drug resistance from genomic data could support timely treatment decisions and public health interventions. However, many existing computational approaches for genomic AMR prediction rely on computationally intensive pipelines, limiting their suitability for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. This limitation is particularly relevant in hospital settings in low- and middle-income countries, where computing infrastructure and access to high-performance computational resources may be limited. To address this challenge, we present a lightweight, novel machine learning (ML) approach suitable for running on edge devices that combines 4-mer frequency features derived from whole-genome sequences with a Random Forest classifier to predict antibiotic resistance in MTB. The proposed ML approach achieved an average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.82 across 20 antibiotics on an independent test set.
items.abstract_zh: 结核分枝杆菌（MTB）的抗微生物药物耐药性（AMR）对全球结核病控制构成重大挑战，因为耐多药菌株限制了可用的治疗选择。从基因组数据快速准确地预测耐药性可支持及时的治疗决策和公共卫生干预。然而，许多现有的基因组AMR预测计算方法依赖计算密集型流程，限制了其在资源受限边缘设备上部署的适用性。这一限制在低收入和中等收入国家的医院环境中尤为相关，因为这些环境中计算基础设施和高性能计算资源的获取可能有限。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种适合在边缘设备上运行的轻量级新型机器学习（ML）方法，它将源自全基因组序列的4-mer频率特征与随机森林分类器相结合，用于预测MTB的抗生素耐药性。所提出的ML方法在独立测试集上针对20种抗生素取得了0.82的平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积。

items.title_en: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
items.title_zh: KernelShift：跨演进硬件的内核优化基准测试
items.abstract_en: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derived from real model executions. KernelShift supports incorporating new kernels and hardware configurations as libraries and processors evolve. We evaluate agents with proprietary and open-weight models across progressively newer architectural extensions (Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2), examining how performance changes as hardware evolves. On established extensions, agents beat the auto-vectorized compiler everywhere (2.4-19.8x) and exceed general-purpose libraries such as ncnn (getting up to 2.74x over its Neon kernels), but fall behind Arm's hand-tuned KleidiAI kernels (0.70x). In end-to-end inference of two LLMs, agent-written kernels achieve a 1.3-1.6x prefill speedup over llama.cpp's fast path. However, current agents do not yet reliably adapt to new extensions that require unfamiliar programming models, such as SME2's matrix tiles.
items.abstract_zh: 高效的AI计算依赖于随时间演进的硬件，这改变了实现高性能代码所需的策略。对于CPU内核，一个关键的演进因素是可用架构扩展的集合，这些扩展暴露专用硬件指令，从而改变用于优化内核的技术。我们研究编码智能体使用这些新的、可能不熟悉的扩展来编写快速代码的有效程度。我们引入KernelShift，一个基准测试流水线和一组环境，用于在演进中的CPU架构上评估编码智能体的内核优化。其智能体辅助、人工验证的流水线将代码仓库转化为基准实例，其环境让智能体利用来自目标硬件的反馈来优化代码。使用该流水线，我们从真实世界中活跃开发的代码仓库（ncnn、llama.cpp、Arm SIMD Loops和KleidiAI）构建了99个内核，包括来自真实模型执行的推理工作负载。随着库和处理器演进，KernelShift支持纳入新的内核和硬件配置。我们在逐步更新的架构扩展（Arm Neon、SVE、SVE2和SME2）上，使用专有模型和开放权重模型评估智能体，考察性能如何随硬件演进而变化。在已有扩展上，智能体在所有情况下都优于自动向量化编译器（2.4–19.8倍），并超过ncnn等通用库（在其Neon内核上最高达到2.74倍），但落后于Arm手工调优的KleidiAI内核（0.70倍）。在两个LLM的端到端推理中，智能体编写的内核相比llama.cpp的快速路径实现了1.3–1.6倍的预填充加速。然而，当前智能体尚不能可靠适应需要不熟悉编程模型的新扩展，例如SME2的矩阵瓦片。

items.title_en: Learning the Next Best Move with Visual Diffusion Models
items.title_zh: 使用视觉扩散模型学习下一最佳走法
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that visual diffusion models can learn to predict the next best move (NBM) in tasks requiring sequential reasoning and lookahead, without explicitly exploring future steps or exhaustive searching at inference. Previous work demonstrated that these models can generate complete solutions to geometric and reasoning problems. Here, we show that simple fine-tuning on visual state--NBM pairs enables a pretrained model to select actions whose value depends on consequences several steps ahead. Each move is predicted directly in image space from the current state, without an explicit symbolic representation or search procedure. Repeated NBM predictions then construct a solution one decision at a time. We demonstrate this capability on chess puzzles and tile-based pathfinding, and show that it extends to Connect Four, Go and billiards. In chess, the model predicts legal moves and finds the best move far more often than by recalling similar training positions, including piece sacrifices whose benefit emerges only through later tactical continuations. In pathfinding, it constructs shortest paths on uniform-cost maps and cost-optimal routes across terrain tiles with different traversal costs, choosing longer routes when they are cheaper overall. These costs are learned implicitly from examples, without numerical cost supervision. These results show that direct visual move prediction can support globally informed decisions and successful sequential problem solving.
items.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们表明视觉扩散模型能够学习在需要序列推理和前瞻的任务中预测下一最佳走法（NBM），而无需在推理时显式探索未来步骤或进行穷举搜索。先前工作已证明这些模型能够为几何和推理问题生成完整解。在此，我们表明，对视觉状态--NBM 对进行简单微调，可使预训练模型选择其价值取决于若干步之后后果的动作。每一步都直接从当前状态在图像空间中预测，无需显式符号表示或搜索过程。重复的 NBM 预测随后一次一个决策地构造解。我们在国际象棋残局题和基于瓦片的路径规划中展示了这一能力，并表明它可扩展到四子棋、围棋和台球。在国际象棋中，该模型预测合法走法并找到最佳走法的频率远高于通过回忆相似训练局面所得，包括其收益仅通过后续战术延续才显现的弃子。在路径规划中，它在均匀代价地图上构造最短路径，并在具有不同通行代价的地形瓦片上构造代价最优路线，在较长路线总体更便宜时选择较长路线。这些代价从示例中隐式学习，无需数值代价监督。这些结果表明，直接视觉走法预测能够支持全局信息支持的决策和成功的序列问题求解。

items.title_en: Large Language Model Extraction and Inference of Physician Global Assessment from Clinical Notes in Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的幼年特发性关节炎临床记录中医生总体评估的提取与推断
items.abstract_en: Background: The physician global assessment (PhGA) is a core outcome measure in juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) but is incompletely captured, even in clinical registries. We developed a large language model (LLM) approach that extracts explicitly documented PhGA from clinical narratives and infers a score where none is recorded. To our knowledge, this is the first study to address both tasks. Methods: We linked charts from 306 children with JIA at one center to the Childhood Arthritis and Rheumatology Research Alliance (CARRA) Registry (2016-2024). A structured prompt was developed on 100 randomly sampled charts, then evaluated on 400 charts from patients not represented in the development set. Extraction used GPT-5.2 within a HIPAA-compliant Azure environment. Registry-recorded PhGA served as the reference standard, with discordances adjudicated by a pediatric rheumatologist blinded to both sources. Agreement was assessed by intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC(2,1)), exact match, and mean absolute error (MAE). Results: Against registry values, ICC(2,1) was 0.87 (95% CI 0.85-0.89; n=400), with 70.5% exact agreement and MAE 0.363. Agreement was near-perfect for explicit extractions (n=190; ICC 0.99; 95% CI 0.98-0.99) and lower for inferred scores (n=210; ICC 0.72; 95% CI 0.64-0.78). Large discordances ([≥]2 points) occurred in 7.3% of cases. Against the adjudicated standard, overall ICC(2,1) was 0.96 (95% CI 0.95-0.97), with 77.5% exact agreement and MAE 0.200. All 14 explicit discordances reflected mismatch between the registry and the clinical note, rather than extraction errors (adjudicated ICC 1.00). For inferred scores, ICC rose to 0.90 (95% CI 0.87-0.92). Residual disagreement was concentrated at the inactive/minimally active boundary. Conclusion: An LLM can reliably extract PhGA from clinical notes with high accuracy to support downstream clinical research, offering a scalable approach to mitigating missingness in patient registries.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：医生总体评估（PhGA）是幼年特发性关节炎（JIA）的核心结局指标，但即使在临床登记中也未被完整采集。我们开发了一种大语言模型（LLM）方法，从临床叙述中提取明确记录的 PhGA，并在未记录评分时推断一个评分。据我们所知，这是首个同时处理这两项任务的研究。方法：我们将一个中心 306 名 JIA 儿童的病历与儿童关节炎和风湿病研究联盟（CARRA）登记库（2016—2024）进行关联。在 100 份随机抽样的病历上开发结构化提示，然后在 400 份来自未出现在开发集中的患者的病历上进行评估。提取使用 HIPAA 合规的 Azure 环境中的 GPT-5.2。登记库记录的 PhGA 作为参考标准，不一致由对两个来源均设盲的儿科风湿病学家裁定。一致性通过组内相关系数（ICC(2,1)）、完全匹配和平均绝对误差（MAE）评估。结果：与登记库值相比，ICC(2,1) 为 0.87（95% CI 0.85–0.89；n=400），完全一致率为 70.5%，MAE 为 0.363。显式提取的一致性接近完美（n=190；ICC 0.99；95% CI 0.98–0.99），推断评分的一致性较低（n=210；ICC 0.72；95% CI 0.64–0.78）。大幅不一致（≥2 分）发生于 7.3% 的病例。与裁定标准相比，总体 ICC(2,1) 为 0.96（95% CI 0.95–0.97），完全一致率为 77.5%，MAE 为 0.200。所有 14 个显式不一致反映的是登记库与临床记录之间的不匹配，而非提取错误（裁定 ICC 1.00）。对于推断评分，ICC 升至 0.90（95% CI 0.87–0.92）。残余分歧集中在非活动/最低活动边界。结论：LLM 能够以高准确度从临床记录中可靠地提取 PhGA，以支持下游临床研究，为减轻患者登记库中的缺失提供可扩展方法。

items.title_en: Localized Strain Tuning of Second-Harmonic Generation in MoS2 Monolayers and Bilayers
items.title_zh: MoS2 单层和双层中二次谐波产生的局域应变调控
items.abstract_en: We investigate the modulation of second-harmonic generation (SHG) in CVD-grown MoS2 monolayers and few-layer flakes through localized mechanical deformation applied by an atomic force microscope (AFM) tip. MoS2 membranes suspended over microstructured Si3N4 substrates allow simultaneous measurements of force and SHG intensity during controlled approach and retraction cycles. Suspended regions exhibit enhanced SHG relative to substrate-supported regions, with pronounced suppression near the clamping boundaries. While the SHG response during compressive loading varies among individual membranes, adhesion-mediated pulling during retraction consistently reduces the SHG intensity until tip detachment, when the signal recovers. By correlating the optical modulation with the measured pull-off force and a phenomenological estimate of effective strain, we obtain a characteristic sensitivity of approximately 12% SHG modulation per 1% effective strain, with comparable behavior in monolayers and bilayers. These findings reveal adhesion-mediated mechanical deformation as a distinct and reversible mechanism for controlling nonlinear optical emission in atomically thin membranes.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究了通过原子力显微镜（AFM）探针施加局域机械变形，对 CVD 生长的 MoS2 单层和少层薄片的二次谐波产生（SHG）的调制。悬浮在微结构 Si3N4 衬底上的 MoS2 膜允许在受控的接近和回撤循环中同时测量力和 SHG 强度。与衬底支撑区域相比，悬浮区域表现出增强的 SHG，在夹持边界附近有明显抑制。虽然压缩加载期间的 SHG 响应因各个膜而异，但回撤期间由黏附介导的拉拽持续降低 SHG 强度，直到探针脱离，此时信号恢复。通过将光学调制与测得的拉脱力和有效应变的唯象估计相关联，我们获得约每 1% 有效应变引起 12% SHG 调制的特征灵敏度，单层和双层中的行为相当。这些发现揭示，黏附介导的机械变形是一种独特且可逆的机制，用于控制原子级薄膜中的非线性光发射。

items.title_en: Making Protocol Effects Explicit: LLM-to-Packet Simulation for Superpod Interconnect Exploration
items.title_zh: 使协议效应显式化：用于超节点互连探索的 LLM-to-Packet 仿真
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of modern AI services. The rapid growth of LLM sizes and context lengths has exceeded the memory capacity of a single GPU or NPU, requiring model partitioning across devices. However, partitioning models across devices introduces costly communication overhead, driving the need for superpods with large-scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency scale-up fabrics. Exploring superpod designs requires accurate interconnect simulation, as communication latency is jointly determined by link technologies, topologies, and scale-up protocol-stack choices. Latency-bandwidth models estimate communication latency using a startup term and a transfer term derived from message size and effective bandwidth. But they fail to capture contention and protocol effects. Packet-level simulators like ns-3 model routing, queueing, and packet timing, but require protocol-specific LLM-to-packet implementations. This paper presents ProtoBridge, an ns-3-based LLM-to-packet simulator for superpod interconnect exploration. To make protocol effects explicit, ProtoBridge introduces two abstraction layers over ns-3: (1) an operation-to-packet (OTP) layer that captures protocol-specific packet exchanges and dependencies, and (2) a packet-execution (PEX) layer that applies shared packet-level mechanisms to the ns-3 event system. ProtoBridge achieves average latency error of 17.8\% on H200 NVLink4 and 10.3\% on C500 MetaXLink. To enable faster superpod evaluation for further interconnect exploration, we derive a surrogate model that combines OTP parameters with analytical models of PEX mechanisms. The surrogate reduces evaluation time from 2.38$\sim$75.70s to 20.5us per operation. We use ProtoBridge to analyze two emerging superpod designs, scale-up memory pool and co-packaged optics (CPO) interconnects, revealing design insights for future LLM superpod architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为现代 AI 服务的基础。LLM 规模和上下文长度的快速增长已超过单个 GPU 或 NPU 的内存容量，需要跨设备划分模型。然而，跨设备划分模型会引入昂贵的通信开销，从而推动对具有大规模、高带宽、低延迟 scale-up 互连结构的超节点的需求。探索超节点设计需要准确的互连仿真，因为通信延迟由链路技术、拓扑和 scale-up 协议栈选择共同决定。延迟-带宽模型使用启动项和由消息大小与有效带宽导出的传输项来估计通信延迟，但它们无法捕捉竞争和协议效应。诸如 ns-3 的数据包级仿真器可对路由、排队和数据包时序建模，但需要针对特定协议的 LLM-to-packet 实现。本文提出 ProtoBridge，一个基于 ns-3 的 LLM-to-packet 仿真器，用于超节点互连探索。为使协议效应显式化，ProtoBridge 在 ns-3 之上引入两个抽象层：（1）操作到数据包（OTP）层，捕捉协议特定的数据包交换和依赖关系；（2）数据包执行（PEX）层，将共享的数据包级机制应用于 ns-3 事件系统。ProtoBridge 在 H200 NVLink4 上实现平均延迟误差 17.8%，在 C500 MetaXLink 上为 10.3%。为实现更快的超节点评估以进一步探索互连，我们推导了一个代理模型，将 OTP 参数与 PEX 机制的分析模型相结合。该代理模型将每次操作的评估时间从 2.38~75.70 秒缩短至 20.5 微秒。我们使用 ProtoBridge 分析两种新兴超节点设计——scale-up 内存池和共封装光学（CPO）互连——揭示了对未来 LLM 超节点架构的设计启示。

items.title_en: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
items.title_zh: NoHairCache：以单一幂律指数实现一次校准的 KV 缓存驱逐
items.abstract_en: The decay exponent $α$ in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-α}$, where $A_i$ is cumulative attention and $α$ controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to $α=0$ and $α\to\infty$, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch). The no-hair mechanism of \citet{xiang2026nohair} bounds the admissible range of $α$, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields $[0.556, 0.822]$ for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). The per-model ranges are consistent across five models (410M--1.5B) and independently match the optimal regions from perplexity sweeps. \textsc{NoHairCache} achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets (WikiText, PG19, and arXiv) without per-dataset tuning, outperforming both H2O and StreamingLLM ($p < 0.05$ on all three datasets, with $0.06$--$0.10$ PPL gains over StreamingLLM at budget $512$). On downstream four-way multiple-choice QA, it matches or outperforms StreamingLLM across all nine (task, budget) cells, retaining $98.2\%$ of full-cache accuracy on NarrativeQA at $25\%$ retention versus $91.1\%$ for StreamingLLM; per-cell McNemar tests are not significant, so QA is corroborating only. We release our calibration script and drop-in scorer upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: KV 缓存驱逐中的衰减指数 α 是模型的内在属性：在单一语料上校准一次后，它可直接跨领域迁移。基于注意力的累积（H2O）和基于近因的滑动窗口（StreamingLLM）是两种主流驱逐框架，常被视为互不相关，但我们表明它们是同一幂律族的两个端点：通过将每个 token 评分为 s_i = A_i · (t−i)^(−α)，其中 A_i 是累积注意力，α 控制年龄惩罚，H2O 和 StreamingLLM 分别对应 α=0 和 α→∞（StreamingLLM 还额外硬编码了一个 attention-sink 补丁）。文献 Xiang 等（2026）的 no-hair 机制界定了 α 的允许范围，且测得的指数与之相符：在 WikiText 上校准一次，对代表性模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）得到 [0.556, 0.822]。各模型的范围在五个模型（410M–1.5B）间一致，并独立匹配困惑度扫描得到的最优区域。NoHairCache 在三个数据集（WikiText、PG19 和 arXiv）上无需按数据集调参即取得最低困惑度，优于 H2O 和 StreamingLLM（在三个数据集上均 p < 0.05；在预算 512 时相对 StreamingLLM 的 PPL 增益为 0.06–0.10）。在下游四选一多项选择问答中，它在全部九个（任务、预算）单元上达到或超过 StreamingLLM，在 NarrativeQA 上以 25% 保留率保持全缓存准确率的 98.2%，而 StreamingLLM 为 91.1%；逐单元 McNemar 检验不显著，因此 QA 仅起佐证作用。我们将在发表时发布校准脚本和即插即用评分器。

items.title_en: A ROS2 based Human-In-The-Loop Framework for UAV Search and Rescue Operations
items.title_zh: 基于 ROS2 的无人机搜救行动人在回路框架
items.abstract_en: Existing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) autonomy frameworks lack human contextual awareness, limiting real-time adaptability in unstructured Search and Rescue (SAR) environments. To address data availability, we propose a Robot Operating System (ROS2)-based human-in-the-loop (HITL) framework that translates human directional gestures (left/right) into UAV navigation commands using RGB-Depth (RGB-D) sensing and YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once). The deprecation of ROS1 necessitates migrating to ROS2, prioritising real-time communication, scalability, and long-term maintainability. Unlike approaches optimised for peak accuracy under ideal conditions, the proposed system prioritises robustness and real-time deployment in degraded SAR environments. Our system achieves 89% confidence in depth estimation under occlusion and varying environmental conditions in Gazebo-PX4 simulations. In foggy conditions, RGB-D fusion consistently provides more informative cues than RGB alone, with an average improvement of 46.7% across all scenarios and distances. The framework demonstrates superior occlusion handling (+15%), adaptive RGB-D fusion, temporal consistency modelling, and real-time deployment via a ROS2 data distribution service (DDS), with end-to-end latency below 50 ms. We evaluate the modified YOLOv11 and the depth-weighted pose estimation on a held-out simulated test set and on real people from the public UAV-GESTURE dataset, in clear air and in Koschmieder fog. Without retraining, the framework reads the gestures of real people with 80% accuracy, depth keeps 77% at a visibility of 10 m where RGB drops to 24%, and the modified YOLOv11 reaches 91% in simulation and 99% on held-out real people when trained on real data. The open-source ROS2 implementation eases the transition of SAR-UAV platforms from ROS1, enabling UAVs to act directly on operator gestures without complex path planning.
items.abstract_zh: 现有的无人机（UAV）自主框架缺乏人类上下文感知，限制了其在非结构化搜救（SAR）环境中的实时适应性。为解决数据可用性问题，我们提出一个基于机器人操作系统（ROS2）的人在回路（HITL）框架，使用 RGB-深度（RGB-D）传感和 YOLOv11（You Only Look Once）将人类方向手势（左/右）转换为 UAV 导航指令。ROS1 的弃用使得迁移到 ROS2 成为必要，并优先考虑实时通信、可扩展性和长期可维护性。与在理想条件下针对峰值准确率优化的方法不同，所提系统优先考虑退化 SAR 环境中的鲁棒性和实时部署。我们的系统在 Gazebo-PX4 仿真中于遮挡和变化环境条件下实现 89% 的深度估计置信度。在有雾条件下，RGB-D 融合始终比仅 RGB 提供更有信息量的线索，在所有场景和距离上平均提升 46.7%。该框架展示了更优的遮挡处理（+15%）、自适应 RGB-D 融合、时间一致性建模，以及通过 ROS2 数据分发服务（DDS）实现的实时部署，端到端延迟低于 50 ms。我们在留出的仿真测试集以及来自公开 UAV-GESTURE 数据集的真人上，在晴空和 Koschmieder 雾条件下评估修改后的 YOLOv11 和深度加权位姿估计。无需重新训练，该框架读取真人手势的准确率为 80%；在能见度 10 m 时，深度保持 77%，而 RGB 降至 24%；修改后的 YOLOv11 在仿真中达到 91%，在真人数据上训练后在留出的真人上达到 99%。开源 ROS2 实现便于 SAR-UAV 平台从 ROS1 迁移，使 UAV 能够直接根据操作员手势行动，无需复杂路径规划。

items.title_en: ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusion Model for Oriented Object Detection
items.title_zh: ReDiffDet：面向有向目标检测的旋转等变扩散模型
items.abstract_en: The diffusion model has been successfully applied to various detection tasks. However, it still faces several challenges when used for oriented object detection: objects that are arbitrarily rotated require the diffusion model to encode their orientation information; uncontrollable random boxes inaccurately locate objects with dense arrangements and extreme aspect ratios; oriented boxes result in the misalignment between them and image features. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReDiffDet, a framework that formulates oriented object detection as a rotation-equivariant denoising diffusion process. First, we represent an oriented box as a 2D Gaussian distribution, forming the basis of the denoising paradigm. The reverse process can be proven to be rotation-equivariant within this representation and model framework. Second, we design a conditional encoder with conditional boxes to prevent boxes from being randomly placed across the entire image. Third, we propose an aligned decoder for alignment between oriented boxes and image features. The extensive experiments demonstrate ReDiffDet achieves promising performance and significantly outperforms the diffusion model baseline.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散模型已成功应用于多种检测任务。然而，将其用于有向目标检测时仍面临若干挑战：任意旋转的目标要求扩散模型编码其方向信息；不可控的随机框无法准确标定密集排列和极端长宽比的目标；有向框导致其与图像特征之间出现错位。为克服这些限制，我们提出 ReDiffDet，一个将有向目标检测表述为旋转等变去噪扩散过程的框架。首先，我们将有向框表示为二维高斯分布，构成去噪范式的基础。在该表示和模型框架内，可证明反向过程是旋转等变的。其次，我们设计带有条件框的条件编码器，以防止框被随机放置在整个图像上。第三，我们提出对齐解码器，用于有向框与图像特征之间的对齐。大量实验表明，ReDiffDet 取得了有前景的性能，并显著优于扩散模型基线。

items.title_en: ELLA-mix: Detecting Cell-to-Cell Heterogeneity in Subcellular RNALocalization
items.title_zh: ELLA-mix：检测亚细胞 RNA 定位中的细胞间异质性
items.abstract_en: Subcellular RNA localization can differ between cells expressing the same gene, yet most analyses summarize transcript positions with a single gene-level pattern. We propose ELLA-mix, a finite mixture model for identifying cell subpopulations with distinct radial localization patterns from imaging-based spatial transcriptomics data. Transcript positions are normalized relative to the cell boundary and modeled using flexible spline densities within a count-conditioned nonhomogeneous Poisson process framework. Conditioning on each cell's transcript count separates differences in localization from differences in abundance. We estimate component densities and cell memberships using an expectation-maximization algorithm and select the number of patterns using the Bayesian information criterion, restricting consideration to models with stable cell assignments and sufficiently distinct components. Simulation studies evaluated the type I error and power of the test for nonuniform localization, as well as the accuracy of selecting the number of mixture components and estimating their radial distributions. ELLA-mix correctly selected the number of components in most simulated settings. In seqFISH+ mouse fibroblasts, ELLA-mix identified distinct cell subpopulations for genes previously assigned a single localization class; genes showing such variation were enriched for endoplasmic reticulum and extracellular matrix functions. In Xenium ovarian cancer tissue, more peripheral localization patterns were associated with higher proportions of proliferating cells, particularly in S phase. These results show how modeling cell-to-cell variation can reveal localization patterns and biological associations obscured by gene-level summaries.
items.abstract_zh: 表达同一基因的细胞之间，亚细胞 RNA 定位可能存在差异，但大多数分析仅用单一基因水平模式概括转录本位置。我们提出 ELLA-mix，一种有限混合模型，用于从基于成像的空间转录组数据中识别具有不同径向定位模式的细胞亚群。转录本位置相对于细胞边界进行归一化，并在以计数为条件的非齐次泊松过程框架内使用灵活样条密度建模。以每个细胞的转录本计数为条件，可将定位差异与丰度差异区分开。我们使用期望最大化算法估计组分密度和细胞归属，并使用贝叶斯信息准则选择模式数量，仅考虑具有稳定细胞分配和足够不同组分的模型。模拟研究评估了非均匀定位检验的 I 类错误和功效，以及选择混合组分数量和估计其径向分布的准确性。ELLA-mix 在大多数模拟设置中正确选择了组分数量。在 seqFISH+ 小鼠成纤维细胞中，ELLA-mix 为先前被分配单一本地化类别的基因识别出不同的细胞亚群；表现出这种变异的基因富集于内质网和细胞外基质功能。在 Xenium 卵巢癌组织中，更偏外周定位的模式与更高比例的增殖细胞相关，尤其是在 S 期。这些结果表明，对细胞间变异建模能够揭示被基因水平汇总所掩盖的定位模式和生物学关联。

items.title_en: Reducing RSA-2048 Factoring Resources Below One Billion Toffolis via LLM-Driven Verifiable Quantum Compilation
items.title_zh: 通过 LLM 驱动的可验证量子编译将 RSA-2048 分解资源降至十亿个 Toffoli 门以下
items.abstract_en: Modular exponentiation dominates the logical cost of factoring 2048-bit RSA integers (RSA-2048) with Shor's algorithm. Recent approaches based on approximate residue number systems (RNS) sharply reduce the required logical qubits, yet still demand billions of Toffoli gates. Optimizing these circuits is difficult because shared ancilla qubits and measurement-based uncomputation tightly couple the arithmetic stages, while rare overflows in compressed registers occur too infrequently for random simulation to detect. Here we use large language model (LLM)-driven search to redesign the RNS pipeline across stages and build a deterministic compiler that produces a Pareto frontier of RSA-2048 circuits. We bound rare overflow probabilities analytically and verify the resulting elementary gate sequences across all constituent RNS primes on representative circuits. Relative to Gidney's 2025 baseline under matched adder accounting, our frontier cuts the minimum qubit-Toffoli product by 70.1% and lowers expected factoring Toffolis by up to 78.6% at matched accumulator precision, bringing RSA-2048 factoring below one billion Toffolis for the first time.
items.abstract_zh: 模幂运算主导了使用 Shor 算法分解 2048 位 RSA 整数（RSA-2048）的逻辑成本。近期基于近似余数系统（RNS）的方法大幅减少了所需逻辑量子比特，但仍需要数十亿个 Toffoli 门。优化这些电路很困难，因为共享辅助量子比特和基于测量的逆计算紧密耦合算术阶段，而压缩寄存器中罕见的溢出发生频率太低，随机模拟无法检测。在这里，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的搜索跨阶段重新设计 RNS 流水线，并构建确定性编译器，生成 RSA-2048 电路的帕累托前沿。我们解析地界定罕见溢出概率，并在代表性电路上跨所有组成 RNS 素数验证所得基本门序列。在匹配加法器核算下相对于 Gidney 2025 基线，我们的前沿将最小量子比特-Toffoli 乘积降低 70.1%，并在匹配累加器精度下将预期分解 Toffoli 数最多降低 78.6%，首次将 RSA-2048 分解降至十亿个 Toffoli 门以下。

items.title_en: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
items.title_zh: Yggdrasil：用于状态跟踪和快速 CPU 推理的树路由循环专家
items.abstract_en: Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. Because each step traverses one tree path and reads a single expert per layer, active weights stay within a few hundred kilobytes in CPU L2 cache while the full bank resides in RAM. Among the parallel-trainable models we evaluate, Yggdrasil is the only one to solve all five state-tracking tasks. At matched active parameter counts, it achieves the lowest test bits on enwik8 (1.540 bpb) and the human genome hg38 (1.567 bpb), while stepping $3.0\times$ and $3.3\times$ faster on a single CPU core ($6.7\,μ\mathrm{s}$ and $5.8\,μ\mathrm{s}$) than the fastest streaming baseline, and delivering the highest GPU throughput of all models at batch 1024. On the Genomic Benchmarks, it is the strongest causal model at matched active parameters (86.0% mean accuracy).
items.abstract_zh: 可并行训练的循环模型（如 Mamba、线性注意力和 DeltaNet）提供恒定成本的流式推理，但存在两个局限：1）难以跟踪离散状态；2）每一步都读取所有参数，使模型容量直接与 CPU 延迟绑定。我们提出 Yggdrasil，一种循环架构，通过在大型、树路由的循环专家库中查找每层的转移，将容量与每步计算解耦。每个路由器使用当前 token 和下层状态来寻址其专家库。我们证明这种跨层上下文是必要的——单个以 token 索引、具有有限可达状态的非扩展转移层无法执行条件重置——同时避免来自该层自身过去的反馈可保持并行扫描训练。由于每一步遍历一条树路径并且每层只读取一个专家，活跃权重保持在 CPU L2 缓存中的几百 KB 以内，而完整专家库驻留在 RAM 中。在我们评估的可并行训练模型中，Yggdrasil 是唯一解决全部五个状态跟踪任务的模型。在匹配活跃参数数量的情况下，它在 enwik8（1.540 bpb）和人类基因组 hg38（1.567 bpb）上取得最低测试比特数，同时在单 CPU 核心上比最快的流式基线快 3.0 倍和 3.3 倍（6.7 μs 和 5.8 μs），并在 batch 1024 时提供所有模型中最高的 GPU 吞吐量。在 Genomic Benchmarks 上，它在匹配活跃参数时是最强的因果模型（平均准确率 86.0%）。

items.title_en: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
items.title_zh: CART：用于分类体系构建的重复叙事聚类分析
items.abstract_en: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 CART，一种计算流水线，用于从议会话语中提取政治叙事，并在不依赖预定义叙事类别的情况下将其组织成数据驱动的分类体系。它使用语义表示编码议会话语，通过无监督置信度估计过滤相关且可靠的内容，使用 LLM 提取叙事陈述，并使用叙事聚类和聚类分析构建叙事分类体系。将其应用于围绕 2023 年 Tempi 火车事故的希腊议会记录，识别出十个重复出现的叙事家族，涉及责任归因、制度失败、铁路安全、问责、私有化以及对悲剧的政治解读。我们的结果表明，将无监督学习与 LLM 叙事提取相结合，能够将大型议会语料转化为可解释、数据驱动的政治叙事分类体系。

items.title_en: BRINA: Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE, a Sonar SLAM for Autonomous Marine Vehicles
items.title_zh: BRINA：结合 AKAZE 的底部参考惯性导航，一种用于自主海洋载具的声呐 SLAM
items.abstract_en: Forward-looking sonar (FLS) provides reliable underwater perception where optical sensing is limited, but its use for navigation is hindered by the unobserved elevation of each return. As a result, motion estimated directly from sonar images suffers from an unknown metric scale that is commonly resolved using a Doppler velocity log (DVL). We present BRINA (Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE), a sonar-inertial SLAM system for marine vehicles that uses the FLS as its only exteroceptive sensor. BRINA estimates the sonar altitude from the first seabed return in each beam and uses it to project matched features onto the seabed, providing metric odometry without a DVL. We further derive a bound relating the remaining scale error to seabed tilt and slope variability. The method is evaluated in simulation with an autonomous underwater vehicle, and in field experiments with uncrewed surface vehicles over ten missions, using two FLS systems under different operating conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 前视声呐（FLS）在光学感知受限的环境中提供可靠的水下感知，但其用于导航受到每个回波高度未观测的阻碍。因此，直接由声呐图像估计的运动存在未知度量尺度，通常使用多普勒速度计（DVL）解决。我们提出 BRINA（Bottom-Referenced Inertial Navigation with AKAZE），一种用于海洋载具的声呐-惯性 SLAM 系统，使用 FLS 作为唯一外感知传感器。BRINA 从每个波束中的首个海底回波估计声呐高度，并利用它将匹配特征投影到海底，从而在没有 DVL 的情况下提供度量里程计。我们进一步推导了一个将剩余尺度误差与海底倾斜和坡度变化联系起来的界。该方法在自主水下载具仿真中以及无人水面载具的十次任务现场实验中进行了评估，使用了两种不同操作条件下的 FLS 系统。

items.title_en: GeoRead3D: Grounding Part Descriptions for 3D Pointing and Reorientation
items.title_zh: GeoRead3D：面向三维指向与重定向的部件描述接地
items.abstract_en: Language often refers to an object by its parts, as in asking to point to a part or to turn an arbitrarily posed object so that two named parts lie in given directions. Both tasks need the direction from the object's center to the part's center, not the part's own orientation. A natural approach segments the part and takes the centroid of its mask. However, high mask overlap predicts the pointing direction poorly when a part is spread out relative to its distance from the object center. Language-guided part segmentation is trained and evaluated by mask overlap, which leaves a gap between the masks it produces and the part geometry that these tasks use. We close this gap by learning point evidence, weights over the observed points whose weighted centroid gives the part's location. Geometric Readout Supervision (GRS) trains these weights through the centroid's position and adds direction supervision on the parts used in reorientation commands. GRS improves both tasks even with a single frozen encoder and a single input pose. We implement this supervision in GeoRead3D, a system for pointing and reorientation from part descriptions. A language model maps each description to a known part name. Dual-Route Part Evidence combines refined segmentation evidence with directly predicted point evidence to locate each part. On PartNeXt and Artiverse, GeoRead3D points within $22.5^\circ$ for 74.1% and 60.0% of queries, 5.8 and 7.3 percentage points above the strongest baselines. Its reorientation success exceeds the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 7.8 points.
items.abstract_zh: 语言经常通过部件来指代物体，例如要求指向某个部件，或转动以任意姿态摆放的物体，使两个指定部件位于给定方向。两个任务都需要从物体中心到部件中心的方向，而不是部件自身的朝向。一种自然方法是分割部件并取其掩码质心。然而，当部件相对于其到物体中心的距离较为分散时，高掩码重叠对指向方向的预测很差。语言引导的部件分割以掩码重叠进行训练和评估，这使其产生的掩码与这些任务所使用的部件几何之间存在差距。我们通过学习点证据来弥合这一差距；点证据是观测点上的权重，其加权质心给出部件位置。几何读出监督（GRS）通过质心位置训练这些权重，并对重定向命令中使用的部件添加方向监督。即使使用单个冻结编码器和单个输入姿态，GRS 也能改善两个任务。我们在 GeoRead3D 中实现该监督，这是一个根据部件描述进行指向与重定向的系统。语言模型将每个描述映射到已知部件名称。双路径部件证据将细化后的分割证据与直接预测的点证据相结合，以定位每个部件。在 PartNeXt 和 Artiverse 上，GeoRead3D 分别对 74.1% 和 60.0% 的查询指向误差在 22.5° 以内，比最强基线高 5.8 和 7.3 个百分点。其重定向成功率分别比最强基线高 10.4 和 7.8 个百分点。

items.title_en: At-home ankle and wrist accelerometry and machine learning capture motor impairment and disease progression in ataxia-telangiectasia
items.title_zh: 居家踝部和腕部加速度计结合机器学习可捕捉共济失调-毛细血管扩张症的运动损伤与疾病进展
items.abstract_en: Background: Ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T) is a rare, childhood-onset neurodegenerative disorder for which sensitive, age-appropriate motor outcome measures are needed to support emerging clinical trials. Clinician-rated ataxia scales are limited by subjectivity, low granularity, and floor and ceiling effects. We evaluated whether at-home wearable accelerometry, combined with machine-learned composite scores derived from submovement features, captures cross-sectional motor impairment and longitudinal disease progression in A-T. Methods: 43 children with classic A-T (median age 9.0 years; IQR 5.7-13.4) and 50 age- and sex-matched controls wore GENEActiv accelerometers on the ankle and wrist during one week of natural behavior at home, repeated at 6- to 12-month intervals. From 85 submovement, activity-intensity, and spectral features per sensor site, we trained composite severity models targeting the Brief Ataxia Rating Scale (BARS) gait subscore (ankle) and BARS total score (wrist). Findings: Ankle composite scores correlated strongly with BARS gait (r = 0.88), BARS total (r = 0.88), and caregiver-reported CPCHILD (r = -0.69); wrist composite scores correlated with BARS total (r = 0.88), BARS arm (r = 0.84), and CPCHILD (r = -0.78). Both models discriminated A-T from controls with large effect sizes (ankle Cohen's d = 2.28; wrist d = 2.98) and demonstrated excellent within-week reliability (ICC = 0.95 ankle; 0.92 wrist). The ankle composite captured disease progression sensitively (Mean-to-Standard Deviation Ratio [MSDR] = 0.98; p < 0.0001). In a matched subset with both sensor and clinical data, ankle composite slopes significantly captured progression (Wilcoxon vs zero, p = 0.0036), whereas BARS total (p = 0.079) and BARS gait (p = 0.30) did not. Interpretation: At-home ankle-based wearable accelerometry provides a sensitive, interpretable, and ecologically valid measure of motor function and disease progression in A-T and may serve as a candidate outcome measure for clinical trials.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：共济失调-毛细血管扩张症（A-T）是一种罕见的儿童期起病神经退行性疾病，需要灵敏且适合年龄的运动结局指标来支持新兴临床试验。临床医生评定的共济失调量表受主观性、粒度低以及地板和天花板效应限制。我们评估了居家可穿戴加速度计，结合由子运动特征衍生的机器学习复合评分，能否捕捉 A-T 的横断面运动损伤和纵向疾病进展。方法：43 名经典型 A-T 儿童（中位年龄 9.0 岁；IQR 5.7–13.4）和 50 名年龄、性别匹配的对照者，在居家自然行为的一周内于踝部和腕部佩戴 GENEActiv 加速度计，并以 6 至 12 个月间隔重复。从每个传感器部位的 85 个子运动、活动强度和频谱特征中，我们训练了复合严重程度模型，分别以 Brief Ataxia Rating Scale（BARS）步态子评分（踝部）和 BARS 总分（腕部）为目标。发现：踝部复合评分与 BARS 步态（r = 0.88）、BARS 总分（r = 0.88）以及照护者报告的 CPCHILD（r = -0.69）强相关；腕部复合评分与 BARS 总分（r = 0.88）、BARS 手臂（r = 0.84）和 CPCHILD（r = -0.78）相关。两个模型均以较大效应量区分 A-T 与对照（踝部 Cohen's d = 2.28；腕部 d = 2.98），并表现出优异的周内可靠性（ICC = 0.95 踝部；0.92 腕部）。踝部复合评分灵敏地捕捉疾病进展（均值与标准差比值 [MSDR] = 0.98；p < 0.0001）。在同时具有传感器和临床数据的匹配子集中，踝部复合评分斜率显著捕捉进展（Wilcoxon 对零检验，p = 0.0036），而 BARS 总分（p = 0.079）和 BARS 步态（p = 0.30）则没有。解释：基于踝部的居家可穿戴加速度计为 A-T 的运动功能和疾病进展提供了一种灵敏、可解释且具有生态效度的测量，并可能作为临床试验的候选结局指标。

items.title_en: Generalized dielectric-dependent hybrid functional combining Gaussian and Yukawa screening
items.title_zh: 结合高斯与汤川屏蔽的广义介电依赖杂化泛函
items.abstract_en: We develop a generalized Coulomb-attenuated method (GCAM) for dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals that combines Gaussian and Yukawa-type screening functions to provide an accurate representation of the random-phase approximation (RPA) dielectric function. Through systematic fitting to RPA dielectric functions of semiconductors and insulators, and to the Lindhard dielectric function of the homogeneous electron gas, we demonstrate that GCAM significantly reduces errors in the model dielectric function across the full momentum range. However, despite this improved physical description of screening, band gap calculations reveal that GCAM yields larger errors compared to experiment than previous CAM approaches for wide-gap materials, but smaller errors for most narrow-gap materials. This counterintuitive result demonstrates that the success of CAM stems not purely from physical reasons, but also from a partial cancellation of errors. In contrast, for optical absorption spectra calculated within a model Bethe-Salpeter equation framework, GCAM systematically outperforms CAM, showing better agreement with the reference spectra obtained with the diagonal RPA screening in both peak positions and relative intensities. Our findings reveal the important role of error cancellation in dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals.
items.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种用于介电依赖杂化泛函的广义库仑衰减方法（GCAM），它结合高斯型和汤川型屏蔽函数，以准确表示随机相位近似（RPA）介电函数。通过对半导体和绝缘体的 RPA 介电函数以及均匀电子气的 Lindhard 介电函数进行系统拟合，我们证明 GCAM 在整个动量范围内显著降低了模型介电函数的误差。然而，尽管这种屏蔽的物理描述有所改进，带隙计算表明，对于宽禁带材料，GCAM 与实验相比的误差大于先前的 CAM 方法，但对于大多数窄禁带材料误差更小。这一反直觉结果表明，CAM 的成功并非纯粹源于物理原因，也源于误差的部分抵消。相比之下，对于在模型 Bethe-Salpeter 方程框架内计算的光吸收谱，GCAM 系统性地优于 CAM，在峰位置和相对强度上均与使用对角 RPA 屏蔽获得的参考谱更一致。我们的发现揭示了误差抵消在介电依赖杂化泛函中的重要作用。

items.title_en: Attacking Tabular Foundation Models: An Experimental Taxonomy of Context Poisoning and Test-Time Evasion
items.title_zh: 攻击表格基础模型：上下文投毒与测试时规避的实验性分类体系
items.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models condition predictions on labeled examples supplied at inference time, creating an attack surface that differs from conventional model training. We study four manipulation families (label flipping, backdoor context poisoning, clean-label context selection, and test-time evasion) and organize them by attack stage, label consistency, and distributional realism. TabPFN-2.5, TabICL, and XGBoost are evaluated on CIC-IDS2017 and N-BaIoT using a common preprocessing and evaluation pipeline. Backdoor context poisoning provides strong targeted control over the in-context models with little change in clean accuracy, whereas selecting real, correctly labeled boundary-crowding rows causes no systematic accuracy degradation up to a 20% bias fraction. A simplified surrogate-transfer constrained PGD attack inspired by, but not equivalent to, CAPGD also produces test-time evasion, outperforming equal-budget random noise in most settings. The comparison shows that attack effectiveness depends strongly on both where manipulation occurs and how much freedom the attacker has to alter the data.
items.abstract_zh: 表格基础模型以推理时提供的带标签样本为条件进行预测，形成了不同于传统模型训练的攻击面。我们研究四类操纵（标签翻转、后门上下文投毒、干净标签上下文选择以及测试时规避），并按攻击阶段、标签一致性和分布真实性对它们进行组织。使用统一的预处理和评估流程，在 CIC-IDS2017 和 N-BaIoT 上评估 TabPFN-2.5、TabICL 和 XGBoost。后门上下文投毒对上下文内模型提供强定向控制，而干净准确率几乎不变；相比之下，选择真实、标签正确且拥挤在边界附近的行，在偏差比例高达 20% 时未造成系统性准确率下降。一种受 CAPGD 启发但不等同于 CAPGD 的简化代理迁移约束 PGD 攻击也能产生测试时规避，在大多数设置下优于等预算随机噪声。比较表明，攻击有效性强烈取决于操纵发生的位置以及攻击者改变数据的自由度。

items.title_en: Task-Dependent Linguistic Measures in Aphasia Discourse: A Comparative Analysis of Narrative, Descriptive, and Procedural Speech
items.title_zh: 失语症话语中的任务依赖性语言指标：叙事、描述与程序性言语的比较分析
items.abstract_en: Background: Transcript-based measures such as word counts, lexical diversity and disfluency rates are widely used to describe language ability in aphasia. Each measure comes from a specific elicitation task, and studies use different tasks, so values from different tasks may not be comparable. Aims: To test whether discourse tasks change these measures within the same speakers, and whether the measures follow a gradient from Procedural to Descriptive to Narrative discourse. Methods & Procedures: Baseline transcripts from 61 adults with chronic post-stroke aphasia were taken from the Fridriksson-2 corpus in AphasiaBank (POLAR trial, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03416738). Each speaker produced a Procedural (Sandwich), a Descriptive (Broken Window) and a Narrative (Cinderella) sample in one session. A rule-based pipeline extracted 13 measures, 10 of which were common enough to test. Friedman, Page and Wilcoxon tests with false discovery rate correction were used, with a speaker-grouped Random Forest classifier as a supporting check. Outcomes & Results: Total words and number of different words followed the full gradient, but the step from Procedural to Descriptive was small. For most other measures, Narrative stood apart, while Descriptive and Procedural did not differ. Among the 31 speakers with at least 25 words in every task, filler rate, repetition rate and total disfluency density were higher in Narrative than in both other tasks. The classifier reached an accuracy of 0.61 (always guessing the most common task would give 0.41), mainly by recognizing Narrative samples. Conclusions: Discourse tasks are not interchangeable, and expressing disfluencies per word does not remove the task effect. The task should be reported with every measure, and values should be compared only within the same task.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：基于转录文本的指标，如词数、词汇多样性和不流畅率，被广泛用于描述失语症患者的语言能力。每个指标来自特定的诱发任务，而研究使用不同任务，因此不同任务的数值可能不可比较。目的：检验话语任务是否会在同一说话者内改变这些指标，以及这些指标是否遵循从程序性到描述性再到叙事性话语的梯度。方法与程序：61 名慢性卒中后失语症成人的基线转录文本取自 AphasiaBank 中的 Fridriksson-2 语料库（POLAR 试验，ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03416738）。每位说话者在一次会话中产生一个程序性（Sandwich）、一个描述性（Broken Window）和一个叙事性（Cinderella）样本。基于规则的流程提取了 13 个指标，其中 10 个足够常见可供检验。使用经错误发现率校正的 Friedman、Page 和 Wilcoxon 检验，并以按说话者分组的随机森林分类器作为辅助检查。结果：总词数和不同词数遵循完整梯度，但从程序性到描述性的变化较小。对于大多数其他指标，叙事性话语表现突出，而描述性与程序性没有差异。在每个任务中至少有 25 个词的 31 名说话者中，叙事性话语的填充词率、重复率和总不流畅密度均高于另外两个任务。分类器达到 0.61 的准确率（始终猜测最常见任务将得到 0.41），主要通过识别叙事性样本。结论：话语任务不可互换，按词表示不流畅并不能消除任务效应。每个指标都应报告其所用任务，并且数值只应在同一任务内比较。

items.title_en: Personalization of a Commercial Powered Knee Prosthesis Under Clinically Realistic Conditions via Reinforcement Learning: A Feasibility Study
items.title_zh: 通过强化学习在临床现实条件下个性化商用动力膝关节假体：一项可行性研究
items.abstract_en: Personalization of powered prosthesis control to individual user needs remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, policy iteration with constraint embedded (PICE), a reinforcement learning (RL) tuning approach, has been developed and validated. This feasibility study investigated whether the developed approach can personalize a commercial powered knee prosthesis under clinically realistic conditions. To reduce the time for personalization, tuning was initialized with a policy learned offline from one non-disabled participant walking on a treadmill and was then applied to three other non-disabled participants walking with the knee through a bypass adapter on a 5-meter walkway. All participants reached the goal within 8-18 tuning steps (1.7-4.2 minutes of walking), reducing the knee-kinematic feature error by 64-90% on average. These results support the feasibility of implementing the RL-based tuning approach in clinically realistic conditions with space and equipment constraints.
items.abstract_zh: 将动力假体控制个性化到个体用户需求仍是一项重大挑战。为应对这一挑战，已开发并验证了一种嵌入约束的策略迭代（PICE）强化学习（RL）调参方法。本可行性研究调查了所开发方法能否在临床现实条件下个性化商用动力膝关节假体。为减少个性化时间，调参以从一名非残疾参与者在跑步机上行走离线学习的策略初始化，然后应用于另外三名非残疾参与者，他们通过旁路适配器在 5 米步道上佩戴该膝关节行走。所有参与者均在 8–18 个调参步骤内达到目标（行走 1.7–4.2 分钟），平均将膝关节运动学特征误差降低 64–90%。这些结果支持在具有空间和设备限制的临床现实条件下实施基于 RL 的调参方法的可行性。

items.title_en: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
items.title_zh: 通过互信息最大化进行自监督数据集蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.
items.abstract_zh: 数据集蒸馏（DD）旨在将大型数据集压缩为小型合成数据集，且该合成数据集仍能有效用于训练神经网络。尽管在监督学习中取得了成功，DD在自监督学习（SSL）中仍研究不足；在SSL中，蒸馏数据必须保留学习在数据增强下保持一致的表示所需的信息。为弥合这一差距，我们提出互信息原型对齐（MIPA），一种高效的SSL数据集蒸馏方法，它优化合成图像以保留增强不变信息。具体而言，MIPA将合成图像视为可学习原型，并使用冻结编码器根据特征相似度将真实样本分配给这些原型。一个保留这种增强不变性的合成数据集，应在同一真实图像的多个增强视图上产生稳定的原型分配。MIPA通过最大化跨视图分配之间的互信息来鼓励这一点，同时避免所有真实样本仅被分配给少数合成原型的平凡解。在图像分类基准上的评估表明，MIPA生成的合成数据比现有蒸馏方法产生更高质量的表示，同时减少蒸馏过程中的时间和存储需求。

items.title_en: Generalizable mapping of the Epileptogenic Zone from interictal Intracranial EEG using an implant topology-aware Transformer
items.title_zh: 使用植入拓扑感知Transformer从发作间期颅内EEG可泛化映射致痫区
items.abstract_en: Presurgical localization of the epileptogenic zone remains a central challenge in drug-resistant focal epilepsy. At the same time, the abundant interictal intracranial EEG (iEEG) data routinely acquired during presurgical evaluation remain an underexploited source of localizing information. We developed an iEEG implant topology-aware transformer that combines interictal iEEG features with electrode coordinates to predict resection targets. The model was trained exclusively on three public datasets (n = 476) and tested on cohorts from five independent centers across three countries (n = 216). In patients with favorable surgical outcomes (Engel I; n = 120), the median area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) was 0.71, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.92, outperforming interictal spike rate and clinically defined seizure-onset zone baselines in patients with favorable outcomes (P < 0.05 for both AUPRC and AUROC). Patients with unfavorable outcomes (Engel II-IV; n = 96) had lower prediction-resection alignment (median AUPRC, 0.42), and their highest confidence predictions were located farther from resected tissue (P = 0.005). These findings establish a generalizable framework that integrates neural activity and brain topology to identify epileptogenic tissue from interictal recordings, potentially improving surgical success rates and reducing reliance on resource-intensive seizure capture.
items.abstract_zh: 致痫区的术前定位仍是耐药性局灶性癫痫的核心挑战。同时，术前评估期间常规获取的大量发作间期颅内EEG（iEEG）数据仍是尚未充分利用的定位信息来源。我们开发了一种iEEG植入拓扑感知Transformer，将发作间期iEEG特征与电极坐标相结合以预测切除靶点。该模型仅在三个公共数据集（n = 476）上训练，并在来自三个国家五个独立中心的队列（n = 216）上测试。在手术结局良好的患者（Engel I；n = 120）中，精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）中位数为0.71，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.92，在结局良好的患者中优于发作间期棘波率和临床定义的发作起始区基线（AUPRC和AUROC的P < 0.05）。结局不良的患者（Engel II-IV；n = 96）的预测-切除对齐度较低（AUPRC中位数，0.42），并且其最高置信度预测位于距离切除组织更远的位置（P = 0.005）。这些发现建立了一个可泛化的框架，该框架整合神经活动和脑拓扑，从发作间期记录中识别致痫组织，可能提高手术成功率并减少对资源密集型癫痫发作捕捉的依赖。

items.title_en: Molecular Pawns on a Surface Chessboard: Computational Investigation of Nanographenes with Atomistic Methods
items.title_zh: 表面棋盘上的分子棋子：用原子级方法对纳米石墨烯的计算研究
items.abstract_en: Atomically precise nanographenes combine tunable electronic topology with localized, coherent spin states, making them candidate platforms for molecular quantum technologies. This review examines the multiscale theoretical framework governing these systems: the hierarchy of computational methods for describing magnetic properties, the substrate-molecule interface, on-surface synthetic kinetics, and supramolecular self-assembly. We highlight how density functional theory, automated reaction-path discovery, and spin-aware machine-learned interatomic potentials connect static electronic structure to mesoscale dynamics, and how magnetic exchange, optical excitations, and spin transport can be predicted before synthesis.
items.abstract_zh: 原子级精确的纳米石墨烯结合了可调电子拓扑与局域相干自旋态，使其成为分子量子技术的候选平台。本综述考察支配这些系统的多尺度理论框架：用于描述磁性的计算方法的层级、基底-分子界面、表面合成动力学以及超分子自组装。我们强调密度泛函理论、自动反应路径发现和自旋感知的机器学习原子间势如何将静态电子结构与介观尺度动力学联系起来，以及如何在合成前预测磁交换、光激发和自旋输运。

items.title_en: BQDNA: Multi-Head Binary Spherical Quantization for Genomic Sequence Modeling
items.title_zh: BQDNA：用于基因组序列建模的多头二值球面量化
items.abstract_en: Decoding biological information from long, repetitive DNA remains challenging. Genomic language models (gLMs) often follow the conventional language-model pretrain-and-adapt paradigm. However, the lack of inherent semantic segmentation and prior rules makes hand-crafted tokenizers like k-mer and BPE suboptimal. We introduce context-aware \textbf{BQVAE} for scalar quantization of DNA and \textbf{BQDNA}, an autoregressive gLM supporting multi-head codebooks. Comprehensive experiments reveal that: (1) unique training dynamics of vector quantization in DNA space, including the importance of alignment between training corpus and downstream data. (2) superior performance of BQVAE over hand-crafted tokenizers and vanilla VQVAE. (3) remarkable cross-species generalization capability of BQDNA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with merely 0.1B multi-species training for BQVAE and 1 epoch training on hg38 for BQDNA, outperforming gLMs pretrained with 10$\sim$100x more tokens. Our findings underscore the potential of learned vector quantization for genomic sequence representation. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/BQDNA
items.abstract_zh: 从长且重复的DNA中解码生物信息仍然具有挑战性。基因组语言模型（gLM）通常遵循传统的语言模型预训练与适配范式。然而，缺乏固有的语义分割和先验规则使得k-mer和BPE等手工设计的标记器并非最优。我们提出用于DNA标量量化的上下文感知BQVAE，以及支持多头码本的自回归gLM BQDNA。综合实验揭示：（1）DNA空间中向量量化的独特训练动态，包括训练语料与下游数据之间对齐的重要性。（2）BQVAE优于手工设计标记器和普通VQVAE的性能。（3）BQDNA显著的跨物种泛化能力，其仅需对BQVAE进行0.1B多物种训练、对BQDNA在hg38上训练1个epoch，便达到最先进性能，优于使用多10~100倍token预训练的gLM。我们的发现强调了学习型向量量化在基因组序列表示中的潜力。代码见 https://github.com/Sophie10001b/BQDNA

items.title_en: Learn the Effects, Not the Examples: Implicit ICL via Attention Patching
items.title_zh: 学习效果而非示例：通过Attention-Patching实现隐式ICL
items.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, but repeatedly including multiple examples increases context length and inference cost. Many existing implicit ICL methods encode demonstrations as fixed vectors, limiting adaptation of the intervention to individual queries and token positions. We propose Attention-Patching, an implicit ICL method that models contextual changes in self-attention outputs through task-specific updates to attention output projections. Using query-answer pairs processed with and without a fixed demonstration set, Attention-Patching fits layer-wise affine transformations from non-contextual attention representations to the demonstration-induced output changes. Across 12 classification benchmarks and four model families, Attention-Patching achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated implicit ICL baselines while maintaining performance comparable to explicit ICL at near zero-shot inference cost. Further experiments on diverse generation tasks demonstrate its applicability to autoregressive multi-token generation.
items.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）使语言模型能够从演示中适应新任务，但重复包含多个示例会增加上下文长度和推理成本。许多现有的隐式ICL方法将演示编码为固定向量，限制了干预对单个查询和token位置的适应。我们提出Attention-Patching，一种隐式ICL方法，它通过任务特定的注意力输出投影更新来建模自注意力输出的上下文变化。使用在有和没有固定演示集的情况下处理的查询-答案对，Attention-Patching拟合从非上下文注意力表示到演示诱导的输出变化的逐层仿射变换。在12个分类基准和四个模型家族上，Attention-Patching取得的平均准确率高于所评估的隐式ICL基线，同时在接近零样本推理成本下保持与显式ICL相当的性能。在多种生成任务上的进一步实验证明了其适用于自回归多token生成。

items.title_en: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
items.title_zh: CoSel：将合作作为选择用于端到端驾驶
items.abstract_en: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.
items.abstract_zh: 合作驾驶可以将车辆的感知范围扩展到自身传感器之外，但现有的合作端到端方法将共享信息注入规划器，并依赖合作驾驶演示来学习如何使用这些信息。在此类数据中，共享信息应改变驾驶决策的时刻很少，这为学习该行为提供的监督有限。我们认为合作不必由规划器学习。相反，对共享信息作出反应需要预测周围智能体将如何移动，并从自车规划器的候选轨迹中选择响应。我们提出CoSel，一种“合作即选择”框架，它使规划器及其仅自车输入保持不变。一个单独训练的合作预测器使用来自自车、路侧单元和网联自动驾驶车辆的观测来预测周围智能体及其未来运动。CoSel根据这些预测评估规划器的候选轨迹，在规划器的选择仍然安全时保留该选择，并在共享信息揭示额外风险时选择最接近的安全备选方案。每次安全干预都可追溯到触发它的共享证据。在闭环评估中，CoSel在V2Xverse上取得70.7的驾驶得分，比最佳对比合作方法高7.5分，并在MDrive上取得85.8的最高平均驾驶得分。在自车检测缺失的情况下，CoSel在72个场景中的碰撞次数仅从17增加到19，而现有合作端到端模型则从19增加到32。

items.title_en: HoloSplat: Real-Time Token Streaming for Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction
items.title_zh: HoloSplat：面向前馈人体重建的实时令牌流式传输
items.abstract_en: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs. Existing approaches, whether relying on per-frame optimization or feed-forward inference, generate massive 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming limits, while aggressive compression severely degrades rendering quality. In this work, we present HoloSplat, a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video. HoloSplat splits a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, introducing a multi-rate streaming codec driven by server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server side, we apply opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding for token anchors. On the client side, a feature reconstruction hypernetwork is fused into the Gaussian head to recover compression-induced quality loss. Furthermore, we introduce Neural Session Calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views during a warm-up phase. This resolves quality degradation from novel camera parameters and varying capture conditions with zero per-frame overhead. In our evaluations, HoloSplat averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s. It decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, transmitting 22.8$\times$ less data than uncompressed float32 Gaussians, while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB.
items.abstract_zh: 人类实时自由视点视频流式传输可实现沉浸式远程呈现和交互式XR应用。然而，这需要实时重建每一帧、在严格带宽预算内传输数据，并在轻量级客户端GPU上解码。现有方法无论依赖逐帧优化还是前馈推理，都会生成超出实际流式传输限制的海量3D高斯负载，而激进压缩会严重降低渲染质量。在本工作中，我们提出HoloSplat，一种面向以人为中心的体积视频实时流式传输框架。HoloSplat在其高斯头之前拆分前馈重建器，引入由服务端令牌压缩和客户端令牌恢复驱动的多速率流式编解码器。在服务端，我们采用不透明度引导的令牌剪枝、基于PCA的降维，以及针对令牌锚点的无损几何编码。在客户端，将特征重建超网络融合到高斯头中，以恢复压缩引起的质量损失。此外，我们引入神经会话校准（Neural Session Calibration, NSC），其在预热阶段利用传入的相机视角在线快速微调高斯头。这以零逐帧开销解决了新相机参数和变化采集条件导致的质量下降。在我们的评估中，HoloSplat在50 Mbit/s下于四块RTX 5090 GPU上平均达到32.2 FPS。在RTX 3050 Ti笔记本GPU上，其每帧解码为3D高斯耗时22.1 ms，传输的数据量比未压缩float32高斯少22.8倍，而校准解码将PSNR提高1.050 dB。

items.title_en: Survival after deceased-donor kidney transplantation versus continued waiting among candidates with kidney failure attributed to renal cell carcinoma
items.title_zh: 肾细胞癌所致肾衰竭候选者接受死亡供者肾移植与继续等待的生存比较
items.abstract_en: Background: Among transplant candidates with kidney failure attributed to renal cell carcinoma (RCC), we investigated whether deceased-donor kidney transplantation was associated with longer survival than continued waiting and whether the association varied by kidney donor profile index (KDPI). Methods: We studied adult kidney-alone candidates listed in 2005-2025 in the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network registry (follow-up through March 31, 2026) whose coded cause of kidney failure was RCC, versus all other candidates. Time-dependent Cox models compared transplantation with waiting. Calendar-aligned sequential trials with propensity overlap weighting estimated survival after transplantation with a KDPI [≤]85% kidney versus continued waiting. Results: Of 599,887 candidates, 1,542 had RCC-attributed kidney failure (614 deaths). Of these, 597 received a KDPI [≤]85% kidney and 38 received a KDPI >85% kidney. A KDPI [≤]85% transplant was associated with lower mortality than waiting (hazard ratio [HR] 0.51, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.42 to 0.62). The HR was 0.53 in other candidates (interaction P = 0.86). Five-year survival was 83.1% after transplantation and 67.0% with continued waiting (difference, 16.0 percentage points, 95% CI 11.8 to 20.1). The restricted mean survival time difference was 5.8 months (95% CI 4.4 to 7.4). For KDPI >85%, the HR was 1.65 (95% CI 0.87 to 3.13). Conclusions: Transplantation with a KDPI [≤]85% kidney was associated with about 16 additional survivors per 100 RCC candidates at 5 years. The estimate for KDPI >85% was imprecise. Tumor stage and cancer-free interval were unavailable.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：在因肾细胞癌（RCC）导致肾衰竭的移植候选者中，我们研究死亡供者肾移植是否与较继续等待更长的生存期相关，以及该关联是否随肾脏供者特征指数（KDPI）而变化。方法：我们研究了2005—2025年在美国器官获取与移植网络（Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network）登记处登记的成人单纯肾脏候选者（随访至2026年3月31日），其编码的肾衰竭病因为RCC，并与所有其他候选者进行比较。使用时依Cox模型比较移植与等待。采用倾向性重叠加权的日历对齐序贯试验，估计接受KDPI≤85%肾脏移植与继续等待后的生存期。结果：在599,887名候选者中，1,542名患有RCC所致肾衰竭（614例死亡）。其中，597名接受了KDPI≤85%的肾脏，38名接受了KDPI>85%的肾脏。接受KDPI≤85%移植与较等待更低的死亡率相关（风险比[HR] 0.51，95%置信区间[CI] 0.42至0.62）。其他候选者中的HR为0.53（交互作用P=0.86）。移植后5年生存率为83.1%，继续等待为67.0%（差异16.0个百分点，95% CI 11.8至20.1）。限制性平均生存时间差异为5.8个月（95% CI 4.4至7.4）。对于KDPI>85%，HR为1.65（95% CI 0.87至3.13）。结论：接受KDPI≤85%肾脏移植与5年时每100名RCC候选者中约增加16名生存者相关。KDPI>85%的估计不精确。肿瘤分期和无癌间期数据不可获得。
