items.title_en: Programmable Broadband Polarization-Preserving Optical Delay Line with Faraday Mirrors
items.title_zh: 基于法拉第镜的可编程宽带保偏振光延迟线
items.abstract_en: We report a broadband optical delay line programmable for delays up to 1 μs with nanosecond resolution, while preserving an arbitrary and unknown polarization state of the original light. The delay line comprises bidirectional pass in cascaded segments of standard single-mode fibers, along with terminal reflection from Faraday mirrors (FMs) at both ends. Each segment contains either a short path or a long path, selected by an optical switch. The FMs auto-compensate for random polarization fluctuations introduced by the optical fibers, thereby restoring the initial polarization state. Broadband operation of the delay line was assessed by investigating dispersion of both the fiber and the FMs. Surprisingly, we found that the two-pass propagation in the fiber can mitigate dispersive distortion introduced by the FM. Numerical experiments demonstrated that the output polarization state of the delay line has a mean fidelity better than 99% over a range of 50-nm deviation from the central wavelength. Remarkably, the mean fidelity often surpasses that in the absence of the fiber itself.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报道了一种可编程宽带光延迟线，可实现高达1 μs、具有纳秒分辨率的延迟，同时保持原始光的任意且未知偏振态。该延迟线由标准单模光纤级联分段中的双向传输以及两端法拉第镜（FM）的终端反射构成。每个分段包含短路径或长路径，由光开关选择。FM自动补偿光纤引入的随机偏振波动，从而恢复初始偏振态。通过研究光纤和FM的色散，评估了延迟线的宽带运行。令人惊讶的是，我们发现光纤中的双程传播可以减轻FM引入的色散失真。数值实验表明，在偏离中心波长50 nm的范围内，延迟线输出偏振态的平均保真度优于99%。值得注意的是，平均保真度通常超过没有光纤本身时的情况。

items.title_en: A General Non-Stationary Channel Model for Autonomous Vehicle Communications in Underground Spaces
items.title_zh: 地下空间中自动驾驶车辆通信的通用非平稳信道模型
items.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles exhibit high mobility and environmental adaptability, making them well-suited for underground inspection and rescue missions. In this paper, a general three-dimensional (3D) non-stationary geometry-based stochastic model (GBSM) is proposed for autonomous vehicle communications in underground spaces. The proposed channel model accounts for the 3D mobility of autonomous vehicles and can be adapted to pillar, tunnel, and cave scenarios. To characterize the structural and physical features of underground spaces, the proposed model incorporates the generation and evolution of spatially dispersed and/or directionally confined clusters along with their constituent specular/dense multipath components (SMCs/DMCs). Additionally, the proposed channel model considers channel non-stationarity, waveguide effect, and near-field/far-field effects. Statistical properties, including space-time-frequency correlation functions (STF-CFs), delay/angular/Doppler power spectral densities (PSDs), root mean square (RMS) delay spread, and stationary interval, are derived and analyzed. The validity of the proposed channel model is substantiated through comparative analysis between measurement and simulation results.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶车辆具有高机动性和环境适应性，使其非常适合地下巡检与救援任务。本文针对地下空间中的自动驾驶车辆通信，提出一种通用三维（3D）非平稳几何随机模型（GBSM）。所提出的信道模型考虑了自动驾驶车辆的3D移动性，并可适配柱状、隧道和洞穴场景。为表征地下空间的结构与物理特征，所提模型纳入了空间分散和/或方向受限簇及其构成镜面/密集多径分量（SMC/DMC）的生成与演化。此外，所提信道模型考虑了信道非平稳性、波导效应以及近场/远场效应。推导并分析了统计特性，包括空时频相关函数（STF-CF）、时延/角度/多普勒功率谱密度（PSD）、均方根（RMS）时延扩展和平稳区间。通过测量与仿真结果的对比分析，验证了所提信道模型的有效性。

items.title_en: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
items.title_zh: 可检测的认知攻击层：对话历史完整性的覆盖定理与标准化测试框架
items.abstract_en: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption at or below 1.2 percent with zero false positives and zero utility loss. Second, in the exploratory instruction-override extension, the gates' boundary is a cliff: directives rephrased without shape markers bypass them at control-equivalent rates, 47.7 to 49.5 percent against 0.0 percent for the shaped class, placing that class in the model-internal lane. Third, the deterministic core is storage-layer detection at 126 of 126 per model with zero false positives. External anchors reproduce published attack pressure, with PoisonedRAG falling from 70 to 0 percent under the full stack. For practitioners: authenticate stored history and content provenance with deterministic tiers, scope instruction-layer mitigation to provenance-gated designs whose measured benign cost is zero, and monitor composition at the trajectory level rather than per fragment. All protocols and acceptance criteria are pre-registered; the stack and harness are released.
items.abstract_zh: 对话历史是基础设施：已部署的语言模型依赖应用层存储并重新注入先前的轮次，而该存储状态是可写的。我们按攻击层对会话级污染进行形式化，陈述一个覆盖定理，并测量其范围：每个部署层验证层级恰好覆盖其自身层，并且相对于其他层是可靠的；指令覆盖无法在不产生假阳性的情况下被检测到；组合向量可规避逐片段验证。一个标准化测试框架应用于8个机制族、涵盖3,249个会话和3个模型族，使这些主张可被检验。第一，基于模式检测付出了经测量的假阳性代价：经典防御将35%至50%的良性会话标记为异常，而朴素拒绝下限仅达到2.4%的攻击单元采纳率，同时破坏33%至100%的良性轮次，相比之下，来源门控的通道分离实现采纳率不高于1.2%，且零假阳性和零效用损失。第二，在探索性指令覆盖扩展中，门控的边界呈断崖式：不含形状标记的改写指令以与对照相当的比例绕过门控，为47.7%至49.5%，而有形状类别为0.0%，这将后者置于模型内部通道。第三，确定性核心是存储层检测，每个模型126/126，零假阳性。外部锚点复现了已发表的攻击压力，在全栈下PoisonedRAG从70%降至0%。对实践者而言：使用确定性层级对已存储历史和内容来源进行认证，将指令层缓解限定于经测量良性成本为零的来源门控设计，并在轨迹层面而非逐片段层面监测组合。所有协议和验收标准均已预注册；该技术栈和测试框架已发布。

items.title_en: One Policy, Many Bodies: Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Heterogeneous Teams
items.title_zh: 一种策略，多种身体：异构团队中的协作式人-物交互
items.abstract_en: Physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) has enabled multiple characters to cooperatively transport objects, but existing cooperative controllers largely assume homogeneous embodiments and predefined interaction tasks. We ask whether a single physics-based policy can enable cooperation across diverse embodiments, team compositions, and interaction skills. We present MorphHOI, a decentralised framework built on a key insight: effective heterogeneous cooperation requires a unified representation across embodiments while accounting for differences in their physical capabilities. To realise this insight, we introduce a canonical body interface that unifies observation and action spaces, together with an embodiment-conditioned transformer that adapts cooperative decisions to the physical capabilities of each agent and its teammates. To extend cooperation to new interaction skills, we reuse the learned cooperative policy through task-specific tokens and lightweight adaptation, preserving its original capabilities. Our framework achieves success rates of up to 96.7\% on seen embodiments, 95.6\% on unseen embodiments, and 91.4\% on novel payloads. Furthermore, the learned cooperation extends to diverse interaction skills with high success rates, including box carrying, transport on stairs, and waypoint following, while preserving previously acquired cooperative capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 基于物理的人-物交互（HOI）已使多个角色能够协作搬运物体，但现有协作控制器大多假设同质具身形态和预定义交互任务。我们研究单一基于物理的策略是否能够实现跨多样具身形态、团队组成和交互技能的合作。我们提出MorphHOI，一个基于关键洞见的去中心化框架：有效的异构协作需要跨具身形态的统一表示，同时考虑其物理能力差异。为实现这一洞见，我们引入一个规范身体接口，以统一观测空间和动作空间，并引入一种以具身为条件的Transformer，使协作决策适配每个智能体及其队友的物理能力。为将合作扩展到新的交互技能，我们通过任务特定令牌和轻量适配复用了已学习的协作策略，同时保留其原始能力。我们的框架在已见具身形态上达到最高96.7%的成功率，在未见具身形态上达到95.6%，在新载荷上达到91.4%。此外，所学合作扩展到多样交互技能并具有高成功率，包括搬运箱子、楼梯运输和航点跟随，同时保留先前获得的协作能力。

items.title_en: Field-Level Crop Classification via Similarity-Induced Supervision from Imperfect Labels
items.title_zh: 基于不完美标签的相似性诱导监督的田块级作物分类
items.abstract_en: Regional-scale crop mapping is critical for food production monitoring, yet remains challenging in tropical regions, where persistent cloud cover limits optical imagery. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) enables continuous observation throughout the agricultural cycle, but a second obstacle is label quality: national-scale land cover products exhibit systematic biases that underestimate less prevalent crops, and training directly on them inherits and amplifies their errors. This work proposes a methodology to build large-scale crop classification models from imperfect public land cover products, requiring no new field campaign, ground survey, or manual label correction. The approach combines two mechanisms. The first reduces the semantic inconsistency of the labels by shifting supervision from the sample level to the group level: a similarity-based clustering model organizes SAR time series into coherent groups, and noisy labels are used only to assign each group its most representative class. The resulting clusters are highly pure with respect to the reference classes (89.0% and 91.2% in the two study regions). The second reduces the spatial inconsistency of the predictions: a segmentation model delineates crop field boundaries from optical imagery, and patch-level predictions are consolidated by majority voting within each field, yielding spatially coherent maps. Evaluated in two Brazilian municipalities, Campo Verde (Mato Grosso) and Luís Eduardo Magalhães (Bahia), the approach consistently outperforms the noisy baseline in mean class accuracy, with gains of up to 10.14 percentage points, especially for minority crops. A state-scale analysis across Mato Grosso and Bahia shows stable behavior without further model adjustment, and the derived municipal crop areas are consistent with official IBGE/PAM statistics, an independent estimate the model never observes.
items.abstract_zh: 区域尺度作物制图对粮食生产监测至关重要，但在热带地区仍具挑战性，因为持续的云覆盖限制了光学影像。合成孔径雷达（SAR）能够在整个农业周期内进行连续观测，但第二个障碍是标签质量：国家级土地覆盖产品存在系统性偏差，会低估较不普遍的作物，直接在其上训练会继承并放大其误差。本工作提出一种从有缺陷的公开土地覆盖产品构建大规模作物分类模型的方法，无需新的野外调查、地面测量或人工标签校正。该方法结合两种机制。第一种通过将监督从样本级转移到组级来降低标签的语义不一致性：基于相似性的聚类模型将SAR时间序列组织为一致的组，含噪标签仅用于为每个组分配最具代表性的类别。所得聚类相对于参考类别具有高纯度（在两个研究区域分别为89.0%和91.2%）。第二种降低预测的空间不一致性：分割模型从光学影像中勾画作物田块边界，并通过在每个田块内多数投票合并地块级预测，生成空间连贯的制图结果。在两个巴西市镇Campo Verde（马托格罗索州）和Luís Eduardo Magalhães（巴伊亚州）评估，该方法在平均类别精度上持续优于含噪基线，提升最高达10.14个百分点，尤其是对少数作物。在馬托格羅索州和巴伊亚州进行的州尺度分析显示出稳定行为而无需进一步模型调整，且导出的市级作物面积与官方IBGE/PAM统计数据一致，而该独立估计是模型从未观测到的。

items.title_en: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Automates Artifact Correction for Clinical Body Surface Gastric Mapping at Scale
items.title_zh: 不确定性感知深度学习在规模化临床体表胃映射中实现伪影校正自动化
items.abstract_en: Body surface gastric mapping (BSGM) enables non-invasive measurement of gastric electrophysiology, but signals are approximately 100 times weaker than cardiac potentials and overlap spectrally with motion artifacts, necessitating labor-intensive manual review that limits clinical scalability. We present an uncertainty-aware deep learning framework to automate artifact correction in high-resolution BSGM. A signal reconstruction network was paired with a parallel uncertainty estimation network, trained on 2,398 multihour, 64-channel recordings from 27 international clinical sites using weak supervision, a physiology-aware loss function, and uncertainty-gated quality control. In an independent cohort of 127 patients, per-patient signal reconstruction error was 29% lower than with the industry-standard Wiener filter (10.3% vs 14.6%; lower in 103 patients), and remained lower when both filters retained identical samples (9.8% vs 14.6%). Amplitude-movement correlation was 23% lower. Changing only the filter raised the rhythm index across the cohort and robustly altered automated clinical phenotyping in 7.1% of patients, mostly by removing dysrhythmic classifications from artifact-affected recordings. Uncertainty-aware deep learning enables reliable automated artifact correction in body surface gastric mapping, improving signal fidelity and enabling scalable clinical interpretation. The system is FDA-cleared (510(k) K252504) and deployed in clinical practice, demonstrating that data-driven artifact correction can meet regulatory requirements for medical devices and reduce dependence on specialist manual review.
items.abstract_zh: 体表胃映射（BSGM）能够无创测量胃电生理，但信号比心电电位弱约100倍，并在频谱上与运动伪影重叠，因此需要耗费大量人工复核，限制了临床可扩展性。我们提出一种不确定性感知深度学习框架，用于自动化高分辨率BSGM中的伪影校正。一个信号重建网络与一个并行不确定性估计网络配对，使用来自27个国际临床中心的2,398段多小时的64通道记录，通过弱监督、生理感知损失函数和不确定性门控质量控制进行训练。在一个由127名患者组成的独立队列中，逐患者信号重建误差比行业标准维纳滤波器低29%（10.3%对14.6%；在103名患者中更低），并且当两种滤波器保留相同样本时仍更低（9.8%对14.6%）。幅度-运动相关性低23%。仅更换滤波器就使整个队列的节律指数升高，并在7.1%的患者中稳健地改变了自动化临床表型分型，主要通过从受伪影影响的记录中去除节律异常分类。不确定性感知深度学习能够在体表胃映射中实现可靠的自动化伪影校正，提高信号保真度并实现可扩展的临床解读。该系统已获FDA许可（510(k) K252504）并部署于临床实践，证明数据驱动的伪影校正能够满足医疗器械的监管要求并减少对专家人工复核的依赖。

items.title_en: Floquet dark-mode manipulation in a three-mode optomechanical system
items.title_zh: 三模光机械系统中的Floquet暗模操控
items.abstract_en: We propose a Floquet sideband method to manipulate the dark-mode effect in a three-mode optomechanical system consisting of a single cavity mode coupled to two mechanical modes. We introduce a periodic frequency modulation for one mechanical mode to generate the Floquet sidebands, one of which is selected to match the resonance frequency of the other mechanical mode, allowing complete destructive interference to produce a mechanical dark mode decoupled from the cavity mode. The semiclassical operating point is determined self-consistently within the framework for linearization of optomechanical interaction, and the linear stability is examined under the rotating-wave approximation. We evaluate the validity of the approximate Hamiltonian by examining the fidelity between the states governed by the approximate and exact Hamiltonians. We further demonstrate dark-mode control by inspecting the bright/dark-mode populations of the system, when a frequency detuning is introduced suddenly. These results may provide a basis for further study of quantum-state storage using the Floquet mechanical dark modes.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种Floquet边带方法，用于操控由单个腔模与两个机械模耦合组成的三模光机械系统中的暗模效应。我们对一个机械模引入周期性频率调制以产生Floquet边带，并选择其中一个边带与另一个机械模的共振频率匹配，从而实现完全相消干涉，产生与腔模解耦的机械暗模。在线性化光机械相互作用的框架内自洽地确定半经典工作点，并在旋转波近似下检验线性稳定性。我们通过考察由近似哈密顿量和精确哈密顿量所支配状态之间的保真度，评估近似哈密顿量的有效性。我们进一步通过检查突然引入频率失谐时系统的亮模/暗模布居来演示暗模控制。这些结果可为利用Floquet机械暗模进行量子态存储的进一步研究提供基础。

items.title_en: Structural Agreement Indicates Prediction Accuracy For Protein-Ligand Co-Folding
items.title_zh: 结构一致性指示蛋白质-配体共折叠的预测准确性
items.abstract_en: Co-folding models predict the structures of proteins and their bound ligands, but their accuracy varies across targets. Their usefulness therefore depends on knowing which predictions a user can trust. Confidence scores are intended to guide that choice. However, across seven co-folding models, we show that confidence-based selection offers little improvement over choosing a prediction at random. For approximately three-quarters of structures, predictions are either exclusively correct or incorrect, leaving no opportunity for ranking to change the outcome. Moreover, high confidence does not reliably discriminate correct top-ranked predictions from incorrect ones. We find that structural agreement among predictions is a more accurate measure of likely success than current confidence scores. We capture this with the Concentration of Repeated Ensembles (CORE) Score, which combines cluster tightness with ensemble support. CORE Score discriminates top-1 success and oracle success, achieving mean ROC AUCs of 0.866 and 0.838, compared to 0.757 and 0.759 for ipTM. CORE Score also outperforms training set similarity measures, including ligand Tanimoto, protein sequence, and Runs N' Poses similarity, despite requiring no experimental ligand pose. Structural agreement is therefore a practical indicator of reliability and a baseline for evaluating future confidence estimators, without requiring an additional trained uncertainty estimator.
items.abstract_zh: 共折叠模型预测蛋白质及其结合配体的结构，但其准确性因靶标而异。因此，其实用性取决于知道用户可信任哪些预测。置信度分数旨在指导这一选择。然而，在七个共折叠模型中，我们表明基于置信度的选择相比随机选择预测几乎没有改进。对于大约四分之三的结构，预测要么完全正确要么完全错误，没有机会通过排序改变结果。此外，高置信度不能可靠地区分正确的排名第一预测与错误预测。我们发现，预测之间的结构一致性是比当前置信度分数更准确的潜在成功度量。我们用重复集成集中度（CORE）分数来刻画这一点，该分数结合了聚类紧密度与集成支持度。CORE分数能区分top-1成功和oracle成功，平均ROC AUC分别为0.866和0.838，而ipTM为0.757和0.759。CORE分数也优于训练集相似性度量，包括配体Tanimoto、蛋白质序列和Runs N' Poses相似性，尽管不需要实验配体姿态。因此，结构一致性是可靠性的实用指标，也是评估未来置信度估计器的基线，且不需要额外训练的不确定性估计器。

items.title_en: HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models
items.title_zh: HGDNA：用于高效自回归基因组语言模型的重叠k-mer分词
items.abstract_en: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA
items.abstract_zh: 基因组语言模型（gLM）领域发展迅速，在多样多物种基因组语料上预训练的模型已展示出显著能力。虽然简单核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已得到充分确立，但重叠k-mer分词在因果预训练中仍研究不足，尽管其具有丰富的邻域信息。在此，我们重新深入审视重叠分词，并引入HGDNA，一种混合线性注意力gLM，具有因果语言建模（CLM）预训练和用于下游适配的共享标记预测接口，采用物种分类辅助任务和共享类别标记。HGDNA在序列分类和冻结嵌入评估中提供有竞争力的性能，以30M参数和19B预训练token支持短程和长程任务。代码见https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA

items.title_en: Calibrating World Action Models: From Adaptive System 2 Takeover to Self-Evolution
items.title_zh: 校准世界动作模型：从自适应System 2接管到自我演化
items.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) deliver fast visuomotor control, yet degrade sharply in challenging scenes and act blindly when about to fail; conversely, foundation-model-based agents generalize and recover reliably, but incur prohibitive latency and cost when queried at every step. To achieve both WAM (System 1)-level speed and agent (System 2)-level reliability--- we propose \textbf{\oursfull (\ours)}, a framework that calibrates WAMs' confidence--- adaptively triggering System~2 only when necessary, and distilling System~2's knowledge to form an evolving System~1. First, \ours equips a frozen WAM with \textbf{calibrated self-assessment}: a single lightweight judgment token reading internal video--action features is trained via our proposed \textbf{cross-fitted temporal-difference (TD) learning} using only binary rollout success/failure signals. It can predict a \textbf{calibrated success probability} at negligible overhead without affecting action predictions. Second, this calibrated success probability schedules control chunk by chunk---invoking System~2 to resolve bottlenecks when confidence drops, and handing control back to the WAM once confidence recovers, preserving WAM-like speed while approaching System~2 reliability. Third, as System~2 intervenes only when the WAM lacks confidence, its takeover trajectories directly capture the WAM's capability gaps. JiL distills these takeovers into the WAM to repair those gaps so System~1 can operate standalone without System~2 at test time, while our mastered-skill anchoring and dynamic confidence gating prevent degrading existing capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）提供快速的视觉运动控制，但在挑战性场景中性能急剧下降，并在即将失败时盲目行动；相反，基于基础模型的智能体能够泛化并可靠恢复，但每一步都查询时会带来过高的延迟和成本。为同时实现WAM（System 1）级速度和智能体（System 2）级可靠性——我们提出\textbf{\oursfull（\ours）}，一个校准WAM置信度的框架——仅在必要时自适应触发System 2，并将System 2的知识蒸馏以形成不断演化的System 1。首先，\ours为冻结的WAM配备\textbf{校准自评估}：一个读取内部视频-动作特征的单一轻量判断标记，仅使用二元rollout成功/失败信号，通过我们提出的\textbf{交叉拟合时序差分（TD）学习}训练。它能够以可忽略的开销预测\textbf{校准成功概率}，且不影响动作预测。其次，该校准成功概率逐块调度控制——当置信度下降时调用System 2以解决瓶颈，一旦置信度恢复则将控制交还给WAM，从而保持类WAM速度，同时接近System 2可靠性。第三，由于System 2仅在WAM缺乏置信度时介入，其接管轨迹直接捕获WAM的能力缺口。JiL将这些接管蒸馏到WAM中以修复这些缺口，使System 1在测试时无需System 2即可独立运行，同时我们已掌握技能锚定和动态置信度门控可防止降低现有能力。

items.title_en: RigidAnchor: Cross-View Geo-Localization for UAV via Iterative Planar Rigid Alignment
items.title_zh: RigidAnchor：通过迭代平面刚性对齐实现无人机跨视角地理定位
items.abstract_en: A UAV that flies without GNSS has to estimate its absolute position and heading without any external signal. Most existing methods for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization (U-S CVGL) treat the task as image retrieval: they compress the UAV image and each satellite tile into separate descriptors, rank the tiles by their similarity, and return the center of the best tile. The output can therefore only lie on a pre-defined grid, its accuracy is limited by the tile size, and no heading is produced. Regressing the pose in a single pass removes the grid, but it leaves no chance to correct the estimate afterwards. We observe that satellite tiles are not independent samples. They are laid on the map at a fixed spacing, scale and orientation, so neighboring tiles join into one continuous satellite block with a consistent metric, and a nadir UAV view of that block differs from it by a planar rigid transform only, i.e. a 2D translation plus an in-plane rotation. We therefore reformulate U-S CVGL as solving for this transform between two images of different sizes. Position and heading then become parts of one geometric quantity, and the accuracy is no longer limited by the tile grid. We propose RigidAnchor, which solves the transform iteratively. The network encodes the two images and builds a multi-level correlation pyramid between them. At each iteration, it indexes the pyramid with every aerial cell carried through the current estimate, pools the descriptors of all cells into one hidden state, and lets two decoupled heads predict a translation increment and a rotation increment, the latter being composed rather than added. On Bearing-UAV-90K, the cross-view mean errors are 78.6% lower in position and 69.7% lower in heading than Bearing-UAV, and HSR@15 increases by 19.06 points. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor.
items.abstract_zh: 在没有GNSS的情况下飞行的无人机必须在没有任何外部信号时估计其绝对位置和航向。大多数现有的无人机到卫星跨视角地理定位（U-S CVGL）方法将任务视为图像检索：它们将无人机图像和每个卫星瓦片压缩为单独的描述符，按相似度对瓦片排序，并返回最佳瓦片的中心。因此，输出只能位于预定义网格上，其精度受瓦片大小限制，且不产生航向。单次回归位姿消除了网格，但之后没有机会校正估计。我们观察到卫星瓦片不是独立样本。它们以固定间距、尺度和方向铺设在地图上，因此相邻瓦片连接成一个具有一致度量的连续卫星块，而该块的无人机正下视视图与其仅相差一个平面刚性变换，即二维平移加平面内旋转。因此，我们将U-S CVGL重新表述为求解两个不同大小图像之间的该变换。位置和航向随之成为一个几何量的一部分，精度不再受瓦片网格限制。我们提出RigidAnchor，它迭代求解该变换。网络编码两幅图像并在它们之间构建多级相关金字塔。在每次迭代中，它用经当前估计变换后的每个航拍单元索引金字塔，将所有单元的描述符池化为一个隐藏状态，并让两个解耦头预测平移增量和旋转增量，后者是复合而非相加。在Bearing-UAV-90K上，与Bearing-UAV相比，跨视角平均误差在位置上降低78.6%，在航向上降低69.7%，HSR@15提高19.06个点。代码见 https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor。

items.title_en: Direct tumour-adipocyte contact / Stroma AReactive Invasion Front Areas (TAC/SARIFA) in advanced oropharyngeal cancer
items.title_zh: 晚期口咽癌中的肿瘤-脂肪细胞直接接触/间质无反应性浸润前沿区域（TAC/SARIFA）
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Stroma areactive invasion front areas (SARIFA) are a histopathological phenomenon at the tumour invasion front characterised by direct tumour-adipocyte contact (TAC). It can be detected on histological Haematoxylin-Eosin (H&E) stained tumour slides. TAC/SARIFA has emerged as a strong negative prognostic factor in several tumour entities. In this monocentric retrospective study, we aim to elucidate the impact of TAC/SARIFA in oropharyngeal cancer. Materials and methods: 78 cases of pT3 to pT4 oropharyngeal squamous cell cancer from 2005 to 2023 and their corresponding lymph nodes were analysed for the occurrence of TAC/SARIFA. Besides, we compared overall survival rates, recurrence-free survival (RFS) and association with biological and pathological tumour characteristics. Results: In total, overall survival was significantly reduced in TAC/SARIFA-positive tumours (p=0.014). Moreover, TAC/SARIFA positive primary tumours are associated with TAC/SARIFA positive lymph nodes (p<0.001) and extranodal extension (ENE) (p=0.032). Finally, RFS in TAC/SARIFA-positive tumours was reduced, but not significantly (p=0.072). No significant difference was found between p16 positive and p16 negative tumours and prevalence of TAC/SARIFA. Conclusion: TAC/SARIFA is a possible prognostically relevant risk factor in oropharyngeal cancer. When detected in the primary tumour or lymph nodes, it is associated with reduced overall survival rates and tendency towards shorter RFS. TAC/SARIFA-positive lymph nodes almost always show ENE.
items.abstract_zh: 引言：间质无反应性浸润前沿区域（SARIFA）是肿瘤浸润前沿的一种组织病理学现象，其特征是肿瘤-脂肪细胞直接接触（TAC）。它可在组织学苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色的肿瘤切片上检测到。TAC/SARIFA已在多种肿瘤实体中成为强负预后因素。在这项单中心回顾性研究中，我们旨在阐明TAC/SARIFA在口咽癌中的影响。材料和方法：分析2005年至2023年78例pT3至pT4口咽鳞状细胞癌及其相应淋巴结中TAC/SARIFA的发生情况。此外，我们比较了总生存率、无复发生存期（RFS）以及与生物学和病理学肿瘤特征的关联。结果：总体上，TAC/SARIFA阳性肿瘤的总生存显著降低（p=0.014）。此外，TAC/SARIFA阳性原发肿瘤与TAC/SARIFA阳性淋巴结（p<0.001）和结外侵犯（ENE）（p=0.032）相关。最后，TAC/SARIFA阳性肿瘤的RFS降低，但不显著（p=0.072）。p16阳性与p16阴性肿瘤之间以及TAC/SARIFA的患病率之间未发现显著差异。结论：TAC/SARIFA是口咽癌中可能具有预后意义的风险因素。当在原发肿瘤或淋巴结中检测到时，它与总生存率降低和RFS较短的趋势相关。TAC/SARIFA阳性淋巴结几乎总是显示ENE。

items.title_en: Dark and bright solitons in a multimodal lithium tantalate microresonator
items.title_zh: 多模态钽酸锂微谐振器中的暗孤子和亮孤子
items.abstract_en: Bright-soliton and dark-pulse microcombs provide complementary outputs. Integrating both states in a single resonator would expand the operating capabilities of an integrated coherent source, but requires opposite group-velocity-dispersion (GVD) channels while reconciling localized interfamily interaction for dark-pulse formation with spectral isolation for independent bright-soliton pumping. Wavelength-addressed access to both states is achieved in a LiTaO$_3$ microring through two TE-like transverse mode families. The higher-order TE$_{10}$ family fulfills two distinct roles in different spectral regions. Within localized avoided-mode-crossing regions, mode-resolved spectroscopy implicates TE$_{10}$ in perturbing the normal-GVD TE$_{00}$ resonance sequence. Away from these regions, TE$_{10}$ retains anomalous GVD and remains spectrally isolated as an independently pumpable bright-soliton channel; at representative pump resonances, the closest resonance of the non-addressed family is separated by 75--192 loaded cavity linewidths. With the input polarization held fixed, pumping TE$_{00}$ and TE$_{10}$ resonances generates dark-pulse and bright-soliton microcombs, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental realization of a dark-pulse microcomb in an integrated LiTaO$_3$ microring. These results establish transverse-mode-family engineering as a route to combining localized modal interaction with independent spectral addressing in a single microresonator.
items.abstract_zh: 亮孤子和暗脉冲微梳提供互补输出。在单个谐振器中集成这两种状态将扩展集成相干源的工作能力，但需要相反的群速度色散（GVD）通道，同时要协调用于暗脉冲形成的局域跨族相互作用与用于独立亮孤子泵浦的光谱隔离。通过两个类TE横模族，在LiTaO3微环中实现了对两种状态的波长寻址访问。高阶TE10族在不同光谱区域发挥两种不同作用。在局域避免模式交叉区域内，模式分辨光谱表明TE10参与扰动正常GVD的TE00共振序列。远离这些区域，TE10保持反常GVD，并作为可独立泵浦的亮孤子通道保持光谱隔离；在代表性泵浦共振处，非寻址族最近的共振相隔75–192个加载腔线宽。在输入偏振保持固定时，泵浦TE00和TE10共振分别产生暗脉冲和亮孤子微梳。据我们所知，这是集成LiTaO3微环中暗脉冲微梳的首次实验实现。这些结果确立了横模族工程作为在单个微谐振器中将局域模式相互作用与独立光谱寻址相结合的途径。

items.title_en: Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model
items.title_zh: 使用物理引导的条件去噪扩散概率模型进行洪水预报
items.abstract_en: High-resolution flood forecasting with full two-dimensional shallow water equation (SWE) solvers remains computationally expensive, even on GPUs. We develop a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) that forecasts the evolution of 30 m water-depth fields over a four-day horizon for the Des Plaines River watershed, Illinois. The model is trained on SynxFlow SWE simulations of 113 historical storms observed across twelve Midwestern states (2003-2024), each under three antecedent-wetness scenarios, and can optionally be conditioned on coarse 100 m or 150 m hydrodynamic simulations. Because reverse diffusion is stochastic, every forecast is a 20-member ensemble drawn from the same trained model. Coarse conditioning reduces the four-day mean water-depth RMSE of the ensemble mean from 0.170 m to 0.054 m (100 m) and 0.048 m (150 m). The coarser 150 m conditioning also gives the best critical success index (0.839), false alarm ratio, CRPS and Brier score at lower cost, so finer conditioning does not guarantee better skill. Averaging members reduces error by 5-11% relative to a single realization, and the ensemble provides spatially explicit exceedance probabilities, although the ensembles are under-dispersive (spread-to-error ratios 0.35-0.73). On a single GPU, a four-day forecast over 26 non-overlapping patches is 7.8x, 11.0x and 16.3x faster than the 30 m simulation for the 100 m, 150 m and unconditioned configurations, and projected speedups for a 14-day forecast reach 12-49x for one member and 48-58x for 20 members. Physics-guided diffusion models are thus promising probabilistic surrogates for regional-scale flood forecasting.
items.abstract_zh: 使用完整二维浅水方程（SWE）求解器进行高分辨率洪水预报，即使在GPU上仍然计算昂贵。我们开发了一个条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），用于预报伊利诺伊州德斯普兰斯河流域30 m水深场在四天时域内的演变。该模型在SynxFlow SWE模拟上训练，这些模拟涵盖十二个中西部州（2003–2024）观测到的113场历史风暴，每场风暴在三种前期湿度情景下，并可选择以粗分辨率100 m或150 m流体动力学模拟为条件。由于反向扩散是随机的，每个预报都是从同一训练模型抽取的20成员集合。粗条件化将集合平均的四天平均水深RMSE从0.170 m降至0.054 m（100 m）和0.048 m（150 m）。更粗的150 m条件化还以更低成本给出最佳临界成功指数（0.839）、误报率、CRPS和Brier分数，因此更细的条件化并不保证更好的技巧。与单次实现相比，对成员取平均可将误差降低5–11%，集合提供空间显式的超越概率，尽管集合是欠离散的（离散度与误差比为0.35–0.73）。在单个GPU上，对26个不重叠分块进行四天预报，在100 m、150 m和无条件配置下分别比30 m模拟快7.8倍、11.0倍和16.3倍，而14天预报的预计加速比对于单个成员达到12–49倍，对于20个成员达到48–58倍。因此，物理引导扩散模型是区域尺度洪水预报有前景的概率代理模型。

items.title_en: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
items.title_zh: 利用循环残差释放预训练大语言模型中循环的潜力
items.abstract_en: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.
items.abstract_zh: 循环Transformer迭代共享层块以在不增加参数的情况下增加计算，提供更强性能和测试时扩展。然而，这种能力迄今需要从头训练，并且对LLM仅带来适度增益。将现有模型微调为循环要便宜得多，但相比SFT也仅带来边际增益。我们提出LoopRes，一种有效、可扩展且简单的方法，将循环转化为预训练LLM显著且一致的增益。基于Attention Residuals，LoopRes让每个循环层直接关注更早循环的输出。由于这些输出是相同层的迭代结果并变得更难区分，我们为每个输出赋予一个可训练的循环感知键，编码其结构身份。关注所有更早循环还让层可以跳过中间循环，因此我们将每层限制在最新W个循环的残差窗口内，迫使每个循环在近期循环基础上增量构建。在来自3个模型族的6个预训练LLM和9个基准上，LoopRes带来显著且一致的增益：在2倍计算下，它将Qwen3-1.7B-Base相比SFT提升29.1%，超过最先进基线增益的两倍。这些增益在最大30B的更大模型上以及所有三个模型族中保持。更重要的是，从1.7B到8B，随着计算增长，LoopRes的扩展比SFT更陡峭，达到更高上限，同时在长输出上需要更少计算。这些结果确立LoopRes为一种有效的循环方法，同时提供更好的性能和更好的测试时扩展。

items.title_en: PushMimic: Learning Adaptive Humanoid Box Pushing via Dynamic Motion Augmentation and Reference Distillation
items.title_zh: PushMimic：通过动态运动增强和参考蒸馏学习自适应人形机器人推箱
items.abstract_en: Humanoid box pushing is challenging when the physical properties of the task, such as the box mass and the ramp inclination, are unknown before the push begins. This paper presents PushMimic, a framework that learns adaptive humanoid box pushing from a single level-ground kinematic reference motion. The learned policy adapts its pushing posture to these properties without observing them. PushMimic augments the reference motion into a dynamically feasible motion dataset over these properties with sampling-based trajectory optimization, and distills the dataset into one motion tracking policy in one stage of training. Simulation results over box masses from 5 to 15 kg and ramp inclinations up to 15 degrees show that PushMimic raises the success rate from 57.8% to 88.8% compared with a baseline that tracks the original reference motion. It also reduces the cost of push of the arms by 22%. Hardware experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that the policy adapts its torso pitch during continuous pushing on an inclined treadmill, with box masses up to 19 kg and ramp inclinations up to 12.6 degrees. PushMimic therefore needs only one reference motion, instead of one for every box mass and ramp inclination.
items.abstract_zh: 当推箱任务的物理属性（如箱子质量和斜坡倾角）在推动开始前未知时，人形机器人推箱具有挑战性。本文提出PushMimic，一个从单个水平地面运动学参考运动学习自适应人形机器人推箱的框架。学习到的策略可在不观测这些属性的情况下使其推动姿态适应这些属性。PushMimic通过基于采样的轨迹优化，将参考运动增强为在这些属性上动态可行的运动数据集，并在一个训练阶段中将该数据集蒸馏为一个运动跟踪策略。在箱子质量5至15 kg、斜坡倾角最高15度的仿真结果表明，与跟踪原始参考运动的基线相比，PushMimic将成功率从57.8%提高到88.8%。它还将手臂推动成本降低22%。在Unitree G1人形机器人上的硬件实验表明，该策略在倾斜跑步机上连续推动时调整其躯干俯仰，箱子质量最高19 kg，斜坡倾角最高12.6度。因此，PushMimic只需要一个参考运动，而不是为每个箱子质量和斜坡倾角各需要一个参考运动。

items.title_en: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
items.title_zh: 写入、演化、读取：将相机流式传输为持久世界状态以进行4D占据预测
items.abstract_en: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld
items.abstract_zh: 4D占据预测预测驾驶场景未来几秒的3D语义占据。在几秒内，场景变化很小而车辆移动，因此前方大部分空间已经被看到。将未来分为不变、变化和未见的空间，我们发现当前基于相机的世界模型在不变部分表现不足：它们未能保持已经看到的内容，而不是预测将会变化的内容。因此，我们让模型已经看到的内容成为其状态。PersistWorld将相机帧流式传输到锚定在场景中的持久3D世界状态，每帧写入一次，而不是从过去的帧重建状态。该状态与预测端到端学习，演化器在自车轨迹上任意查询时间预测该状态。在Occ3D-nuScenes上，PersistWorld将最佳基于相机的世界模型的IoU在1-3秒提高19个点，在最长8秒提高18到24个点，同时运行速度提高两倍以上。代码和模型：https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld。项目页面：https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

items.title_en: A generative framework for unified representations bridging electrophysiological and haemodynamic brain activity
items.title_zh: 一种用于统一表征的生成框架，桥接电生理与血流动力学脑活动
items.abstract_en: Electrophysiological and haemodynamic recordings resolve brain activity at complementary temporal and spatial scales, yet paired acquisition remains difficult to scale. We propose a generative framework that aligns paired multimodal recordings in a unified representation space and generates modality-specific haemodynamic responses from EEG. In paired cohorts, the framework generated fMRI BOLD and fNIRS haemoglobin responses that reproduced regional dynamics, cortical maps, functional connectivity and task structure. Generated BOLD followed Real BOLD time courses and cortical patterns, while Generated haemoglobin responses tracked task-evoked HbO and HbR dynamics. The framework enabled decoding across visual, motor-imagery and mental-arithmetic tasks, independent-record decoding, external BOLD localization and low-sample augmentation. Paired feature-space calibration supported bidirectional retrieval. The proposed framework extends cortical analysis and brain decoding to EEG recordings when Real haemodynamic data are sparse.
items.abstract_zh: 电生理和血流动力学记录在互补的时间与空间尺度上解析脑活动，但配对采集仍然难以规模化。我们提出一种生成框架，在统一表征空间中对齐配对的多模态记录，并从EEG生成模态特定的血流动力学响应。在配对队列中，该框架生成fMRI BOLD和fNIRS血红蛋白响应，重现了区域动力学、皮层映射、功能连接和任务结构。生成的BOLD遵循真实BOLD的时间过程和皮层模式，而生成的血红蛋白响应跟踪任务诱发的HbO和HbR动力学。该框架支持跨视觉、运动想象和心理算术任务的解码、独立记录解码、外部BOLD定位和低样本增强。配对特征空间校准支持双向检索。当真实血流动力学数据稀疏时，所提出的框架将皮层分析和脑解码扩展到EEG记录。

items.title_en: Quantum-Memory Forensics for Tampered Quantum Seals: Resource-Dependent Sample Gains
items.title_zh: 针对被篡改量子封印的量子记忆取证：资源依赖的样本增益
items.abstract_en: Quantum seals reveal that an object was disturbed, but not where, with which tool, or when the tool changed. We study quantum-memory forensics for sealed items returning through an untrusted network where one tool opens many. Each seal cell is half of a Bell pair whose partner the verifier keeps in a protected quantum memory, a secret Pauli frame turns any attack into a Pauli channel, and a three-tier report localizes the tampering, learns a hidden-parity fingerprint of the tool and detects a tool switch in arrival order, not necessarily in attack order. Attribution concerns attackers who do not erase that fingerprint, which a random Pauli layer would do cheaply. Each result is stated within one of four verifier classes. For per-unit verifiers, which never couple two seal units and hold no untouched reference, the sample separation is asymptotically exponential, by reduction from a known lower bound for one parity of strength up to 1/3. On ten tampered cells it is proved to be at least \qnProvedUniformMin-fold against non-adaptive stabilizer probes and observed in simulation at \qnEoneRatioFine-fold. Against an implemented self-referencing strategy the simulated gain is about twice the inverse squared strength. The value also depends on the attack: destroying the untouched cells makes the reference necessary, whereas copying errors exposes the fingerprint to reference-free probes. We derive the vault's qubit inventory and simulate a seal requirement curve: ten times more seal noise lengthens the seal's lifetime \qnSealLifeGainFive-fold at \qnSealRhoFive{} times the attribution cost at $r=10$.
items.abstract_zh: 量子封印揭示一个物体被扰动，但不揭示在何处、用哪种工具或工具何时改变。我们研究量子记忆取证，针对通过不受信网络返回的密封物品，其中一种工具打开许多物品。每个封印单元是贝尔对的一半，验证者将配对的一半保存在受保护的量子存储器中，一个秘密泡利框架将任何攻击转化为泡利信道，三层报告定位篡改、学习工具的隐藏奇偶指纹，并按到达顺序（不一定是攻击顺序）检测工具切换。归因关注不擦除该指纹的攻击者，随机泡利层可以廉价地做到这一点。每个结果都在四类验证者之一中陈述。对于逐单元验证者（从不耦合两个封印单元且不持有未触碰参考），样本分离渐近指数，通过归约自一个强度至多1/3的奇偶性的已知下界。在十个被篡改单元上，证明至少为\qnProvedUniformMin倍，对抗非自适应稳定子探针，并在模拟中观察到\qnEoneRatioFine倍。针对已实现的自引用策略，模拟增益约为强度平方倒数的两倍。该值还取决于攻击：摧毁未触碰单元使参考变得必要，而复制错误将指纹暴露给无参考探针。我们推导保险库的量子比特清单，并模拟封印需求曲线：十倍多的封印噪声使封印寿命延长\qnSealLifeGainFive倍，在$r=10$时归因成本为\qnSealRhoFive{}倍。

items.title_en: Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
items.title_zh: 验证PDE求解器的输出：从有限元到神经代理模型
items.abstract_en: Physics simulation outputs increasingly come from solvers that no expert inspects, such as third-party packages in automated pipelines, programs written by large language models (LLMs), and learned surrogates. In earlier work on cardiac pulsed field ablation, we proposed that solvers return a certificate with their answers. The certificate consists of an admissible potential and an exactly charge-conserving current, and a small independent checker turns it into guaranteed error bounds against a written specification of the physics. Here, the same checker verifies the outputs of other solvers on the same problem. Specifically, FEniCSx computes both fields and receives the same bounds as our own solver. Five plausible bugs in a correct solver, one of them about 0.2% from the true impedance, all converge and pass a grid convergence study, yet the certificate rejects or refutes all five. Of three solvers written by LLMs, one is correct and certified to 0.1%, and one never solves the equation but converges. Neural networks that predict the coefficients of a reduced basis emit admissible fields and receive valid per-prediction bounds, at most 0.0021% wide inside their training range and 0.3-25% wide outside it, where 90% conformal intervals cover none of 14 tests. Untuned Fourier neural operators with free nodal outputs receive valid but uninformative bounds. On a uniform grid, interpolation onto the certificate grid limits them, and on the certificate grid, thin cells turn small nodal errors into large energy errors. Energy-norm training narrows the certified interval tenfold, and projecting the nodal-loss outputs onto the reduced basis narrows it by two to four orders of magnitude, still uninformative. The guarantee concerns the stated model and holds for any output, wherever its input lies. It is informative only when the output is accurate in energy on a grid that resolves the problem.
items.abstract_zh: 物理仿真输出越来越多地来自没有专家检查的求解器，例如自动化流水线中的第三方软件包、大型语言模型（LLM）编写的程序以及学习得到的代理模型。在先前关于心脏脉冲场消融的工作中，我们提出求解器随答案返回证书。证书由一个可容许势和一个严格电荷守恒电流组成，一个小型独立检查器将其转化为针对物理书面规范的保证误差界。在这里，同一检查器验证同一问题上其他求解器的输出。具体而言，FEniCSx计算两个场，并获得与我们自己的求解器相同的边界。正确求解器中的五个看似合理的错误（其中一个与真实阻抗相差约0.2%）都收敛并通过网格收敛研究，但证书拒绝或驳斥了所有五个。在LLM编写的三个求解器中，一个是正确的并被认证到0.1%，另一个从未求解方程但收敛。预测约化基系数的神经网络输出可容许场，并获得有效的逐预测边界，在训练范围内宽度至多0.0021%，在训练范围外宽度为0.3-25%，其中90%共形区间在14个测试中一个也未覆盖。未调优的傅里叶神经算子具有自由节点输出，获得有效但无信息量的边界。在均匀网格上，插值到证书网格限制了它们；在证书网格上，薄单元将小的节点误差转化为大的能量误差。能量范数训练将认证区间缩小十倍，将节点损失输出投影到约化基上可将其缩小两到四个数量级，但仍无信息量。该保证针对所述模型，并对任何输出成立，无论其输入位于何处。仅当输出在能够解析该问题的网格上具有能量精度时，该保证才有信息量。

items.title_en: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
items.title_zh: Deneb-Vritra：通过恢复令牌表征和注意力进行阻断来检验描述、边和名称
items.abstract_en: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other options or text has no effect. No single head matters (largest effect 9 points), and restoring clean marker states undoes the swap from layer 16. Attention mass tracks the window by layer but not by head. Repeated on 5 checkpoints (released, fine-tuned, name-randomised, and a pair trained without two schemas), the knockout finds similar layers; in the name-randomised ones, blocking the description edges instead brings the shortcut back to 56-58%, so the read persists and is outvoted. Marker states decode the name from layer 0; a one-direction probe erasure changed nothing but was weaker than a random edit. Copying layers 0-13 or 14-27 of a name-randomised sibling into a fine-tune recovers 66% and 65% (v1); 21% and 45% (pair A) of its shortcut reduction. 9 of the 12 predictions we could score, written before running, failed. Head sweeps cover 5 of 5 checkpoints; data are synthetic and LLM-labelled; one architecture.
items.abstract_zh: Laya是一个421M参数的编码器，一次处理回答关于文本的问题：每个答案选项（写成一个名称加一个描述）获得一个标记令牌，并在每个标记处从网络读取一个分数。我们首先确认，当选项名称与描述矛盾时，此类模型可以跟随选项名称；问题在于这发生在网络中的何处。我们定位了它。在951个合成问题上，我们将每个名称移到另一个选项的描述上，并统计模型选择名称正确选项的频率（名称捷径）：发布检查点为53%，我们的微调v1为59%，名称随机化微调为11%。在320项样本上，在28层中的第14至17层阻断从每个标记到其自身名称令牌的注意力，将v1的捷径从67%降至16%（在两个从组件选择中留出的模式上为19%），而使用原始名称的准确率保持在90%；阻断标记到问题、其他选项或文本的边没有效果。没有单个头起作用（最大效应9个点），恢复干净的标记状态可从第16层撤销交换。注意力质量按层跟踪窗口，但不按头跟踪。在5个检查点（发布版、微调版、名称随机化版，以及一对在没有两个模式的情况下训练的模型）上重复，敲除找到相似的层；在名称随机化版本中，改为阻断描述边将捷径恢复到56-58%，因此读取持续存在并被多数否决。标记状态从第0层解码名称；单向探针擦除没有改变任何东西，但弱于随机编辑。将名称随机化兄弟模型的第0-13层或14-27层复制到微调中，分别恢复其捷径减少的66%和65%（v1）；21%和45%（配对A）。在我们可以评分的12个预测中，有9个是在运行前写的，失败了。头扫描覆盖5个检查点中的5个；数据是合成的且由LLM标注；一种架构。

items.title_en: One Latent World for Heterogeneous LiDARs: A Scan Pattern Agnostic 4D World Model via Direct Ray Decoding
items.title_zh: 异构LiDAR的单一潜在世界：通过直接光线解码的扫描模式无关4D世界模型
items.abstract_en: LiDAR world models generate and predict metric 3D observations in the form of LiDAR scans. They typically synthesize scans following the scan pattern of their training sensor or render them from an intermediate 3D surface or field. However, following one scan pattern limits transfer to LiDARs with other patterns, and rendering from intermediate geometry can cause incorrect depths and false returns. In this paper, we propose a scan pattern agnostic 4D LiDAR world model that decouples the scene from sensor observation, so one spatial latent can be observed by heterogeneous LiDARs at the same mounting position without regeneration. Our decoder predicts the hit probability and depth of each ray directly from the latent, combining global scene context with local features retrieved at a preliminary depth. Without an intermediate surface or field, it reduces incorrect depths and false returns, and as each ray is decoded independently from one latent, LiDARs that share a ray receive the same return and observe one consistent scene. Finally, a diffusion transformer generates scenes in this latent and predicts 4D sequences from observed latents warped by the given ego and object motion. On KITTI-360 and nuScenes, our model generates realistic scenes and reduces the registration error between predicted frames by about 70% relative to the best compared world model. Its decoder yields 19 to 28% lower depth error than the rendering used by other world models, and generated scans benefit several downstream tasks. Our code will be open-sourced. More details are available at https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR世界模型以LiDAR扫描的形式生成和预测度量3D观测。它们通常按照训练传感器的扫描模式合成扫描，或从中间3D表面或场渲染。然而，遵循一种扫描模式限制了向具有其他模式的LiDAR的迁移，从中间几何渲染可能导致不正确的深度和虚假回波。在本文中，我们提出一种扫描模式无关的4D LiDAR世界模型，将场景与传感器观测解耦，使得同一安装位置上的异构LiDAR可以观测同一个空间潜在表示而无需重新生成。我们的解码器直接从潜在表示预测每条光线的命中概率和深度，结合全局场景上下文与在初步深度处检索的局部特征。没有中间表面或场，它减少了不正确的深度和虚假回波，并且由于每条光线从同一潜在表示独立解码，共享一条光线的LiDAR接收相同的回波并观测到一个一致的场景。最后，扩散变换器在该潜在表示中生成场景，并从由给定自车和物体运动变形的观测潜在表示预测4D序列。在KITTI-360和nuScenes上，我们的模型生成逼真的场景，并相对于最佳比较世界模型将预测帧之间的配准误差降低约70%。其解码器产生的深度误差比其他世界模型使用的渲染低19%到28%，生成的扫描有益于若干下游任务。我们的代码将开源。更多细节见https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld。

items.title_en: Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic
items.title_zh: 现代自监督视觉 Transformer 具有空想性错视
items.abstract_en: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features themselves.We call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic subspace.On natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in DINO.This excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their own.Our experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than lost.These findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining directions.Across diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\mathcal{J}$ on video object segmentation.To identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.
items.abstract_zh: 在人类感知中，空想性错视（pareidolia）是指在随机或模糊刺激中感知到有意义模式（例如人脸）的倾向。我们在现代自监督视觉 Transformer（ViT）中发现类似现象：在白噪声上——白噪声既不含物体也不含空间结构——其特征的少数方向仍会在各图像块之间形成空间连贯的模式，且这种模式由特征本身施加。我们将这种行为称为空想性错视，并将这些方向张成的空间称为空想性错视子空间。在自然图像上，该子空间承载了 DINOv2 和 DINOv3 的大部分特征方差，但在 DINO 中只占很小一部分。这种过量可解释为何 DINOv2 和 DINOv3 尽管具有更强的密集特征，却在物体涌现（object emergence）——自监督 ViT 自行识别物体图像块的标志性能力——上远远落后于 DINO。我们的实验进一步表明，按比例缩小其空想性错视子空间可稳定恢复其发现物体的能力，因此其物体涌现能力是被阻碍而非丢失。这些发现自然引出一个免训练校准方法：空想性错视子空间校准（Pareidolia Subspace Calibration, PSC）仅在噪声输入上测量空想性错视子空间，然后通过将这些方向的方差缩放至其余方向的方差水平，来校准自然输入的特征。在多种物体涌现任务中，PSC 使 DINOv2 和 DINOv3 在物体发现上的 CorLoc 最高提升 31.7，在显著性检测上的 maxF 提升 30.2，在视频物体分割上的 J 提升 59.9。为识别空想性错视的成因，我们逐块追踪，发现它在我们考察的每个自监督模型的中间块中形成，但仅在使用图像块级损失训练的模型中一直保持到最后一个块；受控训练证实，仅使用图像级损失会让其消退。

items.title_en: When Can an AI Agent Serve as a Model of Human Psychopathology?
items.title_zh: AI 智能体何时能作为人类精神病理学模型？
items.abstract_en: Language models and AI agents are increasingly described in psychiatric terms, such as anxious, depressed, addicted or helpless. A recent study even proposed language models as experimental systems for psychiatry and as a platform for piloting psychological treatments. We ask when an experiment on an AI agent can provide evidence about a specified human psychiatric process. A claim to such evidence has three parts. Something changed in the agent, and the agent's history caused the change. Nothing other than a process shared with people explains that change. The change matches one theory of the human process and not that theory's rivals. Psychiatry and its neighbouring fields have an evidence standard for each part, from the diagnostic manuals' rule for induced states, from clinical test scores and from animal models. We translate each standard into a criterion that a machine study can meet. For a language model the most critical alternative to a shared process is extrapolation from its training text, which already contains descriptions of how people respond to trauma and how they answer questionnaires. We show how to probe that alternative. Further, we audited forty-three published studies that apply psychiatric terms to a machine or induce a comparable state in one. Most compared the machine with an identical copy that had not gone through the history that induced the state. None excluded extrapolation from training text. Three tested a psychiatric theory against its rivals, and none of the three tests was conclusive. Until better evidence exists, a treatment pilot on a language model is best read as the model's forecast of patient response, and not as an experiment on a model organism. Evidence for a model organism will come from states induced by what happens to the machine, from experiments on its internal workings, and from tests on which rival theories disagree.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型和 AI 智能体正越来越多地被用精神病学术语描述，例如焦虑、抑郁、成瘾或无助。近期一项研究甚至提出将语言模型作为精神病学的实验系统，以及作为试点心理治疗的平台。我们追问：在何种条件下，针对 AI 智能体的实验能够为特定的人类精神病理过程提供证据。对此类证据的主张包含三部分：智能体中发生了某种变化，且智能体的历史导致了该变化；除了与人类共享的过程之外，没有其他原因能解释该变化；该变化符合关于人类过程的某一理论，而不符合该理论的竞争理论。精神病学及其邻近领域对每一部分都有证据标准，分别来自诊断手册关于诱发状态的规则、临床测试分数以及动物模型。我们将每项标准转化为机器研究能够满足的判据。对语言模型而言，与共享过程相比最关键的替代解释是从其训练文本中进行外推，而训练文本已经包含人们如何应对创伤以及如何回答问卷的描述。我们展示如何探查这一替代解释。此外，我们审计了 43 项已发表研究，这些研究将精神病学术语应用于机器，或在机器中诱发可比状态。大多数研究将机器与一个未经历诱发该状态之历史的相同副本进行比较。没有一项研究排除了从训练文本外推。三项研究用竞争理论检验某一精神病学理论，且这三项检验均非结论性。在存在更好证据之前，对语言模型进行治疗试点最好被解读为模型对患者反应的预测，而不是对模式生物的实验。模式生物的证据将来自由机器所经历之事诱发的状态、对其内部运作的实验，以及竞争理论存在分歧的检验。

items.title_en: Auditing a superconducting database built by a large language model
items.title_zh: 审计由大语言模型构建的超导数据库
items.abstract_en: The data on superconducting materials are published as measurements and scattered across the literature, in prose, in tables and in figures, so that gathering them into one place means reading the papers themselves. Large language models (LLMs) can read those papers, and databases built that way are appearing. The difficulty is not the reading but the trust: a number lifted out of a sentence can belong to a neighbouring compound, a computed transition temperature can be recorded without saying that it is computed, and the paper itself may be wrong. This paper describes a pipeline that extracts superconducting materials from the published literature with an LLM, checks every value against its source, and asks how far that checking goes. The pipeline proposed 19,576 records; a cascade of gates rejected 659,252 field-level extractions, 644,438 of them for want of verbatim evidence, 13,121 because the text does not attach the value to the material, and 1,693 because the source sentence reads as a calculation. The database that survives holds 3,137 material records, each with the sentence its value came from. An audit of the survivors by two independent models, on 500 records drawn in proportion to the database, shows that the gates remove the errors that are mechanical: in 93.4% of the audited records the value is in the text and the text is about the compound the record names, and 91.8% of them are measurements rather than predictions.
items.abstract_zh: 超导材料数据以测量结果形式发表，并分散于文献中的散文、表格和图像里，因此将其汇集到一处意味着要阅读论文本身。大语言模型（LLM）可以阅读这些论文，以这种方式构建的数据库正在出现。困难不在于阅读，而在于信任：从句子中提取出的数字可能属于相邻化合物；计算得到的转变温度可能被记录而未说明其为计算值；论文本身也可能有误。本文描述一个流程：用 LLM 从已发表文献中提取超导材料，对每个数值与其来源进行核对，并追问这种核对能深入到何种程度。该流程提出 19,576 条记录；一系列门控拒绝了 659,252 次字段级抽取，其中 644,438 次因缺少逐字证据，13,121 次因文本未将该数值归属于该材料，1,693 次因源句读起来像计算。最终保留的数据库包含 3,137 条材料记录，每条记录都带有其数值来源句子。由两个独立模型对幸存记录进行审计，样本为按数据库比例抽取的 500 条记录，结果显示门控移除了机械性错误：在受审计记录中，93.4% 的数值出现在文本中，且文本所涉化合物与记录所指化合物一致；其中 91.8% 是测量值而非预测值。

items.title_en: Matching Under Metric Privacy
items.title_zh: 度量隐私下的匹配
items.abstract_en: We study how to represent and randomize points in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy. Given $n$ private and $n$ public points, we analyze local mechanisms that randomize each private point or its distances to the public points. Using the public points' affine span, we construct a smaller representation that preserves all matching costs. When a trusted server receives the private points, we establish privacy and utility guarantees for Gumbel matching, which randomizes edge costs and releases only the assignment. Through upper bounds and worst-case constructions, we establish the tight rate $Θ\!\left(n\min\{d,\log n\}/\varepsilon\right)$ for expected cost above the nonprivate optimum. Benchmark experiments support $d\approx\log n$ as a practical guide to the transition between directly randomizing point coordinates and using Gumbel matching. Extensions to squared Euclidean costs enable private nonparametric two-sample hypothesis testing. These results show how the application's trust model guides representation and dimension choices for better utility: under local privacy, low-dimensional point representations reduce excess cost, while under central privacy, distance representations achieve the optimal rate even in high dimension.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究如何在度量隐私下表示并随机化 d 维欧氏空间中的点，以获得准确的双部匹配。给定 n 个私有和 n 个公开点，我们分析对每个私有点或其到公开点的距离进行随机化的本地机制。利用公开点的仿射张成，我们构造一个更小的表示，并保留所有匹配代价。当可信服务器接收私有 point 时，我们为 Gumbel matching 建立隐私与效用保证；Gumbel matching 随机化边代价并仅发布分配结果。通过上界和最坏情况构造，我们确立了相对于非私有最优解的期望代价的紧致速率 Θ(n min{d, log n}/ε)。基准实验支持将 d≈log n 作为在直接随机化点坐标与使用 Gumbel matching 之间过渡的实用指南。对平方欧氏代价的扩展使私有非参数双样本假设检验成为可能。这些结果表明，应用的信任模型如何指导表示和维度选择以获得更好的效用：在本地隐私下，低维点表示降低额外代价；而在中心隐私下，距离表示即使在高维下也能达到最优速率。

items.title_en: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
items.title_zh: 连载与人物系统：测量法国小说中的叙事集中度（1800–1940）
items.abstract_en: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical commentary on protagonists might suggest. We operationalize Woloch's notion of the character-system, the distribution of narrative attention across a novel's cast structured by the tension between "the one" and "the many", as the inequality (Gini coefficient) of the PageRank distribution over a character network. We trace this measure of structural concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940, drawn from the Hors d'usage corpus of Gallica fiction. Over the long nineteenth century the trajectory is U-shaped, with concentration declining to a trough in the 1850s-1860s and rising again through the turn of the century. The change is small, comparable to the difference between a novel built on two co-equal protagonists and one built on a single protagonist, but it is robust to the character cutoff, corpus density, cast size, and author effects. Detective and adventure fiction are less concentrated than the average novel of their period. Literary history reads the roman-feuilleton either as the novel of a superior hero or as a form of proliferating episodes, and on this structural measure our results support the second reading. Across the age of the feuilleton (1840-1914), authors whose careers were structured by newspaper serialization distribute centrality more evenly than a literary control, net of period, genre, and canon. Because such claims are only as trustworthy as the networks they rest on, we also evaluate the extraction pipeline against manually annotated novels, at the levels of cast and character identity.
items.abstract_zh: 每一部小说都会在人物之间分配有限数量的叙事注意力，而这种分配的形状——是围绕单一人物组织叙事，还是分散到一群人——是否有历史，远比关于主人公的大量批评评论可能暗示的更不确定。我们将 Woloch 的“人物系统”概念操作化，即小说人物阵容中叙事注意力的分布，由“一个”与“许多”之间的张力所塑造，并将其定义为人物网络 PageRank 分布的不平等程度（基尼系数）。我们在 1800 年至 1940 年间出版的 12,011 部法国小说中追踪这一结构集中度指标，这些小说取自 Gallica 小说的 Hors d'usage 语料库。在漫长的 19 世纪，其轨迹呈 U 形：集中度下降至 1850—1860 年代的低谷，并在世纪之交再次上升。变化很小，相当于一部建立在两个同等主人公之上的小说与一部建立在单一主人公之上的小说之间的差异，但该结果对人物截断、语料密度、阵容规模和作者效应均稳健。侦探小说和冒险小说的集中度低于其所在时期的平均小说。文学史将 roman-feuilleton 要么解读为优越英雄的小说，要么解读为情节增殖的形式；在这一结构性指标上，我们的结果支持第二种解读。在连载小说时代（1840—1914），职业生涯由报纸连载塑造的作者，在控制时期、体裁和经典性后，比文学对照组更均匀地分配中心性。由于此类主张的可信度只取决于其所依赖的网络，我们还在人物阵容和人物身份层面，用人工标注小说评估抽取流程。

items.title_en: EnvTrap: Revealing the Environment-Only Attack Surface in Embodied AI via Consequence-Blind Action Execution
items.title_zh: EnvTrap：通过后果盲的动作执行揭示具身 AI 中仅环境攻击面
items.abstract_en: As AI models evolve from text and vision to physical agents, embodied AI faces a fundamentally different attack surface. Prior attacks on embodied systems have used crafted instructions, adversarial visual inputs, and training-time policy modifications; we study environment-only object rearrangements with unchanged models and instructions. We reveal an attack surface in safety-critical spatial relations among existing objects. An adversary who rearranges objects, without modifying instructions or accessing models, can cause hazardous consequences. In this work, we propose EnvTrap, a diagnostic pipeline that constructs paired safe, trap, and null-trap (benign but misleading) embodied scenarios. We demonstrate that environment-only perturbations raise hazardous-action rates to an average of 83.4% across the five evaluated action policies, with similar vulnerability patterns confirmed in world models. On a consequence-prediction task, model accuracy remains near chance, while human evaluators achieve high accuracy. We further propose a consequence-aware defense that reduces trap trigger rates by an average of 76.3 percentage points across action policies in simulation and by 62.9 percentage points pooled across physical backends. Together, these findings link environment-only attacks to a broader deficit in physical reasoning: embodied models recognize task-relevant objects yet fail to anticipate how spatial relations change the consequences of acting on them. EnvTrap makes this gap directly testable and turns hazardous layouts into training scenarios for safer embodied action. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap.
items.abstract_zh: 随着 AI 模型从文本和视觉演进为物理智能体，具身 AI 面临根本不同的攻击面。以往对具身系统的攻击使用了精心设计的指令、对抗性视觉输入以及训练时的策略修改；我们研究在模型和指令均不变的条件下仅通过环境中的物体重排实施的攻击。我们揭示了现有物体之间安全攸关空间关系中的一个攻击面。攻击者在不修改指令、不访问模型的情况下重排物体，便可造成危险后果。在本工作中，我们提出 EnvTrap，一个诊断流程，用于构建成对的安全、陷阱和空陷阱（良性但具误导性）具身场景。我们证明，仅环境扰动使五种被评估动作策略的危险动作率平均升至 83.4%，并在世界模型中也确认了相似的脆弱性模式。在后果预测任务上，模型准确率仍接近随机，而人类评估者达到高准确率。我们进一步提出一种后果感知防御，在仿真中将各动作策略的陷阱触发率平均降低 76.3 个百分点，在汇总多个物理后端时降低 62.9 个百分点。总之，这些发现将仅环境攻击与更广泛的物理推理缺陷联系起来：具身模型能识别任务相关物体，却无法预判空间关系如何改变对其采取行动的后果。EnvTrap 使这一差距可直接检验，并将危险布局转化为训练场景，以支持更安全的具身行动。代码和数据见 https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap。

items.title_en: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
items.title_zh: TowerBridge：通过权重空间编程弥合双编码器模态鸿沟
items.abstract_en: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.
items.abstract_zh: CLIP 风格的双编码器通过两个独立的塔将图像和文本映射到共享嵌入空间，两种模态占据由模态鸿沟分隔的不同区域。当错误匹配或难负样本的排名高于正确匹配时，检索就会失败，而该鸿沟通常是怀疑对象。然而，在我们测试的每个 CLIP 检查点上，事后消除该鸿沟都会降低检索性能。我们引入一种成对统计量，用于识别两个塔在难负样本上比在匹配对上更一致的方向。适度衰减这些方向可改善检索，同时基本保留该鸿沟。我们通过权重空间编程得到这一修正：在该统计量的引导下，一个 LLM 智能体检查两个塔，并在不进行反向传播的情况下写出闭式权重编辑。由于可以自由编辑任意组件，该智能体在全部 13 个 CLIP 检查点上改善了 COCO 测试检索，并在其中 12 个上编辑了输出投影。我们将其反复出现的修正提炼并改进为 TowerBridge，这是一种由难负样本边际的一阶分析所启发的闭式方法。它基于 25,000 个带标签对在数秒内计算完成，无需针对模型进行调优，且不改变架构和推理成本。在全部 21 个被评估的 CLIP 检查点上，TowerBridge 平均将 COCO 测试检索提高 16.8 RSUM，将 Flickr30k 测试检索提高 6.6，其中包括智能体未见过的 8 个检查点，同时将 ImageNet 零样本准确率的任何下降限制在 0.5 个百分点以内。它还在全部 21 个检查点上降低了 hubness，并在来自其他家族的 5 个双编码器中的 4 个上改善了检索。

items.title_en: Classical visual illusions in vision-language models under an instruction ladder
items.title_zh: 指令阶梯下视觉语言模型中的经典视错觉
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) often name the "illusory" answer when shown a classical visual illusion, but it is unclear whether that answer comes from the picture or from knowledge about famous figures. We drew 300 new stimuli of 25 classical illusions in three conditions--the illusion, the illusion with its inducing elements reversed, and a control with the inducing elements removed--and asked about each image at eight rungs of an instruction ladder that runs from a false fact, through a neutral question and an instruction to report the physical truth, to telling the model the name of the illusion and finally the true answer. Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5, with thinking off and on, gave 460,800 answers. When asked for the physical fact, all four settings almost never gave the illusion answer, and they resolved real 10% differences in the same displays. When asked how the picture looks, the illusion answers returned, and they did not vanish after the true answer was stated. Two measures that cancel position preferences and recognition of the figure suggest that much of this depends on the stimulus: among side answers, Sonnet with thinking chose the illusion side in 85% of cases after being told the truth (95% CI 74--96%), with 16 of the 25 illusions showing a stimulus-driven effect. Yet for five figures--the Fraser spiral, Kanizsa triangle, Pinna--Brelstaff rings, Ouchi pattern and, for Haiku, the rotating snakes--the models gave the illusion answer to the control images as well, which suggests that they answered from the figure rather than from the effect. A false fact was mostly followed on control images but not on illusion images. The stimuli, prompts, all responses and the code are released for testing further models; the Python code that draws the stimuli is parametric and can generate new illusion images for other studies with models or human observers.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在观看经典视错觉时，常常会说出“错觉”答案，但尚不清楚该答案是来自图像，还是来自对著名图形的知识。我们绘制了 25 种经典视错觉的 300 个新刺激，分为三种条件——错觉本身、诱导元素被反转的错觉、以及去除诱导元素的对照——并在八个指令阶梯层级上对每张图像提问；该阶梯从虚假事实开始，经过中性问题和报告物理真相的指令，到告诉模型错觉的名称，最后告诉真实答案。Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Claude Haiku 5.5 在关闭和开启思考的情况下，共给出 460,800 个答案。当被要求给出物理事实时，全部四种设置几乎从不给出错觉答案，并且它们能分辨同一显示中真实的 10% 差异。当被问及图片看起来如何时，错觉答案又会出现，而且在陈述真实答案后也没有消失。两个消除位置偏好和图形识别影响的指标表明，这在很大程度上取决于刺激：在侧边答案中，开启思考的 Sonnet 在被告知真相后，于 85% 的情况下选择了错觉一侧（95% CI 74--96%），25 种错觉中有 16 种表现出刺激驱动效应。然而对于五个图形——弗雷泽螺旋、卡尼萨三角、平纳–布雷尔斯塔夫环、大内图案，以及对 Haiku 而言的旋转蛇——模型对对照图像也给出了错觉答案，这表明它们是根据图形而非错觉效应作答。在对照图像上，模型大多遵循虚假事实，但在错觉图像上并非如此。刺激、提示、所有回答和代码均已发布，用于测试更多模型；绘制刺激的 Python 代码是参数化的，可为使用模型或人类观察者的其他研究生成新的错觉图像。

items.title_en: Reconstruction and geometry of $4\times4$ quantum Sudoku
items.title_zh: $4\times4$ 量子数独的重构与几何
items.abstract_en: We study the reconstruction and geometry of $4 \times 4$ quantum Sudoku, viewed as arrays of rank-one projections whose rows, columns and blocks decompose the identity. We give necessary and sufficient conditions for two prescribed opposite blocks to admit a completion, prove its uniqueness, and obtain explicit reconstruction formulas, also expressed in the language of quantum logic. The sixteen overlaps between these blocks determine the unitary equivalence class of the grid, while the number of nonzero overlaps equals its cardinality. Using a matrix representation, we parametrise the equivalence classes by five closed squares, with the sides of one square identified with the diagonals of the other four. The quotient by classical cell symmetries is a closed disc containing exactly two classical classes. Finally, measurement in the basis of the first block gives a fractional Sudoku that retains the full unitary class and is a convex combination of at most four classical grids. This measurement map embeds the five-square model into a seven-dimensional polytope whose vertices are the twelve classical Sudoku.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究 $4 \times 4$ 量子数独的重构与几何，将其视为秩一投影的阵列，其行、列和块分解单位矩阵。我们给出两个指定相对块允许完成（completion）的充要条件，证明其唯一性，并获得显式重构公式，也用量子逻辑的语言表达。这些块之间的十六个重叠决定网格的酉等价类，而非零重叠的数量等于其基数。利用矩阵表示，我们用五个闭正方形参数化等价类，其中一个正方形的边与另外四个正方形的对角线等同。按经典单元对称性取商得到一个闭圆盘，其中恰好包含两个经典类。最后，在第一个块的基下测量得到一个分数数独，它保留完整的酉类，并且是最多四个经典网格的凸组合。该测量映射将五正方形模型嵌入一个七维多面体，其顶点是十二个经典数独。

items.title_en: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
items.title_zh: 回顾过去，前瞻起草：用于并行投机解码的纠正性前缀注意力
items.abstract_en: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.
items.abstract_zh: 并行投机解码器一次性提出整个 token 块，然而早期的一处不一致就可能导致目标模型拒绝其剩余后缀。我们引入纠正性前缀注意力（CPA），它将前缀感知的选择与自回归监督相结合，以改进这些并行草稿。CPA 让每个候选关注块内较早的选择。固定的候选短名单允许在选择之前计算所有成对交互，从而将顺序遍历缩减为表查找、累加和轻量评分，而不是重复的神经评估。一个辅助自回归损失在干净前缀上训练共享主干，且不增加推理过程。在 Ascend NPU 上，以 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 为目标模型的八个数学、代码和对话基准中，CPA 每轮验证提交的 token 数比 DSpark 多 13--15\%，比 DFlash 多 25--26\%。对于两个目标模型，其平均加速在贪心解码下达到 $3.35\times$ 和 $3.37\times$，在采样下为 $2.86\times$。消融实验支持两个组件，而容量扫描表明，仅提高接受率并不能保证更快的解码。这些结果说明，用因果信息纠正并行提议，同时保持顺序计算开销低廉，是有价值的。

items.title_en: Specification-Aware Sparse Differentiation: Planning under Signal Temporal Logic with Sparsemax Robustness
items.title_zh: 规范感知的稀疏微分：在带有 Sparsemax 鲁棒性的信号时序逻辑下规划
items.abstract_en: Gradient-based optimal control under a Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specification involves solving a nonlinear program whose constraints are smoothed robustness functions of the trajectory, and automatic differentiation without knowledge of sparsity computes the Jacobian and the Hessian that its solver needs in full. This often renders the problem computationally intractable. The dynamics and the specification prescribe a sparsity pattern through the STL syntax, the windows of the temporal operators and the variables that the predicates read. Standard tools such as CasADi recover this pattern by structural detection. In this work, we propose a method to prescribe such a pattern directly from the task specification. We show that our method allows us to exploit SparseMax, a recently proposed smooth robustness operator that is certifiably sparse and sound. Its derivative is exactly zero at every operand at or below a data-dependent threshold, which structural detection cannot see. We derive the patterns that expose this trajectory-dependent sparsity to sparse automatic differentiation, with a margin test for their reuse and Hessians confined to the variables of each constraint's support. We demonstrate the method on a dual-arm coordination task in which two arms share a hand-off zone divided into cells and one until constraint per scheduled visit keeps the other arm out of a cell until the visitor has left it. The two scenes are a zone of five cells and a circle of 64 cells, with single solves and closed-loop re-planning on a rigid-body simulation. Our exact-Hessian interior-point solves are up to 27 times faster than those with the sound log-sum-exp robustness in CasADi and IPOPT.
items.abstract_zh: 在信号时序逻辑（STL）规范下的基于梯度的最优控制涉及求解一个非线性规划，其约束是轨迹的平滑鲁棒性函数，而不知道稀疏性的自动微分会完整计算其求解器所需的雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵。这通常使问题在计算上难以处理。动力学和规范通过 STL 语法、时序算子的窗口以及谓词读取的变量规定了一种稀疏模式。像 CasADi 这样的标准工具通过结构检测恢复该模式。在这项工作中，我们提出一种直接从任务规范规定这种模式的方法。我们表明，我们的方法允许利用 SparseMax，这是一种最近提出的平滑鲁棒性算子，具有可证明的稀疏性和可靠性。在每个等于或低于数据相关阈值的操作数处，其导数恰好为零，而结构检测无法看到这一点。我们推导出将这些依赖于轨迹的稀疏性暴露给稀疏自动微分的模式，并带有用于复用它们的边际检验，以及限制在每个约束支撑变量上的海森矩阵。我们在一个双臂协调任务上演示该方法，其中两条臂共享一个划分为单元格的交接区域，并且每次计划访问有一个 until 约束，使另一条臂在访问者离开某个单元格之前不能进入该单元格。两个场景是一个由五个单元格组成的区域和一个由 64 个单元格组成的圆，在刚体仿真上进行单次求解和闭环重规划。我们的精确海森内点法求解比在 CasADi 和 IPOPT 中使用可靠的 log-sum-exp 鲁棒性的求解快最多 27 倍。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。
